tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 8 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur gzhon pa dang / gtso sgrig pa/ karma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/ mun sel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/ shes rab bzang po/zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring chos sgron/ shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'brug rgyas/

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/dpal brtsegs bod yig dnge rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/dpe thum gsol/dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces brtsas〉 zhes pa'i dpe rding dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang /da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang /'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/nang don rig pa dang /gso ba rig pa/tshad ma rig pa/sgra rig pa/bzo rig pa/lo rgyus/rtsis rig sogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yin/—1—

'ad 'dra'i dpe skrun mnyam las kya go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa na shan tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brjid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lhe gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu le na dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gas la bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mab na rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes chad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'byug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu spungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa cam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / har wid lta bu yo rob dang / a ri sogs su grags chen gyi slob grwa chen mo — 1 —

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod wo po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi be+e ro ska cog zhung / /ga ubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ tanangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'gyung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/—2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang changs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ 'khru / gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/ —3—

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhyen mkhye/na/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zho re las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs tog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/sgro4—

bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+di dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod — 1 —

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras skrungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

bsdu sgrag gsal bshad/gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon tan bzang pos 'jam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3 —

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni mdzo dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras spungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bshes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras skrungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4—

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos chan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'gyung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rjo 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di/ 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5 —

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song hrin krin sogs kyi rgya'i spyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—6—

khong ni slob dpon chen po pa / sge sne 1 6 3 'a / grang gnas dang / paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang spyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs nga/ sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis — 1 —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge spyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung / ’dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gtugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /hūm̐ spya /khri ba bas dgyes yaste sdi sni ༵rni hūm̐/༷sbyi ༷/shī rdo/༷rdo bzhisang ldan bcas rngeg dkyil bdun/ rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/sgrub 'gre ༷ stu | rdo sgyu rtsa'i med rjes 'od | /rdo /kau / chong ༷ /drug 'jam grel dang / / pyudz+nyā ka' rjes rdo gnang rje'i rgya // khrid ༵ /la rgyas ༵/ra ur+ya rjo ༵ ༵ ༵/ lha dho ༵ hūṃ sna /spyu / /sa kau rjo chos lnga/ nag po'i ri gzhud drug pū hi smad lnga/ dril bu skor gsum/ gshe/da dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs /tri kyā~X ༵/ pa shi sem / 'i spre s+ho/ phyag rgya so bskyed rdzog kā/༷ two rdo' bye gas spyis pag khri //༵ ༵snro rdo/ de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla rdo/ stu ༷ sh+lau rtse hūm̐ rdorde sngi ni rgi / lhun rje rtse two ༵༷rde slob sod dpon maX/ —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma nga/pal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/ dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon pad+ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bshes bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bzhas bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'gyung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta pu'o nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni rbu ṇa shrī dang puṇ+ḍa badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya cam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom nga/'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris nga dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams kyang gzhan la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi bcu shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen pod gnyis —8—

༵lhi/༵ ༵༵ 'di ska hā~X ༵ rnyeda~X tshi~X ༵tshan ( ri chen dzi sbyi ste the ṭā mang ༵sta/ ༵ ༵snru ༵ pa dzhai/ ༵ bsdus mi ༵/ ༵ sdo ༵ / gzhan snyed gi nā rwa ngo pa ༵༵sna rno~X po'i /skad dod ༵ dhi bha rjo sna / rno ༵ dho sngi/ ༵ mdzad tsho byurnga pa/ byang du byang chub bzang yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras sbungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol ༵༵sna ba~X ༵ sna ga / sung na nyis / tha// shā gling da/ rtag brtan chos nā/༵ sogs dbu khris/ gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste de /nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635 ) la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9 —

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang na po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gcang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i spyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/

zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi rnam par bshad pa rgyas par bstan pa zung 'jug rab tu gsal ba chen po zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 1rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i snying po stan thog gcig ma'i khrid yig bzhu kyigs// / 252rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi phyi'i ngo sprod bzhugs/ 262sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i ngo sprod nang ma bzhugs/ 282rnal 'byo ra yan lag drug pa'i rtags tshad kyi yi ge bzhugs/ 324sbyor drug gegs sel bzhugs/ 356sbyor drug gi dri lan bzhugs/ 395

bstan pa zung la drug rab tu gsal ba chen po zhes bya ba bzhu / gas/oX snya sti/ oX āXhuX hoXhaX k+ṣaX zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi rnam par bshad pa rgyas par bstan pa zung 'jug rab tu gsal ba chen po zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan rigs rnams kun gyi khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' lha mor bcas/ /brtan g.yor bcas pa'i srid zhi kun gyi snying po mchog dang mgon du bzhugs/ /mtha' dag srid gsum rnam pa kun du rtag tu 'char ba chos kyi dbyings/ /rje bo dam pa srid med srid bral mchog gi bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /kun la khyab pa gdod ma'i mgon po ni/ /mngon sum lam gyis skyon ngon du 'gyur ba'i thabs/ khyab bdag skye dgu'i bdag pos gsal mdzad lam/ /bla ma'i zhal lung bla na med pa gang / /skal ldan tshogs su skal bzang 'jug ngogs zla bral 'di/ /de ring 'chad kyi de bzhin nyid don 'tshol 'dod rnams/ /legs par bzung zhig legs pa'i lam 'dis 'gro rnams la/ /mchog dang thun mong mchog gi 'bras bu'i dga' ston snyeX/ /rdo rje theg pa'i nges gsang smra ba'i

tshe/ /'phags yul mkhas pa mang po'ang rnam 'khor na/ /phyogs 'di'i mkhas par rlom pa mang po zhig /'khrul pas g.yengs mod 'di la ngo mtshar ci theg pa'i yang rtse dpal ldan dus 'khor zhes/ /phal cher smon gnas tsam las khengs mod kyang / /ma nor ji bzhin gsal la rab rgyas pa/ /zhib mor smra ba'i dbyod ldan deng 'dir su/ /blo chung 'ga' res rtog pa'i 'khrul 'khor spel/ /zol 'jog tsam las ngo sor sgrog pa dang / /legs par bslabs min mthong ba'i nga rgyal can/ /snying pos dben pa'i rnam bshad mang mod kyang / /nge dag ma lus cig car zil gnon pa/ /grub pa'i man ngag mkhas pa'i lung rig can/ /nges don legs bshad chu gter 'dir 'jug pa/ /brgya lam na yin rjes su yi rang byos/ de yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis gang zhig ston pa dang / shes ldan rnams kyis gang zhig don du gnyer bar bya ba ni thar pa mchog dang de'i thabs gnyis yin la/ thar pa yang chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin gnas lugs tsam zhig tu nges shing / lam gyi rim pa rnams kyang gnas lugs de la phyin ci log tu sgro btags pa'i 'khrul pa rnams sbyong ba'i thabs zhig go /de ltar nges nas lam gol bar nam yang mi 'gro zhing / drang don tsam la brten pa'i ring lam dag la 'jug par yang mi spro ba'i skal bzang dag ni/dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa mtha' dag gis thugs kyi snying po dang zhal gyi bdud rtsir gyur pa rdo rje'i theg pa'i nges gsang bla na med pa'i lam mchog mthar thug chos rdo rje'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba 'di la 'jug dgos pas/'di'i don cung zad 'chad par byed pa la/ chos thams cad gzhi lam 'bras bu —2—

gsum gyis bsdus pa'i gnad kyis rgyud kyi rgyal po thams cad du rgyud gsum du gsungs so/ /de ltar yang / 'dus pa phyi ma las/ rgyud ni rgyun chags zhes bya ste/ /rgyud de rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /gzhi dang de yi rang bzhin dang / /mi 'phrogs pa yis rab phye ba/ /rang bzhin rnam pa rgyu yi na te/ /gzhi ni thabs zhes bya ba'o/ /de bzhin mi 'phrogs 'bras bu ste /gsum gyis rgyud kyi don bsdus pa'o/ /zhes gsungs shing / dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khe/ra lo la sogs pa'i rgyu sde 'di rnams su phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi rim pas kyang gsungs te/ de snyel phyi chags 'jigs gnas pa 'jig rten khams/ nang lus rtsa rlung thig re/'i rang bzhin/ gzhan rlos nyid de bzhin nyid zung 3jug gi bdag nyid can rnam/sa yin la/ gzhan mchog de thob byed kyi thabs dbang dang bskyed rdzogs la sogs pa'i lam rnams kyang gzhan gyi khongs su bsdu'o/ /de ltar myo/ phyi nang gnyis ni rgyu rgyud kyi chos su gtogs la/ gzhan la dbye na thabs rgyud dang / 'bras rgyud gnyis su 'gyur ro/ /de la rgyud de gsum ngo/'i don gyi gtso bo chos nyid de bzhin nyid yin pas ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba med la/ rgyud ces bya ba'i sgra dngos kyang 'di la 'jug pa yin zhing / gang zag so so'i gnas skabs gsum gyi blo'i 'char sgo la 'khe ra ba dang lam dang 'bras bu'i chos sna tshogs par shar ba rnams ni rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu dngos su 'jog pa'i skabs yod kyang rgyud ni btags pa ba yin te/ de bas na de rnams la ni rgyu rgyud kyi bsdus pa'i chos dang / thabs rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i ches dang / 'bras rgyud kyis bsdus nga 'i chos zhes bya yi/ rgyu rgyud/ thabs rgyud/ 'bras rgyud dngos su mi 'jog go /de dag —3—

las skabs 'dir thabs kyi mchog rdzogs pa'i rim pa gtso bor gtan la dbab bya yin zhing / de nyid rtogs par bya ba'i yan lag tu rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rnam pe ra gzhag pa yang cung zad tsam gtan la dbab par bya dgos pas/ don gyi mngo/ 'di ltar bzang bar bya ste/ gang la sgrub pa'i yul gzhi'i gnas lugs gtan la dbab/ ji ltar sgrub pa'i thabs rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sgom pa'i tshul/ de ltar bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa'i rang bzhin te gsum las/ dang po la/ gzhi'i gnas lugs spyir bshad pa dang / lus kyi gnas tshul bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ rang lugs gsal bar brjod pa dang / rgyu rgyud la log rtog sel ba'o/ /dang po la// rgyu rgyud kyi rang bzhin ngos bzung / de'i khyad chos gsal bar bshad/ 'khodzo ra ba la sdug ldog gi rnam gzhag bstan pa ste gsum mo/ /nga/nga po la yang gsum gyi do/na chan dang po ngo bo ngos bzung ba ni/ rgyu rgyud kyi ngo bo sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba dang po'i sangs rgyas dang / don dam rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos dang / bde gshegs snying po'i ming gis bsnyad pa/sa dod ma nas bde stong zung du 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi sems nyid 'di kho na yin la/ spyir sems la dbye na 'khor ba'i sems dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i sems zhes bya ba gnyis su 'gyur te/ de gnyis rim pas kun rdzob pa'i sem/sa dang don dam pa'i sems su yang 'gyur ro/ /de dag kho na la gnas skabs mang por rim pas sem/sa dang / sems nyid ces so sor brda' sbyar bar mdzad de/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i sems dngos ni don dam dang /—4—

myang 'das kyi sems dang / sems sems nyid gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i sems nyid do/ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang / sems byung lnga bcu rtsa gcig la sogs pa glo bur gyi dri ma'i sems ni 'khor ba dang / kun rdzob kyi sems dang / sems sems nyid gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i sems so/ /don dam gyi sems ni chos dbyings dang zung 'jug gi sems kyang yin la/ gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu kun rdzob kyi sems la yang rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba dang / sems nyid dang /ye shes la sogs pa'i brdas bstan pa srid kyang / dpe tsam du 'gyur ba'i phyogs 'dra ba la dgongs pa dang / dgos pa'i khyad par 'ga' zhig gzigs nas bstan pa yin pas dngos ma yin te btags pa tsam mo/ /don tshan gnyis pa de la sgrub byed kyi lung dgod pa ni/ sems gnyis po'i ngos 'dzin/ dpal dri ma med pa'i 'od las/ de ltar snyen ra ba'i sems gyi rang bzhin gyi sad pa la sogs pa'i dbye ba rnam pa bzhir nges pa'o/ /zhes dang /gang gi phyi 'khor ba'i bag chags las grol ba'i sems kyi chos nyid yin pa de'i phyir/ gang sems yod pa'i sems de ni sems ma yin no/ /zhes 'khor ba'i sems dang bral ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i sems gzhan yod pa ni rdo rje can gyi ming gis bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so/ /zhes pa ste/ gnas skabs bzhi'i sems ni 'khor ba'i sems dang / dri ma rnams las gdod nas grol ba'i sems ni myang 'das kyi sems so/ /yang 'ga' zhig 'di ltar sems par 'gyur te/ 'khor ba'i sems ni de kho na yin yang myang 'das kyi sems ni bag chags las grol ba'i sems kyi chos nyid ces gsungs pas dag pa gnyis —5—

ldan gyi rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos dbyings ye shes la brjod kyi/ sems can gyi sems la ngos bzung du mi rung ngo / /zhes pa 'di'o/ /de la brjod pa/de ltar ma yin te/ gong du drangs pa'i lung de las rdo rje can gyi ming gi zhes pa'i bshad bya rtsa ba'i tshig ni/ de dag dbus su rdo rje can ni rang bzhin min zhing rnam 'gyur min te khyab byed rang bzhin med/ /ces dang / de'i 'grel par yang sa la sogs pa 'di dag gi dbus su rdo rje can ni rang bzhin min zhing rnam 'gyur min te zhes myang 'das kyi sems ni sa sogs la gnas par bshad cing /yang de nyid las/ sa la sogs pa ni rang bzhin dang rnam 'gyur zhes bya ba ma dag pa 'khor ba'i phung po la sogs pa yin no zhes sa sogs 'khor bar bshad pas 'khor ba'i chos kyi chos nyid dam/ 'khor ba pa rnams kyi sems rang bzhin 'od gsal yin par gsal bar grub bo/ /de bzhin du rgyud las/ bum pa'i nang du chu ni len par byed pa na yang nam mkha' 'gro ba min pa ji lta bar/ /mkha' khyab mkha' yi rdo rje can ni yul dang rnam par bral ba lus kyi dbus su de bzhin nyid/ /ces dang / de'i 'grel par yang mya ngan las 'das pa'i sems 'khor ba las 'das pa thams cad kyi las la gnas pa ni gang gis kyang ma bcings shing ma grol ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pas kyang shin tu gsal lo/ /don tshan gsum pa brgal lan gyis gtan la 'bebs pa ni/ yang 'di ltar sems par 'gyur te/ 'dir myang 'das kyi sems zhes bya ba yang rang bzhin gyi myang 'das tsam la dgongs pa yin pas myang 'das dngos ma yin la/—6—

de yang 'khor ba'i sems kho na rang bzhin gyi ma grub pa tsam mam/ bden par med pa tsam yin gyi/ rnam shes dang ye shes kyi dbye ba mi 'thad do snyam na/ rdo rje can gyi brdas bstan pas kyang ye shes yin par grub cing / 'khor ba'i sems las gzhan par bshad pas/ de gnyis shes pa ngo bo tha dad pa yin no/ /rang bzhin myang 'das ni yin mod kyi/ myang 'das dngos ma yin no/ /snyam na/ de nyid kyis mya ngan las 'das pa dngos yin par grub ste/ rang bzhin myang 'das ni myang 'das kyi gtso bo yin la/ slo bur gyi dri ma lam gyis spangs pa'i myang 'das ni rnam grangs pa'i myang 'das tsam yin no/ /de'i rgyu mtshan dang po ni/rang bzhin myang 'das ni dngos po'i gnas lugs yin la/ slo bur dri spangs kyi myang 'das ni kun rdzob rgyu rkyen tshogs pa tsam gyi rten 'brel las snang ba yin pa'i phyir dang / rgyu mtshan gnyis pa ni rang bzhin myang 'das rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi dmigs pa'i yul yin pa dang / glo bur gyi de ni rjes thob dag pa'i spyod yul yin pa'i phyir dang / rgyu mtshan gsum pa ni/ sangs rgyas rang snang la rang bzhin rnam par dag par gzigs shing / glo bur gyi de las gdul bya gzhan snang kho na 'byung ba'i phyir dang / rgyu mtshan bzhi pa ni/ kun rdzob 'khor ba'i chos thams cad gdod ma nas yod ma myong bas rang bzhin rnam dag de sangs rgyas kyis gzigs shing / sgrib pa sngar yod dang phyis spangs pa gnyis char gzigs rgyu med pas/ slo bur gyi de sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyis ma gzigs pa'i phyir dang / rgyu mtshan lnga pa ni/ rang bzhin myang 'das ni gdod ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi skabs su gnas la/ de'i phyir rang —7—

bzhin rnam dag 'di glo bur rnam dag la bltos pa med cing / rang bzhin rnam dag yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis lam bsgoms pas glo bur rnam dag tu 'gyur gyi/rang bzhin gyis ma dag na lam bsgoms kyang glo bur rnam dag tu mi 'gyur bas/glo bur rnam dag gi myang 'das ni rang bzhin myang 'das la nges par bltos pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang myang 'das kyi ngo bo ni rang bzhin myang 'das kho na yin la/glo bur rnam dag gi myang 'das ni thabs sgom pa po dang / thabs goms pa'i skyes bu rnams kyi blo ngor dri ma spangs tshul dang / yon to rtogs tshul gyi blo'i snang ba tsam du zad do/ /'jam dpal gyi lta 'dod mdor bstan las kyang /bsod nams phung pos sangs rgyas khyod/ /ston pa'i sku dang spyod pa ste/ /sdig pa'i phung pos sangs rgyas khyod/ /ngan pa rul pa'i lus nyid do/ /zhes kyang gsungs te/ gzhan snang du sangs rgyas kyi sku dang mdzad pa ston pa'i chos nyid dang / sems can rnams la 'khor ba'i lus su snang ba'i chos nyid ngo bo gcig cing sangs rgyas su bshad la/ rdzogs ma rdzogs dang rgyu 'bras dang bzang ngan gyi dbye ba gang yang ma mdzad pas so/ /gnyis pa ni de lta bu'i rgyu rgyud sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal de rang bzhin gnas rigs dang / bde gshegs snying po dang / bdag gi de kho na nyid dang / don dam byang chub kyi sems dang / don dam pa'i byang chub dang / don dam pa'i sangs rgyas zhes kyang bya zhing / de nyid kyi ngo bo cha med kun 'a sbyo kun khyab yin yang / re zhig ldog chas phye ba'i rnam ga theg byas na/ rgyu rgyud rang bzhin 'od gsal de nyid sku dang gsung dang thugs dang ye shes kyi thig le ste 8—

thig le bzhi'i ngo bor gnas shing / de ltar gnas pa'i go don yang lus ngag yid ye shes kyi dwangs ma dang chos nyid yin pa'i phyir thig le zhes bya zhing / chos nyid de yang kun rdzob kyi snang ba ma yin mod/ don dam pa'i lus ngag yid ye shes kyi snang ba mtha' yas pa can yin pa'i phyir/ spyir snang med du mi 'jog go /de ltar thig le bzhi po de nyid 'bras dus kyi sku bzhi'am rdo rje'i bzhi'i rgyu rgyud yin zhes bya la/ zhib mor na gzhi 'bras dbye ba med pa yin pa'i phyir/thig le bzhi po de nyid sku bzhi yin kyang sems can rnams la thig le bzhi cam las 'phros pa'i snang ba 'byung ba'i phyir rgyu rgyud du 'jog la/ sangs rgyas rnams la sa bzhi'i snang ba gtso bor 'gyung ba'i phyir 'bras rgyud du 'jog pa yin zhing /thabs rgyud la'ang des rigs 'gre'o/ /de ltar na skabs 'dir chos nyid de don dam pa'i rgyu yang yin/ don dam pa'i 'bras bu yang yin la/ kun rdzob rgyu 'bras gang yang ma yin mod/ sems can rnams kyi shes ngor rgyu'i tha snyad 'jug tu rung zhing / sangs rgyas rnams la shes ngor 'bras bu'i tha snyad don mthun du 'jug go /zhes pa dang / don dam pa'i snang ba can te sems can thams cad la gnas pa yin yang lam ma bsgoms pa rnams la snang ba de mi snang ngo / /zhes dang / de rnams don dam pa'i thig le yin pa'i phyir mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba'ang yin la/ don dam dus kyi 'khor lo'i zhal bzhi dngos kyang thig le bzhi po 'di yin zhing / gzhi 'khor ba'i chos la dgongs te/ gnas skabs bzhi la bshad pa ni thig le 'di rnams kyi dri ma yin pa la dgongs so/ /zhes pa rnams grub don no/ /de ltar na chos nyid dang / snang bcas dang/ rgyu rgyud dang / gzhi 'bras —9—

dbyer med sogs thig le bzhi la bshad pa'i skabs 'dis rigs bsgres te/gzhan rnams la yang rtogs par bya zhing / don dam dbyings de khams lnga'i dwangs ma yin pa'i phyir stong pa chen po yi ge lnga zhes brjod de/ de ni ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rgyu rgyud yin la/ phung po drug gam 'byung ba drug gi dwangs ma yin pa'i phyir thig le stong pa 'gyur med drug ces bya ste/ rgyal ba rigs drug dang / yum drug gi rgyu rgyud dang / rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi chos nyid yin pa'i phyir dang / rlung 'pho ba bcu gnyis kyi dwangs ma yin pa'i phyir bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis rtogs pa'i ye shes chos sku'i rgyu rgyud dang / thig le 'pho ba bcu drug gi chos nyid yin pa'i phyir don dam pa'i dga' ba bcu drug kyang yin la/ de nyid rnam pa bcu drug mkhyen pa'i ye shes bcu drug dang/ sku bcu drug gi rgyu rgyud kyang yin rno zhes shes par bya'o/ /de dag las stong pa chen po zhes bya ba la/rang gi ngo bos ma grub pa tsam gyi stong nyid ni stong pa tsam yin yang chen po ma yen la/ chen po'i sgras stong pa de nyid ye shes yin par yang bstan zhing / thig le stong pa zhes brjod pas bde ba'i thig le de nyid gzung 'dzin kyi spros pa dang bral bar yang bstan no/ /'gyur med ces bya ba ni mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes su go dgos shing / yi ge lnga zhes bya ba la sogs pa yi ge'i sgras bstan na/ gsung gzhom med kyi nā da la 'jug pas gnyis ka ltar yang mi 'gal lo/ /gsum pa ni/ ji skad du/ mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas las/ /chags sogs dri ma ldan pa'i sems/ /'gyur ba 'khor ba'i rgyu yin te/ /de dang bral pas rnam par dag /rang bzhin dri med dag pa'o/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa lhas —1/)—

kyang / sde/ bzhin rang bzhin sems 'di yang / /rtog pa'i tshon gyis bsgyur ba nyid/ /tha mal rtog pa'i tshon gyis ni/ /rin chen sems ni dben gyur na/ /thog ma nas dag ma skyes pa/ /gnyug/ ma'i rang bzhin dri ma med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar spros bral gyi sems nyid 'di mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen dang / rnam kun mchog snyeldan gyi stong nyid dbyer mi phyed pa'i zung 'jug gi ye shes su gnas pa yin yang / chags spre snang / snyegs 'khru/la pa'i snang bas sems rgyud bsgribs nga/ra gyur pa'i sem/sa can rnams la ni 'kho ra ba 'jug par 'gyur zhing / 'khru'/ pa de nyid rang bzhin med pa'i gnas la zhugs te rang sangs la 'gro ba'i skabs ni 'khor ba ldog pa zhes bya'o/ /de la chos can 'khor ba'i ngo bo ni/ gnas skabs bzhi dang phung po drug dang khams drug dang dbang po drug dang yul drug dang las dbang drug dang las dbang gi bya ba drug rnams yin la/ 'jam dpal gyi lta 'dod mdor bstan las kyang / bde dang sdug bsngal nyer spyod pa/ /rtag tu kun rdzob 'khor ba'o/ /zhes kyang gsungs so/ /'khor ba ldog pa'i chos nyid ni/ rdo rje bzhi dang / rgyal ba rigs drug dang / yum drug dang / don dam nga 'i sems dpa' drug dang / lha mo drug dang / khro bo'i dbang po drug dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma drug go /de ltar na don tshan dang po 'khor ba 'jug ldog gi ngo bo bstan pa'o//'khor ba'i gnas skabs kyi dri ma de phyis dag 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan yang /ji skad du dbang mdor bstan las/ sems la glo bur dri ma med/ /sems las yun ring dus can min/ /sems med par ni skye ba med/ /sems la rmi zad —11—

gnas pa min/ /zhes dam bca'i tshul du mdor bstan nas/ gal te 'di nyid glo bur ba/ /de tshe sngon du sems dri med/ /gang tshe sems las dus ring can/ /de tshe de ni ci las skyes/ /gal te sems med par skye na/ /de tshe nam mkha'i me tog bzhin/ /gal te sems la rtag tu gnas/ /de tshe kun tu thar pa min/ /zhes 'thad pa bkod pa'i tshul gyis rgyas bar bshad/ ji ltar zangs kyi dri ma ni/ /ro yi sbyor bas nyam par 'gyur/ /de bzhin sems kyi dri ma ni/ /stong nyid sbyor bas rnam nyam 'gyur/ /zhes rang bzhin la glo bur gyi dri ma spong pa'i tshul gsal bar gsungs pa ltar te/ sems sngon dri ma med pa las phyis dri ma gsar du byung ba ma yin te/ de lta bu 'byung srid na sgrib gnyis spangs zin pa'i rjes su slar yang skye srid par thal bar 'gyur/ sems nyid med pa'i sngon rol nas chags sogs yod pa'ang mi srid de/ srid na chags sogs rgyu med du thal bar 'gyur/ chags sogs de sems med par yang mi skye ste/ skye na nam mkha' las kyang me tog skye bar 'gyur te/ rang gi gnas med par skye ba mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /dri ma dang sems ngo bo gcig pa'am mi gcig kyang 'bral mi rung ma yin te/ yin na sems dri ma dang bral ba'i thar pa mi srid par 'gyur ro/ /des na sems dang chags sogs gser dang g.ya' bzhin du sngon gcig grub tsam na gcig shos kyang grub pas rtag tu 'grogs pa yin mod kyang / dri ma de sems kyi ngo bo nam yang ma yin pa'i phyir dri ma spangs kyang sems nyid mi zad de/ dri ma spangs pa'i sems thar par 'gyur ro/ /dper na lcags sam zangs kyi dngos po tsam dang / de'i kha dog nag pa'am dmar ba dang / gyong zhing sra ba'i mtshan —12—

nyid rnams dang po nas rtag tu 'grogs shing dbye ba mi phyed pa lta bur snang yang lcags zangs kyi dngos po tsam ni de dag gi ngo bor med pas gser 'gyur rtsi'i ro bcud kyis btsos pa na kha dog nag dmar mi mdzes pa dang / gyong zhing sra ba'i dngos po ni nyam kyang lcags zangs nyid kyi dngos po ni mi nyam ste/ dag pa'i gser kha dog bzang zhing rang bzhin mnyen par 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /de ltar na 'khor ba 'jug pa dang ldog pa gnyis kar 'thad do/ /don tshan gnyis pa 'khor ba 'jug ldog rung ba'i rgyu mtshan bshad pa'o/ /de la 'khor ba 'jug pa'i rnam gzhag mdo tsam bshad na/ gong du bstan pa'i thig le bzhi po ni chos nyid yin la/ de nyid kyi g.ya' lta bu glo bur gyi dri ma ni gnas skabs bzhi'i bag chags yin zhing de las 'khor ba'i chos thams cad 'byung ba yin no/ /de yang sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba de ni kun gzhi ye shes dang / mi shigs pa'i thig le dang / gzhom du med pa dang /'od gsal dang / a thung gi brdas bstan pa yin zhing / dpal dri ma med pa'i 'od las/ 'dir sems can rnams kyi snying gi nang na gnas pa ni ye shes so//de yang gzhom du med pa'i sgra ste rtag tu nā da'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes gsungs shing 'dir snying gi nang na gnas pa zhes pa ni snying por gnas pa ste chos nyid kyi don yin la/ de nyid thig le bzhi dang yon tan brgyad kyi dwangs mar gnas pa'i rten 'brel las de nyid dang 'dres pa ltar snang ba'i slo bur gyi dri ma kun gzhi rnam shes kyi ngo bo gnas skabs 'gar rtsa ba'i ma rig pa chen po zhes kyang bya la/de la yang ldog chas phye na gnas skabs bzhi'i bag chags sogs yod cing /—/3—

de'i rang snang las gnas skabs bzhi'i snang ba dang rnam rtog mngon 'gyur ba rnams 'char ba dang / mun rdul snying stobs gsum sgra reg ro gzugs dri ste yon tan brgyad 'byung zhing / de dag las kyang khams dang phung po dbang po las dbang dang bcas pa rnams 'byung ngo / /ye shes de'i bzhon pa ni de nyid dang ngo bo gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rlung yin la/ rtsa ba'i ma rig pa de'i bzhon pa yang phra mo'i rlung yin te/ rtsa ba'i ma rig pa rlung dang bcas nga/ 'di la yang skebs 'ga' zhig tu ye shes dang / de'i rlung gi ming btags pa ni/ 'bras kyi sprun pa la 'bras kyi ming btags pa dang mtshungs shing / dgos pa ni sprun pa dang ma bral ba'i 'bras kyi gnas lugs go dgos pa ltar dri bcas de bzhin nyid gtan la 'bebs pa'i phyir yin no/ /grub chen yu mo la sogs pa gong ma rnams kyi gsung gi rtsa ba'i ma rig pa de las rlung gi mtshan nyid can gnyis 'byung ba las dga' ba'i rlung gis bzhi pa'i gnas skabs bskyed la/ lhan cig skyes pa'i rlung gis sad pa dang / rmi lam dang gnyid 'thug po'i gnas skabs gsum bskyed do/ /zhes gsungs te ma rig pa de las bem chos kyi rlung skye pa'i don ma yin gyi/ de nyid rlung de'i ngo bor gnas shing rlung yin pa'i cha nas gnas skabs bzhi'i rnam rtog skye ba'i don la dgongs so/ /de las rlung bcu dang / de las dus sbyor bcu gnyis kyi rlung dang / de dag gis yul lnga 'dzin pa'i dbang shes lnga dang / de'i rjes su 'brang ba'i yid kyi rnam par shes pa dang / bdag la dmigs pa'i nyon mongs pa can gyi yid dang / yid gnyis kyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i rlam par rtog pa mtha' med du 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang ye shes —14—

de ni dkar dmar rlung gsum gyi dwangs ma chos nyid yin nga/'i phyir/ de'i dri ma'i tshul gyi rtsa ba'i ma rig pa de yang dkar dmar rlung gsum phra ba'i ngo bor gnas shing rags pa rnams bskyed pa'i sa bon yin no/ /ye shes de ni brtan g.yo kun la kun khyab yin pa bzhin du rtsa ba'i ma rig pa de yang 'khor ba'i chos kun gyi rten dang gzhi dang 'khrul snang kun la khyab pa'i tshul can yin mod kyi/ re zhig sems can so sor re re'i snang ba dang bstun nas skyes bu'i lus la khyab pa'i tshul gyis gnas so zhes brjod cing / rdo rje lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs kyi gzhi rtogs pa'i phyir snying ga'i 'khor lo'i dbus su dkar dam/ra kha sbyor gyi nang na rlung dang drod phra mo'i rang bzhin can gnas pa la ma rig pa phra mo de chos nyid dang bcas te gnas so zhes pa lta bur bshad nga/ dang / dkar dmar kha sbyor rlung dang bcas pa de la mi shigs pa'i thig ler yang btags shing / de bzhin du rtsa 'khor gzhan dang gzhan la de lta bu sbyar ba mang ste/ de dag la gnad du bsnun pas dri ma sbyong ba dang / lam gyi ye shes khyad nga/ra can skye ba'i rkyen byed pa la dgongs pa yin no/ /de yang thig le bzhi dang ru ri bre la ba'i gnas skabs bzhi'i bag chags ni shes pa kho na yin nga/'i phyir lus kyi cha shas so so la gnas pa ma yin mod kyang dpral ba'i ri rlung thig le'i byed pa las sad pa'i gnas skabs kyi bag chags sad de/ /sad dus kyi snang ba rags pa rnam/ rtog dang bcas pa mngon 'gyur du 'byung ba yin la/ de bzhin du mgrin pa'i snyelas rmi lam dang / snying ga'i las gnyid 'thug dang / lte ba'i las bzhi pa'i gnas skabs kyi bag chags sad de chags rtogs gi snang ba rags pa rnam/ rtog dang —15—

bcas pa mngon 'gyur du 'byung bas na 'khor lo bzhi dang / rdo rje bzhi dang /gnas skabs bzhi rnams sbyar ba yin no/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ ye shes rnam shes sbyor ba las/ /lte ba'i dbus na gnas pa'i sems/ / srog gi yon tan brgyad kyis bcings/ /bdag skyes rnams kyi dar srin bzhin/ /sad dang rmi lam gnyid log skabs/ /rnam gsum ye shes dbye ba las/ /srog chags rnams kyi zhal gsum sems/ /bzhi pa'i dus la zhal bzhi'o/ /zhes dang / lte ba'i dbus na thig le dang / /tsheg drag de dag kha sbyor la/ /rnam shes ye shes sbyor ba yi/ /byang chub sems ni rnam par gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa las/ thig le ni byang chub kyi sems dkar cha yin la/ tsheg drag ni me ste dmar cha'o/ /rnam shes ye shes sbyor ba zhes bya ba ni chos nyid de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po kun gzhi ye shes la rtsa ba'i ma rig pa kun gzhi rnam shes kyis g.yog pa'i ming ngo / /des na kun gzhi rnam shes de la dkar dmar rlung gsum gyi bag chags sa bon gyi tshul du gnas pa de'i skabs kyang rlung gi mthu las rnam par rtog pa'i mtshan nyid can gti mug gi rang bzhin dang / dmar cha rdul gyi bag chags las chags shing gdung ba'i mtshan nyid can dang / snying stobs dkar cha'i bag chags las zhi zhing g.yo ba 'dzag bcas kyi bde ba'i mtshan nyid du gnas pas/ rtsa ba'i ma rig pa de ni dug gsum gyi rang bzhin dang rnam pas byin gyis brlabs pa 'gyur ba'i bde ba dang / 'pho ba'i bag chags dang /'dzag bde'i sems zhes brjod pa yin la/ de nyid la rlung g.yo ba dang rnam —/6—

rtog mngon 'gyur ba bskyed pa dang / 'dzag bde'i dga' ba bcu drug dang / rten 'brel bcu gnyis rnams rags pa mngon 'gyur ba bskyed pa'i nus pa yod la/sa bon gyi dus nyid nas rags pa mngon 'gyur ba med kyang rlung rnam rtog dga' ba rten 'brel rnams phra ba'i mtshan nyid rnams dngos su yod pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i rtsa ba'i ma rig pa de nyid rags pa'i lus dang 'brel ba las khyad par 'dod khams pa gtso bor gyur pa'i 'khor ba 'jug tshul ni 'di ltar yin te/gzugs khams dang gzugs med khams la'ang phra rags kyi khyad par ma gtogs phal cher 'dra'o/ /de yang dkar dmar rlung gsum gyi bag chags las rlung gi nus pa sad de 'pho ba bcu gnyis kyi rlung rgyu bar 'gyur la/ des dmar cha g.yo zhing 'bar bar 'gyur/ des dkar cha rnams yongs su zhu bar byed/ rlung g.yo ba dang dmar cha 'bar ba dang dkar cha zhu ba gsum gyi spyi thun mong du rnam rtog sna tshogs skye zhing sngon gyi las kyis 'phangs pa'i sa bon gzhan rnams sad pas rang gzhan snod bcud kyi snang ba sna tshogs 'char/ las 'phen byed kyi nyon mongs sna tshogs skye/ da dung nyon mongs te rlung dang bcas pa lhag par 'phel bas skye ba 'phen 'gyur gyi las gsog cing / las de la'ang gnyis te/ thun mong gi las kyis skye ba gzhan du snod kyi 'jig rten gtso bor 'grub la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i las kyis sems can rang rang gi lus dang longs spyod la sogs pa 'grub bo/ /snod bcud de thams cad kyang phung khams skye mched du 'dus so/ /de ltar yang rtsa rgyud las/ rnam shes ye shes sbyor ba yis/ /lnga drug yul gyi bdag nyid can/ /sems ni zhal lnga zhal drug pa/ /—17—

sems min sems kyi gzung bya ste/ /zhes gsungs/ de dag ni don tshan gsum pa 'khor ba 'jug tshul spyir bshad pa'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i don de gsal bar brjod pa ni 'di ltar yin no/ /de yang 'dzag bde 'khor ba'i rtsa ba yin te/ gzugs med khams na nam mkha' dang / sgra khams kyi thig le 'gyur ba'i 'dzag bde dang/ gzugs khams na de'i steng du rlung dang reg bya/ me dang gzugs kyi de dag kyang yod/ 'dod lha rigs drug la chu dang ro'i de dang / mi dang dud 'gro sogs la sa dang dri'i khams kyi thig le 'gyur ba'i 'dzag bde yang yod pas mi'i rten la ni 'byung ba lnga dang/ yon tan lnga char tshang ba'i 'dzag bde rags pa'i mthar thug pa yod cing / de 'ching du rung ba'i nus pa mthar thug pa'ang yod pas rten 'di la lhag par bsngags pa yin no/ /gzugs dang gzugs med kyi khams na 'dzag bde phra mo dngos kyang yod la rags pa'i bag chags dang sa bon yod pas/ slar 'dod khams kyi mngal skyes su skye ba dang/ gzugs khams dang gzugs med kyi khams nyid du yang nying mtshams sbyor te/ rang rang gi phung po dang ting nge 'dzin la chags pa 'byung ba yang khams de dag nyid kyi 'dzag bde'i rnam 'gyur yin no/ /de bzhin du/ dri dang gnas la mngon 'dod gzhan/ zhes gzhan las 'byung ste/ 'dod khams kyi rdzus skyes gnas la sred pa dang / drod gsher skyes dri la sred pa 'dzag bde'i rnam 'gyur du shes par bya'o/ /de thams cad la mtshungs par rlung gis dmar cha sbar bas thig le zhu ba na/ 'dzag bde'i dga' ba bcu drug rim gyis 'char zhing / re re yang dga' ba nyam/ pa'i mtshan nyid can —/8—

yin pas zhe sdang dang gti mug phra mo re yod la/ khyad par bcu drug pa'i mthar khams 'gyu/ra zhing 'dzag pas chags pa dang bral nas zhe sdang dang / chags sdang gnyis kyis sems 'khrugs pas rmongs par 'gyur zhing / de gsum 'dzom pas sngar gyi dug gsum gyi bag chags lhag par stobs su 'gyur la/ de ni ma rig pa'i rten 'brel la lhag par spyod pa'i skabs yin zhing / des las bsags pas 'du byed kyi rten 'brel sogs gzhan rnams 'gyung ste/ srid pa'i 'khor lo bar ma chad du 'khor ba yin la/ rten 'brel tshar gcig gi 'phen pa zad mtshams su 'chi 'pho ba yin zhing / de yang rlung sems rags pa rnams 'gags rjes 'khor ba pa rnams thabs mkhas dang bral ba yin pa'i phyir dmar po steng du lhag par 'bar bas thig le dkar po lhag ma med par zhu/ chus me bsad pa'i tshul gyis dmar po'i nus pa rtsa ba nas nyam/ dkar dmar kha sbyor zhig pa'i mtshams nas skye ba gzhan 'grub 'gyur gyi las kyi mthu las rlung bskyod pa dang lhan cig sems gzhan du 'pho'o/ /de ma thag dkar dmar rlung gsum dang lams lnga phra mo dang bcas pa'i bar do 'grub la/ des mngal gzung ba sogs skye ba'i srid pa blangs pa na rtsa ba'i ma rig pa sa bon gyi gnas skabs can de tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum rags pa phung khams skye mched kyis bsdus pa len par 'gyur zhing / gong du bshad pa ltar 'pho ba bcu gnyis kyi rlung g.yos pas 'dzag bde gsar pa skye ba la sogs par 'gyur ro/ /'di dag kyang /mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes grub par/ ma rig pa ni 'dir thog ma med pa'i 'dod chags kyi bag chags so/ /des 'dod chags rab tu 'jug ste 'dod spre/9—

chags las kyang 'gyur ba'o/ /'gyur ba las chags pa dang bral ba ste chags pa dang bral ba las kyang zhe sdang ngo / /zhe sdang gi bdag nyid ni brgyal ba ste brgyal ba zhes bya ba ni gti mug go /de ltar na 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gi bdag nyid ni ma rig pa ste/ nam mkha'i me tog gi phreng ba ni ma yin no/ /ma rig pa zhes bya ba ni nyon mongs pa'o/ /ma rig pa las 'du byed de 'du byed las rnam par shes pa ste sdug bsngal ba'o zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs shing /mdor bsdu na/ 'dzag bde'i bag chags kyi sems las khu rdul rlung gsum mngon du 'gyur/ de gsum gyis da lta'i lus ngag yid gsum bskyed/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi rtsa rlung thig le'i snang ba las phyi 'jig rten khams kyi snang ba sna tshogs shar/ nang bag chags kyi nus pa khu rdul rlung gsum gyi rnam par shar ba'i nyer len dang / phyi rol snang ba rang lus dang bcas pa'i yul dang 'phrad pa'i rkyen gnyis 'dzom pa las slar yang nyon mongs skyes nas las bsags pas skye ba gzhan 'phen zhing / sngar yod pa'i nyon mongs pa'i bag chags de stobs dang ldan par byas nas ma 'ongs pa na nyon mongs sna tshogs skye ba'i rgyu yang byed do/ /des na 'khor bar 'khyams pa thams cad rang sems las byung ba'i nyon mongs kyis sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin can gyi 'khor ba bsgrubs pa yin pas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bskyed pa po gzhan na med pas dar kyi srin bu rang nyid kyi kha chus bcings pa bzhin no/ /de dag ni don wo bzhi pa 'khor ba ji ltar bskyed pa'i tshul lo/ /de nas 'khor ba ldog pa'i tshul bshad na/ de ltar 'khor bar 'khyams —2()—

pa'i tshul de thams cad kyang gnas lugs la yod cing bden par grub pa ma yin gyi/ med bzhin du snang ba'i 'khrul pa yin no/ /'khrul pa de yang rnam par rtog pa tsam yin la/ rnam par rtog pa de yang bag chags yod pa'i mthu dang /las rlung rgyu ba'i rkyen gyis bskyed pa yin te de'i gnyen por mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyis las rlung dgag dgos pa yin no/ /de yang chos nyid la mngon sum pa'i snang ba can gyi mi rtog ye shes kyis 'gyur bde'i bag chags spongs la/las rlung bkag pas ni dkar dmar gyi tshogs pa rang sar dengs nas 'dzag bde bcu drug dang / rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi rim pa de rnams 'gag par 'gyur ro/ /las nyon sdug bsngal sngar gyi rgyun rnams dngos su 'gags shing /rnam rtog spang pas slar skye bar yang mi 'gyur la/ srid par las nyon gyi skye ba zad par 'gyur ro/ /de ni med bzhin du snang ba'i 'khrul pa'i 'khor lo rang sangs su song ba tsam na thar pa ste/ sngar yod bden pa po bsal rgyu dang/ sngar med khyad par can bzhag rgyu med te/ de ltar yang dri med 'od las/ nge'i phyir bdud ces bya ba ni sems can rnams kyi 'khor ba'i sems kyi bag chags kyi dri ma'o/ /sangs rgyas nyid ces bya ba ni 'khor ba'i sems kyi bag chags dang bral ba'i sems so/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs so/ /de ltar na kun rdzob sems can gyi gang zag ni rnam shes 'khor ba'i chos mtha' dag dang bcas pa'i rgyun tsam yin la/ de nyid la don dam ye shes kyi sangs rgyas rtag tu bzhugs pa'i phyir/ rgyud las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas yin te sangs rgyas chen po gzhan 'dir 'jig rten khams na yod ma yin/ /zhes sogs —21—

——snye——snye———— rderderderde —snye—rdegasungs shing / rgyud kyi rgyal po gzhan/ dang / mdo sde rnam/sa las kyang rgya cher gsungs so/ /don 'di rgyas par lam dang 'bras bu bstan pas shes par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa rgyu rgyud/ la log rtog sel ba dngos dang / /sna phras don no/ /dang po ni/ mkhas pa 'ga' zhig skabs 'dir gnas skabs bzhi'i dri ma dang / ma dag pa'i khams drug dang / las rlung 'pho ba bcu gnyis dang/ 'gyur bde'i dga' ba bcu drug rnams 'bras bu'i rdo rje bzhi la sogs pa'i rgyu rgyud dngos yin zhes gsungs shing / spyir yang rdo rje rtse mo las/ rgyud ni rgyun chags zhes bya ste/ /'bor ba rgyud du 'dod pa yin/ zhes pa'i dgongs par byas nas 'kho/ra ba nyid rgyu rgyud du bzhed do/ /'on kyang rnam gzhag 'di legs pa ma yin te/gnas skabs bzhi sogs 'kho/rder ba'i chos rnams ni spang bya kho na yin pas sa/ngas rgyas kyi rgyu grung por mi rung la/ 'kho ra ba spangs pa'i tshe rgyun chad pas gzhi lam 'bras gsum du rgyun chags par yang mi rung ba'i phyir dang / rdo rje rtse cho/'i lung nge yang rgyu thabs 'bras bus bsdus pa'i rgyud gsum gyi rnam gzhag 'chang/ pa 'i skabs ma yin pa'i phyir dang / 'kho/ra ba'i rang bzhin la bsam pa yin na rang bzhin sde/ 'bor ba ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang bod mang po zhig ni/rgyu rgyud 'khor ba'i chos nyid yin la 'khe/ra ba rang bzhin med tsam de 'khe/ra ba'i chos nyid yin no/ /zhes smra ba ni mi 'thad pa chen po ste/ med par dgag pa'i mtshan nyid can dngos med de ni rgyu dngos kyang ma yin la/ rgyur 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yang med pa'i phyir dgos pa dang ldan pa'i btags pa nga/ra yang mi rung —22—

— ngo / /rang bzhin med tsam de ni thams cad la spyi khyab yin pa'i phyir/ 'bor ba /bo na'i steng du gnas pa mi srid na/ 'khor ba kho na la rang bzhin med pa'i sgra sbyar ba don med pa dang / 'bras bu'i sangs rgyas kyang 'khor ba rang bzhin med pa yin pas khyed la rgyu rgyud du thal bar 'gyur zhing / de ltar 'dod pa yang ma yin pa'i phyir dang / dngos med la rgyun chags pa'i don dngos dang phyogs mthun gang yang ma tshang ba'i phyir dang / 'khor ba kho na la gnas pa'i rang bzhin med pa zhig kyang yod do snyam na de lta bu'i chos de ji ltar yin zhes rnam par dpyad pas de 'dra shes bya la mi srid par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /yang 'ga' zhig rgyu rgyud rnam pa gnyis te/ med dgag gi mtshan nyid can gyi stong nga/ de ni rgyu rgyud kyi gtso bo yin zhing gnas lugs mthar thug kyang yin la/ rang rig tsam gyi ye shes shig kyang khas ni len zhing / de gnas skabs kyi chos nyid dang / gnas lugs phal pa tsam yin zhing / snga ma gtan la dbab bya dang / bsgom bya'i gtso bo yin yang phyi ma yang bsgom zhing gtan la 'bebs dgos te/ gnas lugs spros pa nyer zhi'i rnam pa can gzhi zag med kyi sems dang 'brel ba de kun gzhi ye shes yin zhing gzhi dus na yod cing / de lhan skyes kyi bde chen du gnas pa sangs rgyas kyi thugs kyi nyer len dang / stong gzugs longs sku'i rnam nga/ dang ldan pa zhig gzhi dus nas yod pa ni gzugs kyi sku'i nyer len yin la/ de dag rtag pa dngos min zhing rigs pa'i dpyad bzod kyi bden grub min yang /rgyun gyi rtag pa dang dgos pa'i don la mi bslu ba'i bden pa yin no/ /de sgom pa'i tshul yang spros bral gyi yul la las dang po pas de dang mthun nga/'i 'dzin —23—

——— —gostangs dgos pas stong nyid ni 'dzin stangs kyi gzung bya dang / stong gzugs ni stong pa'i rlam nga/ can gyi snang yul yin no/ /'di ltar byas na 'khor lo bar mtha' gnyis dang / shing rta chen po gnyis kyang dgongs pa 'gal med du sgrub nus pas/ chos spong gi las spangs pa yin no zhes zer zhing / dpyod ldan chen po gzhan dang gzhan dag kyang 'di dang phyogs mthun du gsungs pa dag yod do/ /'di ni snga ma gnyis las legs kyang da dung mi 'thad pa snang ngo / /chos sku'i nyer len zag med kyi sems rgyun kho na la mi 'jog par spros pa nyer zhis khyad par du byas pa'i zag med kyi sems la 'jog pa ni rnam dpyad med pa'i tshig ste/ rang bzhin spros pa dang ma bral ba'i zag med kyi sems shig yod na de gcod pa'i phyir de skad brjod dgos pa bden kyang de 'dra mi srid pa'i phyir dang / zag med sems rgyud tsam de rgyu rgyud yin na ni spros pa dang bral tsam de rgyu rgyud kyi gtso bor bzhag pa shin tu 'gal ba'i phyir dang / spros pa dang bral tsam ni chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs yin par 'dod pa'i phyir zag med kyi sems kho na dang 'brel ba la dgos pa ci yang med pa'i phyir dang / khyed ltar na gdod nas grub pa'i stong gzugs de yang rang bzhin med pa'i phyir/ de'i rang bzhin med pa ni gzugs sku'i rgyur thal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / de yang 'dod na/ 'khor lo bar pa'i dngos bstan bstan byas gtso bo chos nyid med dgag de chos sku'i rgyu rgyud gtso bor bshad pa'i rang tshig dang 'gal ba'i phyir dang / dngos med la rgyu'i don dang rgyud kyi don gnyis ka ma tshang zhing ci yang ma yin pa ni dngos po'i khyad par gcig kho na la dam por sdod pa mi srid pa'i skyon —24—

—————rderde—————ba———— rde———na ri na risngar bshad pa yang 'dar 'jug nga/ dang / zag mad kya sams rgyun dang ma 'brel ba'i spros bral tsam gyi chos sku'i rgyu rgud du sno/ 'gyur 'ing / gdod ma'i stong gzugs dang ma 'brel ba'i spros bran sna/ yang gzugs sku'i rgyu rgyud du mi 'gyur na/ sku gnyis gang la yang rgyu'i don mi/ byed rnga/ nge rgyu rgyud kyi gco bor /bas len pa shin tu 'gasnye pa ba'i phyir dang / sgom pas 'ums su pen chul la/ bdag gnyis bkag pa'i 'dzin stangs can gyi rig shes nges par sngon du 'gro dgos par 'dod pa ni/ rgya bod kyi dbu ma'i gzhung smra ba po theg chen gyi grub mtha' bzung nas rtog ge la dga' ba rnams kyi lugs bo na yin pa'i phyir dang /rdzogs rim gtan la 'bebs pa'i skabs su snang dzil dang / zhen yul gyi tha snyad sbyor ba tshad ldan sus kyang ma bshad pa'i rtog bzor 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /des na 'di la grub mtha' mi 'dra ba gnyis bsres pa'i skyon chen po byung zhing / bod phal cher rtag pa dang / bden pa mi 'dod pa ni rung ba ma yin te/mdo rgyud rnams las/ rtag pa dang bden pa'i rnam gzhag mtha' yas pa gsungs pa'i phyir dang / klu'i zhabs kyi sgom rim du/ de ltar shes rab dag pa yis/ /rang gi ngo bo don dam 'di/ /shin tu yang ni grub pas na/ /brtags pa'i gzhan/ dngos 'byung ma yin/ /zhes pa dang / ar+sā de bas kyang / yod la med par 'khru/la dang mi rtag nyid du 'khra/la/ /med la yod par 'khru / la dang rtag pa nyid du 'khru / la/ /zhes dang / klu'i bshes gnyen gyi sku gsum du 'ju ga par yang /ngo bo nyid ni rnam gsum po/ /yongs su shes dang spangs dag pa'i/ /sku gsum po ni thob 'gyu ra te/ /de phyir de ni de yis bsdus/ /zhes dang / rgyud kyi rgyal po —25—

las kyang / gang dag sa la dpag bsam shing dang ro dang mchog gi ro dang sman dang ro yi dbang po gzhan/ /mtha' dag nad 'phrog rdul phran rnams kyi rab tu bskyed pa de rnams sems can rnams kyis mi mthong ste/ /gang zhig phal pa'i rtsa dang shing dang chu dang dwol dang rnge ba dang ni lcags rnams mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhes yod pa'i chos nyid mi mthong snyel/ med pa'i kun rdzob mthong bar gsungs so/ /mdo las kyang / byis pa rnams ni med pa'i chos la spyod/ /ces gsungs na/ chos nyid dang don dam pa yang gnas tshul la med na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyang med pa'i ches snyel spyed par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ byis pa kho na la ci'i phyir de ltar gsungs/ gzhan yang gnas lugs 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir rtag pa yin snyel/ ye shes ma 'khrul ba'i spyod yul yin pa'i phyir bden par grub pa yin no/ /gal te de bden par ma grub na theg chen 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes rdzun pa'i yul can du song bas 'khru kyil par thal ba dang / de mi rtag pa yin na 'phags pa rnams kyi rjes thob ye shes kyis de mi rtog par rtogs par thal ba dang / de las sdug bsngal gyi 'du shes 'jug par thal ba dang / 'dus byas yin pa'i phyir rgyu rkyen du ma las 'byung bar thal te/ rgyu med pa dang / rgyu gcig las dngos po gang yang 'byung ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /'di dag rgyas par logs su dpyad par bya ste/ 'dir yi ge mangs par 'gyur ba'i phyir bzhag go /de bzhin du rtsa ba'i ma rig pa la ye shes su 'dod pa dang / ma rig pa la gzhom med kyi tha snyad mdzad pa dang / gzhi'i dus na ye shes gtan nas med par 'dod pa dang / yang shin tu 'khra/la pa /ba cig /dpal ldan gsang 'dus las/spre2(kyi—

rdo rje 'chang gi sgrub gzhi shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems gdod nas rang chas su yod nga/ra gsungs shing / de'i lugs kyi lam la sgrub gzhi de je bzang du song ba yin par 'dod cing / dus kyi 'khor lo nas sgrub sa'i de 'dra ma gsungs shing lam gyis kyang de la gnad du mi bsnun nga/ra stong gzus/sa shig sngar med gsar du bsgrubs nas de las sangs rgyas 'gyung ba'i phyir dus 'khor snye pa sgrub gzhi meng/ zer ba dang / yang sor sdud kyi skabs dbu ma/'i ya/sa sna la gnad du bsnun dgos pa rgyu mtshan sku'i thig le la gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi snang ba sna tshogs su 'char thub pa'i nus / pa rang chas su yod pa sa de la sems gtad na stong gzugs 'char ba'i rgyu mtshan gyi yin zer ba sogs rbi/ sa ngas rgyas sgrub par byed nga/'i mthar thug gi lam mi 'dra ba gnyis su thal ba dang / rang tshig snga phyi dngos su 'gal ba'i phyir shin tu mi 'thad do/ /yang gzhan stong dbu ma sngags lugs su rlom pa kha cig /bde gshegs snying po'am gzhom med kyi thig le yungs 'bru tsam don dam par yod zer pa yang rdzun chos kyi kha skad blo la 'en nas gsang sngags zab mo ma go bar zad go /'di dag ni dngu/da pa'i sgo cam bstan pa yin gyi/ rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /gnyis nga/ rbi/ skabs 'di 'phros don la rnam gzhag 'di lta bu yang shes dgos te/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg par rgyu rgyud kyi mtshan nyid gsal rdzogs su ma bshad cing / gsang sngags rnal 'byore bla med du gsa'/ rdzogs su bshad pa'i phyir/ thos bsam sgom gsum char gyi lta ba dang / yul dang yul can gyi lta ba gnyis ka'i sgo nas mdo sngags gnyis lta nga mi gcig la/ de bzhin du zung —27—

'jug gi gnas lugs de ma rig pas bsgribs pa tsam zhig zhe 'dod la mthun kyang / ma rig pa'i ngos 'dzin mi mthun par gyur te/ nyan thos rnams ni 'jig tshogs la lta ba dang 'brel ba'i sems rmongs tsam de la 'dod cing / de'i gnyen por gang zag gi bdag med tsam sgom pa dang / sems tsam pa rnams ni gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan tu 'dzin zhing / snang ba la ma rig pa phra bar byas nas/de'i gnyen por gzung ba rang bzhin med par sgom pa dang / dbu ma phal pa rnams ni/ mtshan 'dzin gyi spros pa ma rig pa phra bar byas nas/ de'i gnyen por ci yang ma yin pa'i stong nyid sgom pa dang / dbu ma chen ngo/ mdo lugs pa rnams ni bag chags kyis ma rig pa phra bar byas na/ de'i gnyen por rang rig rang gsal don dam gyi dbyings sgom pa dang / dbu ma chen po gsang sngags pa ni/'gyur bde 'pho ba'i bag chags ma rig pa'i mthar thug tu bzhag nas/ de'i gnyen por rang rig zung 'jug gi ye shes dbang bzhi pa'i lam sgom pa yin no/ /de ltar na spros pa bkag pa'i 'dzin stangs can gyi rig shes kyis ma rig pa phra mo 'gog mi nus pas/ rgyud kyi rgyal po las kyang / dngos dang dngos med kyis phye sems kyi rdo rje dag kyang rnal 'byor ba la bde nyams ster ba min/ /gang zhig mkha' yi shes rab la 'khyud lhan skyes bde bar gnas pa'i rang sems de ni thar pa ste/ /zhes dang / lta 'dod mdor bstan las kyang phung po rnam dpyad stong pa nyid/ /chu shing bzhin du snying po med/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /stong nyid de ltar 'gyur ma yin/ /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs shing /dgyes rdor las kyang / rang rig bdag nyid dag pa ste/ dag pa gzhan gyis rnam —28—

grol min/ /zhes gsungs shing / de'i 'grel par grub chen mtsho skyes kyis rang gis rig pa bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid kyi dag pas dag pa yin gyi/ gzhan pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa'i dag pas rnam par grol ba ni ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs shing / rang rig ye shes kyi mtshan nyid thun mong ma yin nga/ sngags nas bde ba chen por bshad de/ rim lnga las kyang / rang rig cam gyi ye shes rbi/ /nam mkha' lta bur mtshan nyid med/ 'on kyang 'di/ la dbyer yod de/ /mtshan mo nyin mo man las bdag nyid/ /ces gsungs/ sngags la yid mtshan rtog las skyob pa'i sgra bshad mdzad pa sogs kyang phar phyin theg pas skyob mi thub pa'i mtshan rtog yod par ston pa'i tshig yin la/ spong rgyu'i sgrib pa yang 'pho ba'i bag chags de mdo nas ma bshad cing / de spong pa'i thabs kyang mdo las mi 'gyung ste/ slob dpon klu'i byang chub kyi las mtha' rnam 'byed las/ mgo dang rkang lag sogs spyin kyang / /snang ba rnam par ma dag phyir/ /byang chub 'bras bu thob mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ snang ba'i sgrib pa ni gong du bshad pa'i 'pho ba'i bag chags te/ snang mched thob gsum gyi snang ba gsum dang / nyi zla sgra gcan gyi snang ba gsum don gcig go /mdo nas ma bshad pa'i tshogs bsogs tshul yang lhag por yod de/ des na gtso bo gang zhig 'pho med lhan skyes lus kyi bde ba dag ni sngags kyi theg par bstan/ /zhes bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis las gung du tshul khrims kyi tshogs rgya cher bshad do/ /'dir lus kyi bde ba zhes gsungs pas/ lus tshor bde ba zag med du skye ba sngags kyi zab khyab du 'dod pa ni mun sprul chen po ste/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba ni —29

lus tshor bde ba ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang 'di la mang du dpyad pa byar yod do/ /de ltar na lta ba dang / sgrib pa dang / bsgom bya lam dang / bsgrub bya tshogs gsogs pa ste bzhi char gyi sgo nas gsang sngags khyad par du phye'o/ /'di dag tu gsang sngags zhes spyir bstan pa tshig zor yang ba'i phyir te bla med la go dgos shing rgyud sde gzhan 'og ma rnams la'ang 'di las dpags te shes par bya'o/ /'di rnams lam gyi rnam gzhag gtso che yang log rtog sel ba'i skabs 'dir 'brel che bas bshad do/ /gnyis pa lus kyi gnas tshul bye brag tu bshad pa la/ lus chags pa dang / gnas pa dang / 'jig pa dang bsrung ba'i tshul rnams rgyas par rgyud kyi rgyal po'i nang gi le'u rtsa 'grel las shes par bya dgos la/ 'dir sgom pas rnal 'byor du byed pa rnams la nyer mkho rags pa tsam bshad na/ shes bya rtsa rlung thig le'i rnam gzhag dang / spang bya nyi zla sgra gcan gyi 'chi ltas bshad pa'o/ /dang po la rtsa dang rlung dang thig le'i rnam gzhag gsum las/ thog mar rtsa'i rnam gzhag ni/ rdo rje'i lus 'di la rtsa bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi la sogs pa mtha' yas pa gsungs kyang / 'di tsam zhig shes par bya ste/ gsang gnas nas gtsug tor gyi bar du a wa dh+wa tī srog shing gi chul du gnas pa'i yas sna dngos gtsug tor du zug cing / rde las gyes pa'i yal ga sbom pa zhig smin mtshams dang / phra mo zhig tshangs bug tu zug go /ro rkyang gnyis kyang gtsug tor nas gsang ba'i bar du dbu ma dang sum gzhibs su gnas la/ gtsug tor dpral mgrin snying ga lte gsang ste 'khor lo drug gi lte ba'i gnas su ro rkyang —3()—

dang/ dbu ma rtsa'i yal ga phra mo res sbrel nas sbubs 'brel bar yod cing /gtsug tor nas ro rkyang gnyis yal ga sna tshogs su gyes te/ mig dang rna ba dang sna'i bu ga rnams su zug pa las rlung gi lam gtso bor sna bug yin no/ /lte ba sor brgyad nas gsang ba'i 'khor lo yod cing / 'a/bor lo de'i 'og mtshams kyi lte ba nas dbu ma'i mas sna sbom shos ni cung zad g.yas la brten te mdun ngos su 'gro zhing / ro ma'i mas sna yang cung zad g.yon ngos la brten te/ mdun du sna bstad nas chu lam du zug pa yin la/ rkyang ma rni dbus kyi cha bzung ste rgyab tu 'khyogs nas bshang lam du zug pa'o/ /gtsug tor nas gsang ba'i bar la ni ro ma g.yas dang rkyang ma g.yon du 83gro snyel ya' ga phra mo ni lte ba nas rtsa gsum las gyes nga/'i rtsa phran ma/༄la rtsa la 'bral/ de bzhin du gsang ba nas gyes te tshe ba'i rtsa rnams dang yang 'brel zhing / de gnyis ka las dpyi dang brla/ sogs rkang mthi la gyi bar gyi sdu rnams gyes kra/ yin la/ lte ba nas yar song sni nga ga dang 'bre la zhing / snying ga nas gyes nga/sa mchan /khung gi rtsa la sbrel nas ga dpung nga/ g.ya/sa g.yon segs lag pa'i sdu rbem/sa bskyed/ de rnam sa kyi sne mgrin par 'dus/ de las ce chung dang / mchu dang/ rna ba sma lce mig sogs kyi 5 rnams bskyed de slar yang gtsug tor gyi bar du 'bran la da sgol/ /lnge ba nas gtsug tor gyi bar gyi 'khor lo lnga la dbus rtsa gsum 'brel ba'i thad du lte ba'i 'khyud mo cung zad yod cing / de dag re re las phyogs bzhir 'byung bzhi'i nus pa 'dzin pa'i ri bzhi bzhi re yod la/ gtsug tor du de nyid kho na ste phyi nang rim pa'i dbye ba me/da pa dang / gzhan bzhi po la rtsa 'dab bzhi re yod pa de las —na/—

gnyis gnyis su gyes pas rim pa gnyis pa la rtsa 'dab brgyad brgyad do/ /snying ga la de nyid kho na dang / dpral mgrin gnyis la de rnams las kyang gnyis gnyis gyes pas rim pa gsum pa la bcu drug bcu drug go /dpral ba la de nyid kho na dang / mgrin par bcu drug las kyang gnyis gnyis gyis te rim pa bzhi pa la sum cu so gnyis so/ /lte bar brgyad kyi phyogs bzhi las gnyis gnyis gyes shing / mtshams bzhi 'a sa ma gyes pas rim pa gsum pa la bcu gnyis dang /de'i phyogs kyi gnyis gnyis las lnga lnga dang/ man las kyi bzhi las drug drug gyes pas rim pa bzhi pa drug cu re bzhi yin la/ drug tu gyes pa'i tha ma re re ni stong pa 'bab pa'i rtsa zhes bya/ gsang gnas la 'khe1ra lo drug char gyi nus pa 'dzin nga/'i dbang gis 'khyud glo/ nas skyes/ pa'i nang skor rtsa 'dab drug de'i lnga las gnyis gnyis su gyes pas bar skor la rtsa 'dab bcu/ de'i brgyad las gnyis gnyis su gyes pas phyi skor snye pa rtsa 'ang ba bcu drug ces bshang nga/ dang /'dzi sgo na no yang bar skar bcu snye pas gsum gsum/ du gya/sa pas sum cu dang / dbus kya lta ba 'a/sa gyes pa gnyis te phyi skor 8rwa so ga / sa su yang bshad na/ gnyis ka snar yang mi 'gasnye la te bcu drug mri /ba steng du snye sna ba dang / so gnyis ni 'og tu phyogs pa'i /khyad par yin gsung / ri rtsa 'dab brgya lnga bcu rtsa drug bgrod pa'i tshe/ phyi skor bcu rtsu drug pa ltar na/ 'khor lo gzhan rnams kyi phyi skor 'ba' zhig dang /gsang gnas kyi rim/ pa gsum char bgrangs pa ste/ phyi skor so gnyis pa ltar 'a/bor lo thams cad kyi phyi skor ro/ /gsang gnas la 'khor lo gzhan rnams dang bgrod tshul mi 'dra bar byed pa yang mi 'gal te/ skyon yon bskyed pa la —32—
