gong du bshad pa ltar rtags dang rgyu mtshan gtso bo lags so/ /'di rnams don dam pa'i sangs rgyas dngos yin pa'i phyir/ stobs sogs sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ma lus pa'ang 'di la rang chas su yod/ rang gis sgom par nus na rim gyis mngon sum du mthong zhing rtogs par 'gyur rnam grangs nye tshe tsam brjod na/'di la mnyam par bzhag pas mi dge ba'i rnam rtog thams cad 'gag /dad pa dang snying rje la sogs pa dge ba'i chos kyi rnam pa rnams dmigs rnam logs su ched kyi ma bsgoms kyang rang shugs su 'char lus ngag gi 'jug ldog khyad par can shugs la 'byung / 'dzag med kyi tshul khrims kyang myur du thob pas don dam 'od gsal kyis snang ba 'di ka lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa dang don dam pa'i 'dul ba yin/ rtog dpyod can dang rtog med dpyod tsam dang / rtog dpyod gnyis ka spangs pa dang / dga' ba can dang / bde ba can dang / btang stoms kho na can dang / gsal stong bde ba'i nyams sna tshogs dang / 'du shes dang yid la byed pa mtha' yas pa'i rnam pa can dang / zad par la sogs pa'i sna nga ba mtha' yas pa 'char zhing / rin chen snang ba dang zla ba sgron ma la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin brgya nyi shu la sogs pa thams cad kyang 'di la mnyam par bzhag na myur du thob pa'i phyir/ don dam pa'i mdo sde dang lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa yin/ 'di nyid chos thams cad kyi chos nyid yin zhing /'di'i steng na gzung 'dzin gyi snang ba nub/ rnam rtog 'gags/ ye shes kyi snang ba gsal por 'char ba mngon sum du grub pa'i phyir na don dam pa'i mngon pa dang / lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa yin/ de bzhin du chos dbyings yin pa'i —293—

phyir chos kyi sku yin la/ chos sku yin pa'i phyir don dam pa'i sangs rgyas dkon mchog yin/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yin pa'i phyir chos dkon mchog gi snying po'am mchog yin/ chos kyi gnas lugs yin pa'i phyir 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi rtogs bya yin pas/ gang zhig rtogs pas rab tu phye ba'i don dam pa'i dge 'dun yang 'di yin no/ /gzhan yang 'od gsal gyi rtags snang 'di rnams la mnyam par bzhag pas ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i shes bya rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab ngang gis skye bar 'gyur te/ 'di don dam pa'i dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi ru gnas pa'i rtags yin/ brtson 'grus ngang gis skye ste/ don dam pa'i yang dag spong ba bzhi yin pa'i rtags yin/ de sogs lam gyi chos thams cad dang sbyar/ 'di la mnyam par bzhag pas nyon mongs rang byung gi nyams dang rnam rtog rang byung gi nyams sna tshogs pa 'char/ de ni nyon mongs la sogs pa'i chos nyid yin pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / don dam pa'i 'dod chags dang zhe sdang la sogs pa'i rnam pa mthong ba yin/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi gnas lus longs spyod sogs kyi snang ba sna tshogs 'char/ de ni khams gsum gyi chos nyid yin pa'i rtags dang / don dam pa'i lha dang / don dam pa'i dmyal ba dang / don dam gyi mi la sogs par rang chas su bzhugs pa'i rtags yin/ yi dam lha dang sangs rgyas rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs mang po mthong / de ni don dam bde gshegs snying po mtshan dpe la sogs pa yon tan du mas brgyan par bzhugs pa'i rtags dang / rnam pa thams cad pa'i nang nas dag pa'i snang bar bzhugs pa'i rtags yin/ gzhan yang mngon shes la sogs pa dang / spros bral dang /—294—

stong nyid la sogs pa'i rnam pa gzhan dang / sems can gyi don shes pa la sogs pa nyams gyi tshul du 'char te/ de ni stong gzugs zhes kyang bya/ /sems nyid ces kyang bya/ don dam bden pa zhes kyang bya ba 'di gdod ma nas ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang / mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi ngo bor rtag tu gdod nas yod pa dang / sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi rnam pa mtha' yas par ye nas bzhugs shing / bzhugs pa ltar rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi mig gis ci rigs par mthong ba yin no/ /de ltar na stong gzugs bsgoms pas zhing sbyangs par 'gyur tshul nas 'di'i bar du brjod pa rnams kyi don rgya cher bshad na ngo sprod mtha' yas par 'gyur mod kyi/ yi ge mangs pas 'jigs pa'i phyir dang / nyams myong dang bstun nas bshad dgos pa yi ger 'god mi lang ba'i phyir dang / phyogs tsam smros pa 'dis go zhing ston par 'gyur pa'i phyir/ mdo tsam 'di las ma bstan to/ /de dag gis ni chos thams cad stong gzugs su 'dus par ngo sprad pa ste/ ngo sprod skor bzhi pa'o/ /de nas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du ngo sprod pa la/ stong nyid chos kun gyi gzhi yin par bstan/ rang bzhin gdod nas spros bral du gtan la phab/don dam bsal bzhag med pa'i gnas la nges pa bskyed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rnam pa thams cad pa'i stong nyid ye shes 'di ga 'bras bu'i mthar thug rgyal ba rigs lnga rigs drug ye shes lnga'am ye shes drug sogs gdod ma nas yin pa'i gnad kyi sems nyid gcig pu 'bras bu'i chos thams cad du shar/ gzhi 'bras dbye ba med pa'i gnad kyis sems nyid gcig pu gzhi 'bras gnyis ka dang —295—

rnam pa mthun pa'i lam gyi chos thams cad du shar/ de bzhin du sems nyid gcig pu'i dri ma bag chags kyi snang cha las/ gzhi 'khor ba'i chos thams cad shar te/ nang bcud kyi sems can rdo rje lus kyi snang tshul mtha' yas pa dang /phyi snod kyi 'jig rten rnam pa sna tshogs pa 'di dag shar ba yin pas/ mdor na ye shes gcig nyid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad du sprul pa'am/ gcig nyid du mar shar yang du ma gcig gi rang bzhin las ma 'das zhes bya/ gong du'ang don gyis na bshad mod kyi/ 'dir sngar las cung zad gsal bar brjod na/sems nyid rnam pa thams cad pa'i 'char tshul la 'khor ba'i chos dang mtshungs pa'i lha dang dmyal ba la sogs pa'i rnam pa de kun rdzob kyi rnam pa ma yin/ don dam pa'i rnam pa yin/ sbyang bya ma yin/ sbyang gzhi yin/ dag bya ma yin/ dag gzhi yin/ chos can ma yin/ chos nyid yin la/ kun rdzob las snang gi lha dang dmyal ba rnams ni don du ma grub sems snang yin/ don dam gyi rnam pa ma yin kun rdzob kyi rnam pa yin/ sbyang gzhi ma yin sbyang bya yin/ dag gzhi ma yin dag bya yin/ chos nyid ma yin chos can yin/ 'dis mtshon nas don dam pa'i srid gsum gyi snang ba thams cad gnas lugs yin zhing / kun rdzob srid gsum gyi snang ba thams cad slo bur gyi dri ma yin no/ /de bzhin du sems nyid kyi rang bzhin la dad pa dang snying rje dang shes rab la sogs pa'i rnam pa gdod nas gnas pa de ni don dam dang sbyang gzhi sogs yin la/ lam dang rtsol bas gsar du bskyed pa'i dad pa dang snying rje dag shes rab la sogs pa rnams ni kun rdzob dang byed kyi lam yin gyi/ don dam dang dag gzhi la sogs pa ma yin —296—

no/ /lam gyi chos 'di dag gzhi/ dag bya/ dag byed/ dag 'bras bzhi 'am/sbyang gzhi/ sbyang bya/ sbyong byed/ sbyangs 'bras bzhis zlas phye ba'i sbyong byed dang /dag byed kho na yin kyang / sbyang gzhi sbyang bya gnyis su chos thams cad bsdu ba'i tshe/ lam dus kyi shes rab la sogs pa lam gyi ngo bo de rnams ni kun rdzob pa'i chos kho na yin pa'i phyir dang / rim gyis 'dor dgos pa'i phyir sbyang bya'i phyogs su bsdu la/ shes rab kyi steng gi chos yang dag par 'byed pa'i ye shes nang rig tsam gyi ldog cha sogs ni sbyang gzhi'i nang du bsdu ste/ de lta ba'i rigs rgyun nam du yang mi ldog pa dang / kun rdzob kho na nyid ma yin par don dam dang mthun zhing / sangs rgyas kyi sa'i lam bden gdul bya gzhan snang du 'gro ba'i don spyod pa'i ye shes de'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis su kha zhi gcod pa'i skabs 'dir/ gzhi 'bras ngo bo dbye ba med pa'i gnad kyis sbyangs 'bras thams cad kyang sbyang gzhir bsdu'o/ /sems kyi rang bzhin la stobs sogs sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi rnam pa sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyis bsdus pa thams cad ni don dam dang sbyang gzhi sogs yin la/ lam bsgom pas gsar du thob pa'i ldog cha glo bur gyi dri ma spangs pa'i cha rnams dang / gdul bya gzhan snang du ston pa rnams dang / gzhan snang du 'char du rung ba rnams ni kun rdzob dang sbyangs 'bras yin zhing sbyang gzhi ma yin no/ /dag pa gnyis ldan gyi skabs kyi rang bzhin rnam dag gi cha de ni sbyang gzhi sbyangs 'bras gnyis kar yin pa lta smos kyang ci dgos kyi/ gzhi'i chos nyid ces bya ba dang / gzhi lam 'bras gsum spyi'i chos nyid ces brjod kyang wo ste/ gdod ma'i sems nyid de ga sbyangs —297—

'bras mthar thug dang don dam pa'i sbyangs 'bras yin no/ /yang 'dir log rtog 'di lta ste/ de ltar na sems rnam pa thams cad pa'i srid pa gsum gyi rnam pa las ni 'khor ba 'gyung gi gzhan gnyis mi 'byung la/ shes rab kyi rnam pa sogs las gzhan gnyis 'byung zhing 'khor ba mi 'gyung zhing / ye shes lnga'i rnam pa sogs las gzhi lam gnyis mi 'byung bas rnam pa so so tha dad pa rnams byed las tha dad par nges shing / byed las tha dad pas ngo bo yang tha dad par 'gyur la/ de'i phyir du ma'i rang bzhin can kun rdzob pa brdzun pa bslu ba'i chos can yin no snyam pa 'ga' zhig gi bsam pa la 'gyung bar 'gyur te/ de la brjod pa bden te rnam par rtog pa 'di ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas khong du ma chud par zad do/ /'on kyang skyon de ltar mi 'jug ste/ 'dir don dam pa dmyal ba'i rnam pa gang yin pa de ka snying rje'i rnam pa dang shes rab kyi rnam pa'ang yin la/de nyid me long ye shes la sogs pa'i rnam pa'ang yin no/ /de ltar na rnam pa mang po so so tha dad pa dus gcig tu shing la 'bras bu mang po chags pa bzhin du ldan pa ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad ngo bo gcig pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa yin pas/ rnam pa kun ldan dang rnam pa thams cad pa dang dbang po thams cad pa zhes brjod pa yin gyi/ rnam pa tha dad pa dang / rnam pa so so ba dang / dbang po so so ba zhes brjod pa ma yin no/ /des na rnam ba kun ldan gcig pu gnyis su med pa yin kyang / don dam pa'i dmyal ba'i rnam pa sogs yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ de'i g.ya' lta bur chags pa'i dri ma la dmyal sogs 'khor ba'i snang ba 'char ba yin zhing / de nyid shes rab la sogs pa'i rnam pa yin pa'i rgyu —298—

mtshan gyis sgrub pa po'i rgyud la shes rab sogs lam gyi chos thams cad 'char ba yin te/ sa 'og na rdo sol dag chu tshan yod na sa steng gi sa rlan can yang dros nas sa'i steng la rlangs pa byung ba lta bu yin zhing / de nyid me long ye shes la sogs pa'i rnam pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis nor bu las nor bu'i 'od 'byung ba ltar sangs rgyas rnams la sku gsum mdzad pa dang bcas pa 'char ba yin no/ /de yang don dam dbyings las gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos thams cad 'char ba ni/ don dam dbyings te don dam pa'i rnam pa thams cad pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'khor ba pa dang rnal 'byor pa la dag pa dang ma dag pa'i kun rdzob kyi rnam pa thams cad par shar ba yin la/ sangs rgyas rnams kyang gzhan snang du kun rdzob pa'i rnam pa thams cad par ston pa yin no/ /rnam pa thams cad pa'i dpe sman sna tshogs bsdus pa'i gam thang gi dpe dang sbyar ro/ /gzhan yang dper na/ phyogs bzhi las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal po lha chen po zhes pa de mi mang po 'dus pa min gyi mi/ gcig nyid yin/ des phyogs bzhi'i yul mi la bka' lung stsal pas phyogs bzhi'i yul la dbang bsgyur ba yin/ de'i tshe shar phyogs la bka' lung ster ba po shar phyogs la dbang bsgyur ba de ka lho phyogs la dbang bsgyur ba po dang bka' stso la pa bo yin mod/ don la shar gyi mi la bka' stsole ba po lho la dbang bsgyur mkhan yin kyang shar pa rnams la bka' stsal ba'i byed pa'i lho phyogs dbang bsgyur zhes mi brjod pa bzhin du don dam dbyings kyi don dam pa'i bum pa'i rnam pa gcig pu las gzhi las 'bras bu thams cad kyi snang ba byung ba shin tu yin kyang don dam bum pa'i rnam pa yin —299—

pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi bum pa kun rdzob pa'i rnam pa shar/ don dam ka ba'i rnam pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis kun rdzob ka ba'i snang ba 'byung zhes brjod kyi/ don dam bum pa'i rnam pa las kun rdzob ka ba 'byung / ka ba las bum pa 'byung zhes sogs mi zer te/ don la 'gal ba med kyang 'jig rten tshul dang mi mthun pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang dper na/ nam mkha' ni gzugs can thams cad kyi go 'byed pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis sprin dang mun pa la sogs pa'ang 'byung bar 'gyur/ rlung dang nyi ma'i 'od la sogs pa'ang 'gyung bar 'gyur/ rlung gis sprin bsal/ nyi 'od kyis mun pa bsal ba'i gnas skabs 'ga' na/ bar snang stong sang nge ba rab rib med pa'i mig shes kyis dngos su mthong ba yang 'byung mod/sprin dang mun nag dang rlung dang nyi 'od dang bar snang mthong ba'i mig shes rnams kyis nam mkha' la gos pa med cing / nam mkha' kyang de rnams bskyed pa ma yin mod kyi/ de rnams skye ba la nam mkhas gegs mi byed cing / gegs mi byed pa'i nam mkha' de yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis rkyen nye bar dmigs na de rnams 'byung bas na/ nam mkha' la sprin byung zhes sogs tha snyad 'dogs so/ /de bzhin du sems nyid 'dis gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi kun rdzob kyi chos rnams dngos su bskyed pa ma yin zhing / de rnams bskyed pa'i rgyu'ang 'di ma yin la/ de rnams 'byung ba 'di'i byed las kyang yang dag par nam yin mod/chos nyid 'di rnam pa thams cad pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'khor ba pa dang /rnal 'byor pa dang / sangs rgyas rnams la de dang de 'byung zhing / gnas skabs gsum po de dag tu gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos rnams 'byung ba la sems 'dis —300—

mi sgrib cing gegs mi byed la/ de dag gi gzhi rten gyi 'dra mtshungs su yod cing /mi sgrib cing gegs mi byed pa'i sems nyid 'di med na de rnams mi 'byung zhing /rkyen nye ba na 'di yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de rnams byung bas/ don dam dbyings las kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad skyes so/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos thams cad byung ngo / /snang ba sna tshogs pa 'di ni de'i byed las so/ /zhes brda' sbyar ba yin pas rgyu dang 'bras bu dang byed pa po dang byed las su 'jog pa rnams ni phyogs mthun tsam rgyu mtshan du bzhag pa'i btags pa ba yin no/ /de bas na/yang dag par na don dam ni kun rdzob dang 'brel ba can ma yin la/ kun rdzob kyang rang gi ngo bos med pa'i phyir 'brel bar bya rgyu med pas na/ don dam dang 'brel ba med do/ /kun rdzob glo ngor ni don dam chos nyid yod pa'i rgyu mashaṃ gyis kun rdzob byung la/ don dam chos nyid med na ni de yang 'byung mi srid pas/don dam kun rdzob dang ma 'brel yang kun rdzob don dam 'brel zhes brda' sbyar ba yin pa/ 'brel ba de yang btags pa ba yin no/ de ltar na chos nyid de/rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med/ /ces bya ba yin bas don dam pa'i rnam pa kun dang ldan/ rnam pa kun tu rang gi ngo bos yod/ rang bzhin gyis grub cing yod pa yin kyang kun rdzob kyi rnam pa gang du yang med de/ kun rdzob kyi rnam pa thams cad gdod ma nas yod ma myong ba'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu'i chos dbyings rnam pa kun ldan de nyid sems kyi rang bzhin yin pas sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba zhes bya/ 'di'i ngo bo ni mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba yin la/ 'di'i rang gzugs ni stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo yin no/ /'di'i khyad par ni dus —301—

gsum kyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir bde gshegs snying po zhes bya ste/ de ltar na/ stong gzugs mthong bas sems nyid mthong /chos sku mthong / don dam bden pa mthong / gnas lugs mthong / 'gog bden mthong zhes ngo sprad do/ /stong nyid rnam pa thams cad pa la brten nas chos thams cad kyi gzhi rten du ngo sprad pa ste ngo sprod skor lnga pa'o// //gnyis pa ni/ sems nyid rnam pa thams cad pa de la rnam pa'i ldog cha mtha' yas kyang / ngo bo'i sgo nas dbyings bde ba chen po kho nar zad la/ de la gzung 'dzin spros pa'i chos ni gdod ma nas yod ma myong / gdod ma'i ye shes kho rang gi rang ngo nas 'khrul ba'i snang ba 'char ba min kyang / ye shes de rgyud ldan gyi sems can rnams kyi sems rgyud dam rnam shes sgrib pa'i rang bzhin can yin pas dngos gnas la yod pa'i rang bzhin de mi mthong bar rnam shes rang rig rang gsal tsam la 'khrul pa sna tshogs pa shar ba der gda'/ ngo bo 'khrul pa de'i nang tshan yin kyang 'khrul pa gzhan mang po sel nus shing / don dam gyi dbyings de la snying nye zhing 'dun pa'i rnam pa can chos la dad pa dang /sems can la snying rje dang / rtsol bcas kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / gnas lugs la 'jug pa'i shes rab la sogs pa lam gyi chos thams cad kyang rnam shes rang rig rang gsal de'i snang cha la shar nas spang bya glo bur gyi dri ma g.yin rnams rim gyis spong / lam gyi chos rnams kyi 'char gzhi rnam shes tsam de yang lam bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis don dam gyi dbyings su thim par byed cing / rnam shes de gzung 'dzin gnyis snang dang bcas pa ni sems nyid kyi sgrib g.yog yin —302—

pas/ lam gyi gzhi'i sgrib g.yog de spong bar byed cing / lam kho rang yang mthar gtugs na sgrib g.yogs su gtogs kyang / sgrib byed gzhan thams cad khos sel/ mthar bud shing zad na me yal ba bzhin du lam nyid kyang rang sangs la 'gro'o/ /de'i tshe kun rdzob kyi sgrib g.yogs thams cad zad pas/gnas lugs don dam gcig pu nyid khyab brdal du gyur pa ni/ sangs rgyas thob pa dang 'bras bu mthar phyin pa zhes ming btags pa yin no/ /de yang chos dbyings rang ngos nas sgrib g.yogs kyis bsgribs pa'i skabs dang / sgrib g.yogs sel bzhin pa'i skabs dang / bsal zin pa'i skabs zhes dbye ba med kyang / yid can skyes bu rnams kyi blo'i rim pa rnam pa gsum du byung ba yin no/ /ri rab kyi drung na gnas pa'i long ba'i dus dang mig phye ba'i dus kyi dpe dang sbyar ro/ /de ltar yang / khams ni gnas skabs gsum dag tu/ /mi gsum gyi ni bstan pa yin/ /zhes dbyings kyi rang bzhin rtogs dka' bas de rgyud ldan gyi gang zag de'i gnas skabs gsum la tha snyad gdags pa rnam par gzhag pa mdzad nas dbyings de go bar byed pa yin pas/ gnas lugs la 'jug pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar 'char sgo gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi chos mtha' dag dang / kun khyab chos dbyings de bzhin nyid ni skabs 'dir khyad gzhir bzhag nas/ de dag spros bral du gtan la dbab pa ni/ spros pa dang bral ba dang spros pa med pa zhes bya ba la gang zhig bral rgyu dang su zhig med rgyu'i spros pa ni/ yul dang yul can nam/ shes pa dang shes bya'am/ rtogs bya dang rtogs 303—

byed dam/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa dang / che chung dang /bzang ngan dang / mtha' dbus la sogs pa dang / shar la sogs pa'i phyogs cha dang / 'das ma 'ongs da ltar la sogs pa dus kyi cha dang / phyi nang bar gsum la sogs pa gnas kyi cha dang / skye 'gag gnas gsum la sogs pa ngo bo'i char 'khrul zhing snang la sgro 'dogs shing 'dzin pa rnams te/ spros pa de dag kyang med bzhin du blos btags pa/ ming tsam brda tsam ma btags gcig pu nyams dga' ba'i tshul du yod yod ltar snang kyang dngos po'i gshis dang gnas tshul la yod ma myong / de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas kyis kyang med par gsungs/bsam byung gi shes rab kyis kyang brtags na mi rnyed/ sgom byung gi shes rab kyis kyang med par rtogs/ 'phags pa rnams kyis ci yang gzigs ma myong ba zhig yin pas/ khyad gzhi kun rdzob don dam gnyis ka la khyad chos spros pa de dag gdod ma nas med pa lags so/ /gdod ma nas grub ma myong ba yin no/ /spros pa de rnams re re nas med tshul ni 'dir mi 'bri ste/ bshad kyi mi lang ba'i phyir dang / go ba rags pa tsam ni skye sla ba'i phyir dang / rigs pa phra mo rnams ni phal gyis go dka' ba'i phyir dang / sgom ngo sprod pa'i dus su 'thad sgrub kyi rigs pa ni skabs kyi don ma yin pa'i phyir dang / 'di theg chen gyi mdo sngags thams cad la grags pa'i thun mong yin pa'i phyir dang / gzhan du btsal bas rnyed par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par 'di ltar shes par bya ste/ kun rdzob snang grags kyi bsdus pa'i chos 'di rnams yul yul can/ che chung mtha' dbus/ skye 'gag gnas gsum la sogs par ma grub/ de —304—

ma grub pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis snang grags 'di rnams 'khrul snang la shar ba ma gtogs med pa yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan skye 'gags gnas gsum du snang ba 'di yod na skye 'gag gnas gsum du ka sgrub dgos pa las/ skye 'gag gnas gsum ye ma grub pas skye 'gag gnas gsum du snang ba 'di 'khrul snang kho na nyid yin par shes/ yul yul can sogs gzhan thams cad la'ang skye 'gag gnas gsum gyi rigs 'gre/ don dam chos kyi dbyings la yul yul can/ che chung mtha' dbus skye 'gag gnas gsum la sogs pa gang yang med mod de rnams med pas don dam la spros pa'i chos gang yang med pa yin kyang don dam med par mi 'gyur/ de'i rgyu mtshan sngar kun rdzob kyi skabs dang mi 'dra/ kun rdzob gyi chos gcig yod phyin spros pa'i mtshan ma gang rung zhig tu yod dgos/de med pas de yang med/ don dam dbyings ni yod kyang spros pa'i mtshan ma de dag gi ngo bor yod mi dgos pas/ de dag med kyang don dam pa med par mi 'gyur/ dper na skye ba zhes bya ba gtan nas med na skye bar snang zhing myong ba de 'khrul snang kho na yin par thags chod kyang don dam dbyings de skye bar snang ba'i chos min pas/ skye ba gtan nas ma grub kyang don dam dbyings med par mi 'grub pa yin no/ /don dam dbyings de yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gzhan/ ji skad du/gzhan min phyin ci log ma yin/ /de 'gags 'phags pa'i spyod yul dang / /'phags pa'i chos kyi rgyu yi phyir/ /zhes gsungs pa sogs lung dang rigs pa dang man ngag dang nyams myong ste tshad ma bzhi'i sgo nas gnas lugs la bzhugs par grub bo/ /sgo drung na skyes bu lhas byin yod pa la ba lang yod par 'khrul —305—

zhing / dngos su mthong ba na 'khrul pa sangs pa'i dpe dang sbyar ro/ /kun rdzob snang grags kyi chos thams cad kyang skye med 'gag med gnas med yin/ yul med/ yul can med/ gang zag med/ chos bdag med pa yin/ don dam dbyings kyang skye med 'gag med gnas med yin/ yul med yul can med/gang zag med/ chos bdag med pa yin/ de ltar yin yang snang grags kyi chos 'di rnams nam du yang med la/ don dam dbyings ni gnas tshul la yod cing rtag brtan zhi ba g.yung drung du bzhugs pa yin no/ /'dir chos dbyings la ngo sprod tshul ni/ rnal wor pas mthong ba'i stong gzugs la rnal 'byor pas blo ngor skye 'gag gnas gsum du snang ba 'khrul ba yin pas/ skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i 'dus ma byas su ngo sprod pa dang gcig sems gsal rig la'ang skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba sogs de ltar ngo sprod pa dang gnyis/ stong gzugs dang sems gnyis yul yul can tha dad par blos 'dzin pa 'di 'khrul snang yin pas/ gnas lugs la stong gzugs nyid sems/ sem/sa nyid stong gzugs dbyer med ngo bo gcig yin la/de nyid yod med yin min bzang ngan che chung sogs sgra rtog gang gis kyang ma reg pa'i blo 'das su ngo sprad pa ste/ gsum gyi gnad nas bzung ste ngo sprod pa ste ngo sprod gsum mo/ /kun rdzob snang ba la ngo sprod pa la yang gzugs snang lta bu gcig gi steng du sbyar na/ gzugs snang spros bral/ gzugs 'dzin shes pa spros bral/ snang sems dbyer med spros bral te phal cher gong mas rigs 'gre la/'on kyang stong gzugs dang sems nyid ye shes dbyer med 'dus ma byas yin —306—

la/ las snang dang rnam shes gsal rig dbyer med 'dus byas yin pa'i khyad par phyed dgos la/ las snang dang rnam shes gnyis rnal 'byor pa'i yang dag kun rdzob bden pa'i don yul yul can dbyer med du ngo sprad pas rnam shes la gzung cha dang 'dzin cha dbye ba med pa dang / rnam shes tsam zhig tha snyad bden par yod/ gzhan dbang de la kun brtags med par ngo sprad pa yin/ don dam par las snang dang rnam shes gnyis ka gdod nas ma grub pas/ de nyid dang gzhan du brjod du med pa yin zhing / stong gzugs dang sems nyid ngo bo gcig pa nyid yin kyang 'khrul ngor gnyis snang shar mod kyang dbyer med du gto la 'bebs pa ni/ yongs grub la gzhan dbang kun brtags gzung 'dzin gyi gdod nas gos ma myong bar ngo sprod pa yin zhing / bden pa gnyis po yang ngo bo de nyid dang gzhan du brjod du med pa yin no/ /de ltar na/ las snang gi de kun rdzob bden pa la ngo sprod pa yin zhing / stong gzugs kyi de don dam gyi gnas lugs la ngo sprod pa yin no/ /rang bzhin spros bral la ngo sprad pa ste ngo sprod skor drug pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi myang 'das yin/ rang bzhin gyi myang 'das las gzhan pa'i chos med/ 'khor ba'i chos thams cad med bzhin snang ba'i cho 'phrul yin/ des na gshis lugs la 'khor ba yod ma myong / de la sems las nyon mongs mngon sum du skyes/ nyon mongs sna tshogs kyis las sna tshogs bsags/ de las sdug bsngal sna tshogs thog tu babs pa myong bas grub/ lung dang rig pas kyang grub po snyam pa dang / de nas lam —307

bsgoms pas las nyon sdug bsngal gsum po je chung rje chung du 'gro zhing / yon tan gyi chos rnams je mang je cher 'gro ba myong bas grub pa dang / nam zhig 'bras bu mngon du gyur pa'i tshe sngar yod 'khor ba'i skyon thams cad dus der zad/ sngar med kyi yon tan thams cad gsar du thob par yang rigs pas 'thob pa yin pas 'khor ba gdod nas med pa sogs mi rud ngo snyam na/ de lta bu'i 'khor ba dang lam dang 'bras bu'i rim pa de dag kyang blo 'khrul ba'i snang ngo kho na yin/ 'khor ba'i chos thams cad yod ma myong yang rab rib can gyi sa nam mkha' la skra shad mthong ba bzhin du 'khrul te snang / lam bsgoms pas skyon yon spang thob ltar snang ba yang dper na mig rab rib can gyis thag ring thung 'tshams pa'i ri bo'i ngos la bltas na/ ri'i ngos na yod pa'i rtsa dang shing gel ba dang ri dwags la sogs pa gang yang mi mthong ngo / /ri'i ngos la dngos gnas la med kyang skra shad dang 'od zlum po dang / dra ba'i rnam pa can la sogs pa rab rib kyi gzugs brnyan ji snyed cig mthong bar 'gyur na/ mig sman bsten pa la sogs pas rab rib de ji chung je chung du song ba'i tshe ri'i ngos la skra shad la sogs pa je nyung du song ba dang / shing gel ba la sogs pa je mang du song ba ltar snang ngo / /des na ri ni sems kyi dpe/ skra shad sogs ni las nyon sdug bsngal gsum gyi dpe/ rtswa shing sogs ni yon tan gyi dpe'o/ /skra shad sogs sngon nas yod ma myong bas phyis nyung du 'gro rgyu med/ mig gi skyon dag pas 'khrul pa sangs pa tsam yin/ rtswa shing sogs sngar las mang du song ba ma yin/ sngar sgrib byed kyis bsgribs nas ma mthong ba de gsar du mthong ba yin/—308—

de bzhin du 'khor ba'i chos gnas tshul la ma grub pas je nyung du 'gro rgyu med kyang 'khrul pa je chung du song ba tsam yin/ yon tan gyi chos sems la gdod ma nas gnas pa yin pas na gsar du skye ba dang je mang du 'gro rgyu med kyang sngar sgrib pas bsgribs nas ma mthong ba sgrib byed je srab tu song bas mthong chul rgya je cher song ba yin/ rab rib sangs pa'i tshe skra shad sogs ye ma mthong zhing rtswa shing sogs kyis khyab par mthong yang / skra shad bsal ba dag rtsa shing sogs gsar du skyes pa ma yin pa bzhin du sangs rgyas thob pa'i tshe 'khor ba gtan nas med cing / sems nyid mkha' khyab yon tan thams cad kyi rang bzhin du mngon du gyur pa yang 'khor ba bsal rgyu dang / yon tan gsar skyes min te/rang sems la gdod ma nas gnas pa'i yon tan rnams 'khrul pa zad pas mngon sum du mthong ba tsam ni yin no/ ji skad du/ gnyis las gzhan med de ni nor pa skyes/ /de phyir thar pa nor tsam zad pa yin/ /zhes gsungs/ de nyid la bsal bzhag med pa'i don zhes bya ste/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /bzhag par bya ba cung zad med/ /ces so/ /bsal bzhag med pa'i dpe gzhan yang rdzing bu don gnyer gyi mi mtshan mo lam du zhugs pas rdzing bu la rdo stegs su 'khrul/ nam langs pa na rdzing bur shes kyang rdo stegs bsal du med/ rdzing bu bzhag tu med pa dang / dung ser por snang ba sogs dang sbyar ro/ /skabs 'dir sgom nyams skad cig ma'i steng du sbyar na stong gzugs dang bde gsal gyi nyams shig shar/ de rang bzhin gyi myang 'das yin/ gsar du bzhag pa ma yin/gdod ma'i gnas lugs yin/ rang la ye nas yod yod pa yin kyang man ngag —309—

tshad ma dang ma mjal bar du gang zag rang gis ma myong ba yin/ ma rtog pa yin/mngon du ma gyur pa yin/ da ni byed bcings la sogs pa thabs khyad par can gyis cung zad mthong ba yin/ gsal stong bde ba'i nyams shar ba'i skabs de nyid na bzang ngo ngan no bde'o mi bde'o snyam pa'i rnam rtog cig thol gyis 'char/de yud tsam zhig gnas/ dar cig nas de log ste yang rtog pa gzhan skye ba la sogs par snang / de ltar rtog pa skye 'gag gnas gsum du snang ba de 'khrul pa yin/ de nyid rang zhal la bltas pas gang nas skyes/ gang du gnas/ ji ltar 'gag ces brda sbyar bas yul gang na yang mi 'dug gnas gang du yang mi gnas/ dus nam gyi tshe yang ma dmigs/ rnam pa ji lta bur yang mi 'char ngo bo gang du yang ma grub/ des na rnam rtog de gdod ma nas yod ma myong / de phyir yod pa ltar snang ba 'khrul snang tsam yin/ gdod nas med pa la su zhig skye/ su zhig gnas/ su zhig 'gag /rnam rtog 'di 'khor ba yin/ glo bur ba yin/med bzhin du snang ba yin/ des na rnam rtog phar bsal du med/ gsal stong bde ba tshur bzhag tu med pas gnas lugs la bsam bzhag med pa zhes bya/des gzhan thams cad la rigs 'gre'o/ /don dam bsal bzhag med pa'i don la ngo sprad pa ste/ ngo sprod skor bdun pa'o/ /da ni de dag gi 'phros don rnams bshad par bya ste/ gong du bshad pa de dag ni ya na lag drug po'i gnas skabs thams cad du rtogs par bya dgos pa yin la/ 'on kyang sor sdud kyi skabs su rtags snang mthong ba tsam la ngo sprad pa gtso che zhing / bsam gtan gyi skabs su spros bral dang / bsal bzhag med —31()—

—nga ra ngo sprod pa gal che/ srog rtsol gyi skabs su ni/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i bdag nyid stong gzugs dang sems nyid dbyer med pa de rtsa dang rlung gi chos nyid dam/ don dam pa'i rtsa dang rlung du ngo sprad nas/ gsal stong gi ting nge 'dzin gtso bor skyong dgos/ rtsa'i rang bzhin gsal ba dang rlung gi rang bzhin stong pa yin no/ /ro rkyang gi rlung ni 'khrul ba'i rang bzhin yin pas/ /ma 'khrul pa'i ye shes 'od gsal rtags nang de nyid kyi ngang du rlung bcu rengs par gyur pa ni/ rlung dbu mar chud pa zhes bya ba yin te/ rtags snang nyid dbu ma'i ye shes kyi rlung dang dbye ba med pa yin no/ /'dzin pa'i skabs su thig le'i rang bzhin bde ba yin la/ bde ba de dang rtags snang ngo bo dbyer med pa yang dag pa'i gtum mo yin par ngo sprad nas/ rlung bcu yang bde mnyam gyi ting nge 'dzin der thim par byed dgos pa yin no/ /'dir bde stong gi nyams gtso bor skyong / 'di thig le'i rnal 'byor kho na gtso che/ gsal stong bde ba gsum don la dbye ba med kyang tha mal gyi rlung 'di'i dri ma cha shas dag nas/ gsal ba'i ting nge 'jin du shar pa'i tshe/ gsal stong du thim pa zhes bya zhing / da dung dri ma ci rigs dag nas bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin du gyur pa'i tshe bde stong la thim pa zhes bya'o/ /des na rtsa rlung thig le dbu mar thim pa zhes bya ba yang / de rnams rang rang gi chos nyid kyi gnas su ci rigs par thim pa'i ming yin no/ /des na chos nyid kyi rtsa rlung thig le rnam pa thams cad pa stong gzugs dang bde ba zung du 'jug pa'i rang bzhin sems can rnams la gdod ma nas gnas pa de'i dbyings su las snang gi rtsa rlung thig le rnams dag par byed dgos pa yin no/—311—

———— rjes dran skabs su stong gzugs rnam pa thams cad pa dngos su grub ces bya ji la/ rnam pa thams cad pa gdod ma nas yod yod pa yin kyang rnam 'byor pa'i blo ngos la rjes dran ma thob bar du cig car rnam pa thams cad du 'char ma gtub/ /rjes dran thob nas de ltar mngon sum du mthong ba'i don no/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi skabs su stong gzugs dang bde chen zung du 'jug pa'i don ni/gnas tshul la zung 'jug gdod ma nas yin kyang ting nge 'dzin ma thob bar du rten lus kyi phyogs nas thig le gtso bo/ rtsa rlung 'khor/ brtan pa sems nyid bde ba/ dmigs yul stong gzugs rnams dngos gnas la dbyer med yin kyang / rnal 'byor pas dbyer med du mi myong bar bag chags 'khrul pa'i dbang gis tha dad lta bur nyams su myong ba zhig yin pa la/ ting nge 'dzin thob nas ngo skal kyi 'khrul pa de zad pas/ de dag dbyer med gcig yin pa la yin dzir nyams su myong bas zung 'jug go /de ltar na yan lag drug po la yang yul gnas lugs 'gog bden gyis bsdus pa rnams ni ngo bo gcig pa/ don dam rtag brtan chos nyid yin la/ rnal 'byor pa'i blo ngo'i shes pa yul chos nyid dmigs pa'i rnam pa can lam gyis bsdus pa rnams ni 'dus byas mi rtag pa/kun rdzob yin par shes par bya'o/ /don dam pa ni dus kyis ma bsdus pa'i phyir don dam rang ngos nas sor sdud kyi dus kyi stong gzugs dang bde ba zhes pa nas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi stong gzugs dang bde ba zhes pa'i bar du dbye ba med la/ lam gyi yan lag drug po dmigs pa'i yul chos nyid gcig nyid la dmigs pa yin kyang / lam yan lag drug po rang la gnas skabs tha dad pa —312—

drug 'byung zhing / de dang de'i skabs rtogs tshul tha dad pa yang drug byung ba yin no/ /des na yan lag dang po bzhi'i stong gzugs rnam pa thams cad pa ma yin pa dang / phyi ma gnyis la yin no zer ba dang / yan lag dang po lnga'i bde ba mi 'gyur ba ma yin pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi bde ba 'gyur med ces zer ba dang /de bzhin du sor sdud kyi rtags snang mi brtan la bsam gtan gyi brtan zer ba sogs de 'dra'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag thams cad rnal 'byor pa'i blo ngo dang bstan pa yin gyi dngos gnas ma yin pas/ rang lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i grub mtha'i tshig gsal por brjod na/ lam yan lag dang po bzhi la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i sems kyis rnam pa thams cad pa'i stong gzugs de yang rnam pa phyogs re bar mthong / lam phyi ma gnyis la gnas pa'i sems kyis rnam pa thams cad pa rang du mthong / de bzhin du gnas tshul gyi bde ba 'gyur med de ma myong bar rkyen las byung ba'i bde ba tsam myong ba yin kyang / de'i rgyu la bde ba 'gyur med de sbas pa'i tshul gyi yod do/ /zhes dang / lam sor sdud kyi rtogs pa kho na la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i sems kyi stong gzugs de skabs der rnal 'byor pa des mi brtan par mthong yang dngos gnas la stong gzugs de rtag pa yin zhes brjod par bya'o/ de dag ni rnal 'byor yan lag drug gi rim pa drug po ngo sprod pa ste ngo sprod skor brgyad pa'o/ /da ni rnam grangs gzhan dang gzhan gyi sgo nas ngo sprod pa la ting nge 'dzin gyi dbye ba dang / rdo rje 'beb pa'i ye shes dang / 'phros don phra mo tsam ste gsum las/ dang po ting nge 'dzin gyi dbye ba'i ngo sprod ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin —313—

pa las gsungs pa'i ting nge 'dzin brgya nyi shu sogs kyang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ting nge 'dzin 'di la tshang / rnam pa mtha' yas pa gsungs pa rnams kyang zhi ba'i rnam pa la 'dus par gsungs pa ltar/ ting nge 'dzin dang rnam pa dmigs pa thams cad rnam par mi rtog pa khyad par can 'di la tshang ba yin/ sems gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ba ni dben gsum nyams su myong ba tshun chod na yod la/kun du snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ khams gsum gyi gzugs brnyan stong gzugs snang ba dang / sgron ma 'bar ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ 'od gsal gyi gzi brjid kyis las snang bcil bar byed pa dang / gdung ba med pa'i glog gi 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ 'od gsal rtags bcu la mnyam par bzhag pa'i rang mdangs las sems can rnams kyi sems dang spyod pa yang shes/ de'i sems dang 'phrod pa'i chos kyang shes pa'o/ /rin chen snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni ser po 'bar ba dang / rin chen sgron ma zhes bya ba ni nag po 'bar ba dang / zla ba snang ba zhes bya ba ni dkar po 'bar ba dang / spyi gtsug rnam par blta ba ni sor bsam dngos dang / 'od zer rab tu 'gyed pa ni glog gi snang ba dang / blta bas chog mi shes pa zhes pa ni sangs rgyas kyi gzugs dang / phyogs rnam par lta ba zhes bya ba ni nam mkha' sprin med pa lta bu dang / nam mkha' rgyas par 'gengs pa zhes bya ba ni thig le chen po dang / rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan zhes bya ba ni/ rtsa ba'i stong gzugs gcig shin tu brtan zhing brtsegs pa la stong gzugs du ma 'phro 'du byed pa'am/ rtsa dbu ma'i nang du stong gzugs langs pa dang / dri ma med pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba ni/ rtags bcu la gzung —314—

'dzin med par shes pa dang / 'od mtha' yas pa ni re kha nag po dang / 'od byed pa ni 'od skor rgya cher 'phel ba dang / 'od dri ma med pa ni 'ja' tshon lta bu'i 'od kyi snang ba rgyas pa dang / nyi ma'i sgron ma ni dmar po 'bar ba dang / zla ba dri ma med pa ni thig le'i snang ba dang stong gzugs ro gcig pa dang / snang ba gsal ba ni rtsa rnams thig les gang ba'i snang ba dang / snang ba byed pa ni de las mngon shes 'char ba dang / dge ba'i me tog rgyas shing gsal ba ni yul lnga stong gzugs su thim pas bde ba'i snang ba rgyas te tha mal ba'i 'dod yon la chags pa dag pa dang / sgra dang brda la 'jug pa ni stong pa'i sgra dang las snang gi sgra 'dres pas sems can thams cad kyi skad dang nges tshig shes pa dang / sgra dbyangs dang ldan pa ni gzhom med kyi nā da'i sgra dang / sgron ma 'bar ba ni gtum mo'i 'bar snang stong gzugs ro gcig pa dang/ rnam pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan pa ni rjes dran phan chad kyi stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo dang / nam mkha' dang 'dra ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang glog gi sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni stong gzugs kyi gtum mo glog dang 'dra bas zhu bde 'gyur med kyi dga' bzhi drangs shing / de'i mthar rtsa rlung thig le dbyings nam mkha' dang 'dra bar thim pa ste/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag phan chad yin la/ de dag la sogs pa'i mdo sde dang rgyud sde tha dad nas gsungs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin grangs med pa thams cad rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'dir yongs su 'dus pa yin no/ /de dag ni ting nge 'dzin gyi dbye ba ngo sprad pa ste/ ngo sprod skor dgu pa'o/ /—3/5—

gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje 'bebs pa'i ye shes ngo sprad par bya ste/ dbang gi dus su skal ldan mchog ma gtogs pa gzhan la ni ye shes yud tsam zhig phebs pa las lhag po med cing / dbang don rdzogs rim sgom pa'i skabs 'dir ni dbang po rab 'bring tha ma gang yin yang rung / lam 'di la brten pa'i nyams myong skyes phyin ye shes brtan por mi phebs pa mi srid do/ /de ltar rtsa rgyud las/phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /rdo rje 'bebs pas byin gyis brlabs/zhes gsungs te/ sor bsam la rdo rje 'bebs pa chung ngu / srog 'dzin la 'bring po/ rjes dran la chen po/ ting nge 'dzin la mthar thug pa rdo rje 'bebs pa'i ye shes bzhi po rnams 'byung ngo / /ji ltar 'bab pa'i tshul ni ye shes dbab pa'i skabs kyi rgyud rtsa 'grel dang / rdo rje snying 'grel sogs na gsal te/ lung khungs rnams bris na mangs par 'gyur bas/ don gyi snying po 'di lta bu yin no/ /de yang rnam rtog nub cing / sems gsal stong ngam bde stong la g.yo ba med par gnas pa'i ngang nas/ lus 'phar g.yo dang ngag smra rgod sogs dang ‘re bre snyom bar khro bo'i tshul gyis brdeg pa dang sdigs pa sogs ni/ khro bo rnams kyi sku dang / drag sngags dang / drag tu rgod pa dang / brdegs shig choms shig ces pa'i tshig 'don pa ni khro bo'i gsung dang / cung zad nyams srabs pas mthong thos kyi snang ba mi 'gag cing dogs pa dang 'dzem pa sogs rnam par rtog pa rags pa nub la dpa' ba'i gdeng chen po dang ldan na khro bo'i thugs babs pa'o/ /de dag la yang nang tshan du shin tu stobs dang rmugs byed dang / khengs byed dang / rengs byed dang / rdo rje shugs la sogs pa so so'i dbye ba du ma yod —316—

do/ /zhi ba'i sku phebs pas ni bro gar la sogs pas 'phar ga lnga'i rnam grangs du ma 'gyung / gsung phebs pas ni sa sgri ta la sogs pa yul dang 'gro ba du ma'i skad dang / chos kyi sgra sna tshogs pa 'gyung / thugs phebs pas ni lus ngag g.yo ba med cing sems bde gsal gyi ngang nas phyi nang thams cad rig pa 'byung /ye shes rdo rje phebs pas sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad dam/ ci rigs pa bdag nyid la yod pa snyam byed pa 'gyung / de bzhin du sangs rgyas spyan ma phebs pas/ lus stobs dang ldan pa gzhan gyis g.yo 'gul mi thub pa dang mā ma gī phebs pas rang lus bsil zhing gzhan yang bsal bar byed pa dang / gos dkar mo phebs pas dro zhing rngu pa ba dang / sgrol ma phebs pas shin tu yang zhing rtsal che ba dang / rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma phebs pas mchog la mi snang ba dngos 'grub cing / phal pa la rlung gi rgyu ba chad pa dang / gzhan gyis btsal na mi rnyed pa la sogs pa 'byung / de bzhin du gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa phebs pa'i lkog gyur gyi gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos khams sna tshogs pa shes pa dang / stong pa'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya sngar med mtha' yas pa cig car snang ba dang / rig pa ngang bstan bcos sngar ma bslabs pa shes pa'i snang ba 'byung / des mtshon nas rnam snang phebs pas lus mdog dbyibs sna tshogs su 'gyur ba dang / 'od dpag med phebs pas res 'ga' 'du shes rnam rtog rags/ res 'ga' stong par thim pa 'byung ba dang /rin 'byung phebs pas bde sdug gi tshor ba sna tshogs myong ba dang / don yod grub pa phebs pas las dang bya ba 'grub mi thub pa skad cig gis 'grub pa —317—

dang / mi bskyod pa phebs pas rnam shes lnga bde gsal du 'char ba dang / rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum phebs pa ni gong gi ye shes rdo rje dang gcig go /byang chub sems dpa' drug phebs pas kyang rna ba sogs dbang po drug gi gnas rnams la rnam 'gyur sna tshogs 'byung zhing mngon shes drug po ci rigs par 'char ba dang / khro bo rnams la yang las dbang bya ba dang bcas pa'i rnam 'gyur mang du 'gyung zhing / de dag la brten pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi cha shas ci rigs pa 'char ro/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams babs na thams cad kyi thun mong du bde nyams che zhing khro chags spel mar 'byung / ma mo rnams so so'i nyams dang mthun pa dang / so so'i dam tshig gi rdzas rnams don du gnyer ba sogs 'gyung /de bzhin du tshes kyi lha rnams la yang ste/ srin po'i khro ba dang / me lha'i ji tsam/ zos kyang yog pa dang / tshangs pa'i gti mug dang / drag po'i 'dod chags dang /khyab 'jug gi zhe sdang dang / brgya byin gyi nga rgyal la sogs pa 'char te/ nyon mongs de dang de'i rnam nga can gyi ye shes so/ /de bzhin du sgo skyong rnams babs pas bya ba sna tshogs la 'jug 'dod dang / klu rnams babs pas 'dod pa shas che zhing phra ma'i rnam pa ngang / rab gtum ma rnams babs pas khro gtum shas che ba'i rnam 'gyur dang de bzhin du lha rnams dang gzhal med khang la sogs pa babs pas srid pa gsum po mtha' dag gi rnam 'gyur yang 'gyung ngo / /'dod phyir 'dod ma rnams kyang 'bab par 'gyur te/ sa dang rlung 'dres pas phra ma byed cing dbye bar 'dod pa 'gyung ba la sogs pa/ 'od gsal rnam pa thams cad pa nyid du gdod nas rtag par bzhugs kyang rkyen de dang des mngon du rī—318—

'gyur te/ chu dang rlung ni rnam bsres pas/ /lus can rnams ni 'dar bar 'gyur/ /des grang reg skyes te gos 'dod pa'am lus 'dar ba dang/ rlung dang stong pa rnam bsres pas/ skad cig gis ni thams cad skrod/ /ces pha rol skrod par 'dod pa dang / me dang sa ni rnam bsres pas/ /lus can kun la tsha rim 'gyung / /zhes gdung ba drag po 'dod pa dang / me dang ye shes rnam bsres pas/ /thams cad du ni 'bebs par byed/ /ces ye shes phebs pas 'phar g.yo'i sgo nas lus bskyod par 'dod pa yin/ de bzhin du des gtsang btsog med pas lhag ma za bar yang 'dod do/ /rlung dang me ni rnam bsres pas/ /lus can rnams ni 'gugs pa'o/ /zhes 'gugs par 'dod pa dang / me dang stong pa rnam bsres pas/ /skad cig gis ni rim 'debs 'gyur/ /zhes skems par 'dod pa dang / rlung dang stong pa rnam bsres pas/ lus can rnams ni gsod par 'gyur/ zhes g.yul sprod par 'dod pa dang / sa dang chu ni rnam bsres pas/ /lus can rnams ni rgyas par 'gyur/ zhes rgyas par 'dod pa dang / stong pa'i yi ges dug rnams bskyod/ /ces pa ltar/ chu dang nam mkha' 'dres pas tshig rtsub kyi rgyu khro chags kyi dug zhi nas 'jam par smra bar 'dod pa dang / sa yi dag pas rings par byed/ /ces rengs par 'dod pa dang / sa dang stong pa rnams bsres pas/ lus can rnams ni ltung bar 'gyur/ /zhes sprul la sogs pa ltung ba ste/'ching bar 'dod ma ste de dag la sogs pa 'dod phyir 'dod gzhan rnams phebs pa la yang rigs 'gre ba shes par bya'o/ /mdor na don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bde gsheg snying po'i ngo bor rang nyid la bzhugs pa rnams —319—

rnal 'byor pas lam nyams su blangs pas thugs rgyud bskul te rang la byin gyis brlabs shing ye shes phebs pa'i rnam 'gyur yin pas/ byin gyis rlob byed kyi ye shes pa ni gtso bor rang rgyud kyi de rnams yin la/ slob dpon gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs dang / gzhan rgyud dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis kyang rkyen byed pa ni yin no/ /de ltar na ye shes phebs pa'i nyams 'di kun la yang nyams myong dang man ngag gi rgyus med pas bltas na smyo ba ltar snang ba dang /rgyal ba ltar snang ba dang / na tsha sdug bsngal lta bur snang ba mang du 'byung bas rtsa rlung thig le gegs dang / gdon gyi gnod pa sogs su 'dzin pa yod cing / de dang der bzung na rnam rtog gi skyon gyis gegs su 'gro la/ de dag ye shes su ngo shes pas byung rgyal du bskyangs na rtsa mdud grol zhing / rtsa gnas byang chub kyi sems kyis gang nas/ bde stong gi nyams rgya mtsho lta bur 'gro ba la tshegs med do/ /sbyor drug bsgoms nas nyams kyi ye shes rtag tu phebs par gyur na/gegs sngar yod thams cad las grol zhing / gegs gsar pa 'byung ba med la/yon tan zla ba yar ngo ltar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar na sbyor drug pa'i nyams 'ur ba dang / nyams phebs pa zhes grags pa 'di yang rnam pa thams cad pa'i nang tshan yin pas/ stong gzugs dang gnad gcig la/ nyams phebs tshabs che na/ stong gzugs kyang gsal la mang / stong gzugs mang po 'char/ rtsa bzang po la nyams rtag tu phebs 'ong bas/ 'phral blo ngor yang 'gro ldog gcig tu yod do/ /de dag ni rdo rje 'bebs pa'i nyams ngo sprod pa ste/ ngo sprod skor bcu pa'o/ /da ni 'phros don phra mo 'ga' zhig bshad par bya ste/ gzhan yang stong —320—

pa'i gzugs thams cad la rdo rje'i gzugs/ stong pa'i sgra thams cad la rdo rje'i sgra zhes sogs tha snyad sbyar nas/ stong gzugs dang las snang thams cad la sbyor te/ rdo rje'i don stong pa yin pas snang stong dbyer med yin la/ 'on kyang bden pa gnyis la stong tshul gnyis dang snang tshul gnyis gong ngo sprod drug pa'i skabs su bstan pa ltar ro/ /de bzhin du gnas skabs bzhi'i snang ba la rags pa'i 'o/ da dam snang ba'i 'od gsal zer/ bde ba chen po la rang bzhin gsal/stong gzugs la de kho na nyid kyi 'od gsal zhes 'dogs pa'i skabs kyang yod/yang snang ba'i steng du 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i skabs su 'di skad ces bya ste/ lam bsgoms pas ma dag pa'i snang ba dbyings su dag nas/ gzhi'i gnas lugs mngon du gyur pa la 'bras bur 'jog pa'i gnad kyis/ stong gzugs la rtsol bas mnyam par 'jog pa'i lam gyis las snang ma dag pa'i snang ba de 'od gsal stong gzugs la bsdus pas las snang 'gags te stong gzugs kho na 'char pa yin no/ /zhes dang / yang stong gzugs mthong ba'i dus phyi rol rgyang chad ltar snang ba la/ mig btsum pa'am/ lag pas bkab pa sogs byas nas phyi rol kyi gzugs su grub na de dag gis sgrib dgos pa las/ de la thogs sgrib med pas sems kyi snang ba'o/ /zhes bya ba dang / bsam gtan gyi dga' bde'i yan lag phyogs mthun rgyud la skyes pa la stong gzugs dang bde chen zung 'jug tu dpe'i ngo sprod pa'ang yod de/ rtags snang mi gsal na bde ba shas chung / rtags snang gsal na dga' bde shas che ste/ de dga' bde dang rtags snang ngo bo gcig pa'i rtags yin/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid dang mi —321—

'gyur ba'i bde ba yang 'di lta bu ste/ rang bzhin dbyer med zung 'jug gdod ma'i gshis lugs so/ /zhes sogs brda thabs sna tshogs la brten nas ngo sprod pa gong ma rnams kyi phyag len no/ /de dag la thun dang grangs nges pa med cing /ngo sprod skor gyi rim pa'ang med mod/ sde tshan gcig tu byas pas na le'u'i rim pa bcu gcig par byas na legs so/ /de ltar na rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong nyid phyag rgya chen mo dang / mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po zung du 'jug pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / 'khor lo sdom pa dang / dgyes pa rdo rje dang / gsang ba 'dus pa dang / dus kyi 'khor lo dang / e wa zung 'jug dang / rnam bcu dbang ldan dang / nyi zla kha sbyor dang / chos 'byung la gnas pa'i thig le dang / yang dag par mi bslu ba dang / spros bral dang / bde bar gshegs pa dang / cha med kun 'gro dang / rdo rje sems dpa' ris med pa dang /khyab bdag dang dam pa'i bdag dang / kun khyab bde ba chen lo/ /zhes pa zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi ngo sprod nang ma thun mong ma yin pa zab cing rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos mtha' dag gi nges gsang 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas shin tu gsal bar brjod pa ste/ nags rgyal gyi dben gnas dpal jo nang du'o/ /ngo sprod kyi yi ge 'di kun mkhyen dus gsum sangs rgyas jo nang pa chen po dol po pa shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi dgongs bzhed thun mong ma yin pa ches zab cing gsang ba rnams yin pas/ gzhud lugs mi shes pa rnams la cung zad go dka' bar 'gyur mod/ zab don go dka' ba de kun gyi lugs yin/ grub mtha' phal pas sems khengs pa phal cher gyi blor she/nga dka' bas/ brgyud pa —322—

yi ge bzhugs/na mo gu ra we/ zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor bsgoms pa'i rtags tshad la 'phros nas rtags kyi rnam gzhag rags pa rnams bshad par bya'o/ /'di dag kyang rtsa ba rnams rgyud 'grel las gsal bar gsungs shing / brgyud pa gong ma rnam/sa kyis 'di dag mtha' dag nyams myong gis grub par mdzad la/ da lta'i bar du yang yan lag dang po dngos dang gzhan rnams rjes mthun pa'i dbang du byas na/ nyams myong gi gtso bo gtso bo rnams la rtags thon pa dang yon tan skyes pa'i rgyun ma chad pa'i rim pa can yin no/ /de yang bod yul gyi gdams pa chos gzhan rnams kyi nyams myong rtags tshad rnams da ltar bsgoms pa'i tshe/bshad tshod dang mthun mi mthun ci rigs/ yod cing / chos 'di rnams la rtags rnams 'khrul med nges can du 'byung ba ni/ rgyud dang sems 'grel skor gsum nas man ngag gi rtsa ba thams cad lhag chad med par gsungs pas/ gdams ngag 'di ni rdo rje 'chang bi dgongs pa zur ma nyams pa yin la/ gzhan rnams la ni sems 'grel skor gsum lta bu'i dpang po med cing / rgyud tshig rnams kyang zhal mi gsal zhing gab par yod pas brgyud pa mang po zhig brgyud pa las ma/na ngag gi zur nyams pa'i rgyu las yin no gsungs so/ /de la sngon 'gro dben gsum gyi skabs su mthong nyams dang lus nyams —324—

sogs ni ma nges pa sna tshogs 'byung / dben gsum dang sor sdud kyi skabs ci rigs su/ lus gnad mdun du bub na snying ga'i dbus kyi nā da mdun gyi rlung dang phrad pas shes pa hol le ba 'byung / g.yas su yo na me dang phrad pas 'tshub long ba dang / g.yon du yo na chu dang phrad pas nyog ge ba dang / rgyab tu yo na sa dang phrad pas bying zhing sra 'thas pa'i nyams 'byung / de dag spangs te sgal tshigs bsrangs pas snying lte bar gyi rtsa 'drongs pas srog rlung 'ching / rdo rje skyil krung dang 'og tshags legs por byas pas thur sel dang / mgrin pa dgugs pas gyen rgyu dang / gsum pa mnyam dgang du shugs la yang 'byung ba byed kyang dgos te des mnyam gnas dang / lta stangs kyis mig tu rgyu ba'i rlung dang / mgrin pa bkug nas so mchu rang so dang / lce rtse yar rkan la sbyar bas rna ba'i rtsa yang khyur te 'ong bas rna ba dang lce'i rlung 'ching ba dang / sbyor ba de dang rlung sna nas dal bus btang ba sna'i rlung dang / khu chur brla bzhas lus gram/sa lhod ran par byas pas lus dbang la rgyu ba'i rlung dang / thams cad bsdoms pas khyab byed kyi rlung 'ching ste/ de yang lus gnad kho nas 'ching thub pa rang ta ma yin mod/ lus gnad dang dmigs pa sbyar bas yin no/ /de ltar bsgoms pas/ sems nyams gtso che ba'i dbang du byas na/ nyams gnas skabs dang po ni/ sems skad cig kyang mi gnas shing rnam rtog sngar bas mang ba 'phro rgod ches che ba 'byung / 'ga' zhig gcig rting la gcig breng ma chad cing rigs mi 'dra ba sha stag 'gyung ba'ang yod/ 'ga' zhig yul gcig la brten pa nyid rnam 'gyur mi 'dra tsam gyis yang yang dran yong ba'ang yod/ da sgom mi skye ba yin nam —325—

snyam pa dang / 'di bas gzhan zhig byas na dga' la snyam pa yang 'byung / de ni sngon sgom ma byas pa'i dus na rnam rtog mang yang kha phyi bltas su song nas ngo ma shes/ 'dir kha nang log gis bltas pas 'gyu ba la 'gyu bar rig shas byung ba tsam yin gyi/ rnam rtog sngar las mang du song ba min/ gzhan yang skabs der phar cher la lus gnad ma 'byongs bas lus kyang na zug che/ dbugs 'thums pa dang 'dar ba 'gyung / sems kyang tshig pa za ba dang / gzhan du 'gro 'dod pa dang / gu dog pa'i rnam pa 'byung / sngar gyi nad gzhi rnying pa yod na ldang ba snyam byed/ de ni cung zad sems zin pa'i 'bras bu ste/ g.yo ba zhes bya ba'i nyams yin la/ dpe ri ga zar gyi 'bab chu dang 'dra'o/ /gnas skabs gnyis pa ni/ de dag la skyon yon dga' sdug gang du yang ma bltas par bsgoms pas/ snga ma ltar rnam rtog mang po yod 'phro la cung zad re zhi mal song ba dang / lus dang dbugs kyang bde ba snyam byed/ de'i 'phro la sngar bzhin rnam rtog ldang zhing / lus dang dbugs kyang mi bde ba skye/ de ni thob pa zhes bya ba'i nyams te/ dpe bya tsi tsi mo'am/ rong khung dog po'i 'bab chu dang 'dra'o/ /gsum pa ni da dung bsgoms pas mgo dang ro stod lji ba tsam 'byung /sngar las rnam rtog de phra ru song ba snyam byed cing shugs chung la/ 'phral rang la yal 'gro ba me stag gnam du yar ba lta bu dang / res 'ga' rnam rtog 'char tshad pa la zlog /res 'ga' rnam rtog mi 'gyur bar har re tshom me gsal cha dwangs cha ngar cha med pa la lus yong / de skabs su hur phyung ngar bton te bsgom —326—

pa gal che/ des shes pa gsal dwangs can la lhan lhan gnas pa 'ong / de 'phro la rnam rtog thol lo lo skye de ltar spel mar 'byung ste/ lus nyams ngag nyams sngar bas ches 'jam zhing bde ba'i mgo zin te/ goms pa zhes bya ba'i nyams yin la/ dpe mi rgan po'i spyod lam dang / ri drung gi rdzing bu'am sbal pa mchong pa dang 'dra'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ da dung yun bsrings te bsgoms pas rnam rtog chig skyer ba dang / gnyis bstud gsum bstud thol thol ba 'gyung / phal cher rtse gcig tu 'jam nyal le gsal seng nge gnas/ lus nyams phal cher bde cham pa 'byung /rlung yang phal cher 'jam zhing bde/ res 'ga' sna sgo'i rlung gi reg bya dang sgra shin tu gsal bas sems gnas su mi ster bar sun pa snyam byed res 'ga' rnam rtog 'gyu 'gyu 'dra yang ngos bzung med par lhan ne gnas/ res 'ga' sems btang yang mi 'gro ste/ de ni brtan pa'i nyams zhes bya ba yin/ dpe rus sbal mkhar gzhong du bcug pa dang / mtsho chung ser bus bskyod pa dang / lcags sbugs su chu blug pa lta bu'o/ /lnga pa ni da dung 'bad de bsgoms pas snga ma las kyang lus nyams ngag nyams bde zhing lus yod pa mi shes/ rlung rgyu ba mi tshor ba dang / shes kyang bde sdug med pa'i btang snyoms la gnas te sems mi 'phro ba dang / 'ga' zhig brtags na shes ma brtags na mi shes pa'ang 'byung / sems zhi gnas gcig tu mer gyis song nas/ sems gzhag na sdod/ btang na 'gro/ dgos dus sleb nas rang dbang thob/ sgra drag po sogs phyi'i rkyen byung ba dang / nang gi rtsol pas —327—

sad par byas na ma gtogs thun re thun re 'khyongs pa 'byung te/ mthar phyin pa'i nyams zhes bya ba/ dpe rgyal po 'khor la dbang bsgyur ba dang / ri bo chen po lta bu dang / mtsho chen rlabs dang bral ba lta bu'o/ /de ltar yang g.yo thob goms mthar phyin te/ bsam gtan lam gyi skye tshul yin/ /zhes gsungs/ yang nyams skye tshul lnga po de dag la rim pas/ rnam rtog ngos 'dzin gyi nyams/ dal gso'i nyams/ thang chad kyi nyams/ rlabs bcas kyi nyams/ rlabs dang bral ba'i nyams/ zhes gsungs/ lnga pa 'di 'od gsal rtag bcu'i steng du gnas shing brtan pa thob na/ rkyen drag pos kyang sgom la 'du 'bral mi 'gyung ste/'bras bu 'od gsal la sbyor thub gsung ngo / /de dag la res 'ga' sems mi gsal ba rangs dwangs cha ma rnyed pa 'gyung ste/ de ni zhi gnas lteng sor grags pa bying ba dang 'dres pa'i skyon yin/ phyis skabs shig na de lta bu yang byung rgyal du bskyangs pas mi rtog pa skyon med du 'gro ba yod kyang / re zhig shes pa grims cha thon par byas la spang dgos/ de dag gi bar bar du 'dod yon gyi g.yeng ba sngar byas dran pa ni rgod pa dang / phyis byed 'dod ni 'dod pa la 'dun pa dang / bya nyes phra mo tshun chod la'ang 'gyod pa skye ba dang / chos dang bya ba gang la yang yid gnyis the tshom mang po 'byung ste/ gom la bzhag nas rig pa dwangs po byung ba'i tshe/ de dag gang rung zhig bskyar gyin bskyar gyin blo la 'char bas sems la gnod par 'gyung ste/ phyis skabs shig na de lta bu yang byung rgyal du bskyangs pas gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi grogs su 'gro ba zhig yod kyang / re shig ched du spangs na legs pas/ de dag gi yul rnams bden med sgyu ma lta —328—

bur shes pa dang / rgod 'dun la nges 'byung dang / 'gyod pa la spro ba bskyed pa dang / the tshom la blo thag bcad pa rnams lan kha yar shugs bskyed de bsgoms pas sel/ de dag ni dben gsum dang sor sdud kyi skabs su ci rigs par dgos so/ /dben gsum dang thun mong ba rnams bshad zin to/ /da ni sor sdud kyi nyams rnams bshad bar bya ste/ nang du rlung sems 'gags pa las rtags bcu 'char ba'i tshul ni/ shes rab kyi phyogs la sa rlung dbu mar 'dus pas du ba lta bu ste phyur phyur ba dang / du gdang chags pa lta bu mer re ba dang / spos ring gi du ba lta bu khyur khyur 'gro ba dang / char sprin gsar pa 'dra ba dang / rmugs pa 'thibs pa lta bu 'byung zhing / kha dog ser dkar dmar nag ljang sngo khra bo sogs sna tshogs dang / kha dog gcig pa dang / gnyis ldan gsum ldan bzhi ldan lnga ldan la sogs pa sna tshogs dang / tshad kyang che chung ma nges pa brtan pa dang g.yo ba dang rgyu ba'i tshul kyang gcig tu ma nges pa 'byung ngo / /ngag nyams rlung 'thon dka' ba dang / lus nyams lus brdzi snyam byed/snying ga la sogs pa nas gzhan gyis mnan pa'am btsir ba snyam byed pa 'byung /sems nyams bying rmug shas che rmi nyams du ba rlangs pa 'tshub ma rmugs pa sogs dang / sa'i 'og tu non pa dang / sa phug dang khung du nyal ba sogs 'gyung / chu rlung dbu mar 'dus pas/ smig rgyu lta bu ste shig shig pa dang / chu bo lta bur rgyug pa dang / char zim rlung gis bskyod pa ltar hrib hrib pa 'byung / kha dog dang rgya che chung dang brtan g.yo la sogs pa gong du bshad pa ltar ma nges pa'o/ /lus nyams 'jam la mnyen/ lus bsil ba dang gang ltar 'dug kyang —329—

bde ba'i rnam pa 'gyung sems nyams gnas pa dang rnam rtog res mos su 'gyung zhing / bde mi bde yang res mos su 'char/ rmi nyams su'ang chu bo dang char dang smig rgyu la sogs pa 'byung / me rlung 'dus pas srin bu me khyer lta bu ste/ 'od phra mo tsim tsim mang po nam mkha' la skye zhing yal ba dang / 'phro zhing 'du ba dang /tog yar gyis 'gro ba 'byung / lus nyams drod che ba skabs su rngus dang bcas pa dang / bkres skom gyi snang ba 'byung / ngag nyams su dbugs kha thung / sems nyams su shes pa gsal la 'phro zhing rtsub/ rmi nyams su me'i snang ba mang du 'gyung / rlung gi rlung 'dus pas mar me 'bar ba lta bu ste/ 'od tshad 'bring tsam gsal zhing / 'bar ba yun ring du gnas shing g.yo ba med pa dang / 'dar khril ba 'byung / 'phreng du bsgrigs pa dang / gcig tu cher 'bar ba dang / gcig rting la gcig byung ba sogs mdog dbyibs tshad sogs ma nges pa gong bzhin no/ /lus nyams yang zhing g.yo/ ngag nyams dbugs 'jam zhing dal/dbugs phyi nang du 'gag pa snyam byed/ sems nyams yul yul ba dang / brjed ngas che ba dang / gtad med du cho lang nge 'byung / rmi nyams su rlung tshubs dang bya sogs lding ba dang / rta sogs srog chags rgyug pa'i rnam pa 'byung ste mtshan rtags bzhi'o/ /de ltar bzhi dang / 'og tu 'chad pa'i thig le lnga ni shes rab phyogs kyi 'byung ba lnga 'dus pa yin pas/ khams lnga'i rlung 'dus pa zhes bya'o/ /'di'i 'phros las nam mkha'i rlung 'dus na mchog gi cha lta bu'i rtags skabs 'dir 'byung ngo / /zhes gsungs la/ nyin mtshan gnyis kar gyi thun mong du nam mkha' sprin med pa lta bu'i rtags kyang 'byung ste/ 'di ni nyin rtags —33()—

rnams 'char ba'i gzhi yin pas rtag bcu'i nang du logs su ma bgrangs pa yin no/ /de yang skar khung gi bu ga lta bu dang / glo skar dang / mthongs ka dang /tshags se dang gra mig la sogs pa'i rnam pa 'byung zhing / mthar de dag gcig la gcig 'brel te/ ji yangs je yangs su gyur nas/ nam mkha' mtha' dbus med par 'gro/ kha dog ma nges pa sogs gong dang 'dra/ 'on kyang nam mkha' lta bu'i rtags yin na gang yang mi sgrub cing dwangs pa zhig 'ong ngo thabs kyi phyogs la rlung gi rlung dbu mar 'dus pas ser po 'bar ba'i rnam pa 'byung ste/sprin med pa'i nam mkha' la me 'od kyis khyab pa dang / thab kyi me 'dra ba dang /nags mes tshig pa lta bu'i rnam pa dang / me lce g.yas g.yon du rgyu ba sogs 'byung ste/ 'di yang ser po gtso bo yin la kha dog ma nges pa sna tshogs su 'gyung ba sogs gong dang 'dra/ khyad par mun khang du dmar po shas che ba dang / sprin med kyis mkha' la dkar po shas che ba 'byung zhes gong ma 'ga' zhig gsung /de yang gcig tu ma nges par 'dug cing / lhab lhab 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du byung na/ kha dog ji ltar byung yang rung ser po 'bar ba'i phyogs mthun du bsdu'o/me rlung dbu mar 'dus pas dkar po 'bar ba zhes bya ba zla ba'i rnam pa 'char te 'od dkar po nar rgyug pa dang / glo skar dang / mthongs ka nas zla zer shar ba 'dra ba dang / tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar gyi zla ba'i gzugs sna tshogs pa dang / phyogs thams cad 'od zer dkar pos khyab pa sogs mdor na kha dog dkar po shas che ba'i sna tshogs pa dag 'gyung ste/ skar mda' 'pho ba lta bu dang lcags sgrog ltar sbrel ba dang skya ling ba sogs 'gyung ngo / /chu rlung dbu mar —331—

'dus pas dmar po 'bar ba nyi ma lta bu'i nyams 'gyung ste/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mthong yang ri rtse khang logs sa mthil sogs la nyi 'od 'phog pa lta bu dang / glo skar dang mthongs ka nas nyi mthongs byung ba 'dra ba dang / mun khang gi nang nyin mo ltar mthong ba dang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bu'i 'od zer gsal ba dbyibs dang kha dog ma nges pa dang / 'od zer gsal zhing 'tsher bas mi bzod pa dang / dmar sgo re ba 'od med pa dang / dkyil 'khor ljang khu dang ljang ser sogs 'byung / sa rlung dbu mar 'dus pas nag po 'bar ba sgra gcan gyi nyams 'byung ste/ rin po che nag po lta bu dang / mig gi rnam pa lta bu dang /mtshan mo'i sprin dang rmugs pa bzhin nag ling ling ba dang / nag bun bun pa dang / nag sgor sgor ba dang / nag ril ril ba sogs dwangs shing sgrib pa med pa che chung mang nyung ma nges pa dang kha dog kyang nag po shas che ba'i kha dog ma nges pa sna tshogs 'byung zhing / ltos 'gro'i dbyibs dang khro zhal gyi rnam par snang ba kun kyang skabs 'dir 'byung zhes gong ma 'ga' zhig gsung / steng phyogs na gnas pa nam mkha'i rlung 'dus pa las mchog gi cha ste/ glog 'od kyi rnam pa 'gyung ba ni/ dang por 'od khyug khyug pa dang / de nas 'od chem chem pas khyab pa snga ma las yun ring ba dang / mthar goms na 'od chem me ba zhig gis khyab pa'i ngang nas 'od phra mo mang po g.yo zhing 'byug pa 'gyung ngo / /de ltar lnga po de rnams thabs kyi phyogs 'byung ba lnga 'dus pa yin pas/ phung po lnga'i rlung 'dus pa zhes bya'o/ /'og tu ye shes kyi khams kyi rlung 'dus pa las thig le'i rnam pa 'byung ste/ kha dog sngon po gtso bo yin kyang gcig tu ma nges ste/ kha dog drug po re re —332—

dang / gnyis ldan nas drug ldan gyi bar du 'gyung zhing / thig le'i nang stong pa dang / nang thig le rang dang mdog 'dra bas gang ba dang / kha dog mi 'dra ba sna tshogs pas gang ba dang / dbyibs dang che chung ma nges par 'byung / de ltar nyin rtags drug la shas cher mthun par lus nyams 'jam zhing bde ba/ lus yod du mi tshor ba dang / ngag nyams rlung rgyu ba mi mngon pa tsam dang / sems nyams gsal stong rtog med du sing nge gnas pa 'byung zhing / skabs 'dir g.yang za ba snyam byed pa'i 'jigs pa dang / gang yang med snyam pa 'byung zhes kyang gong ma kha cig gsung / de ltar rtags bcur grags pa la/ du ba la sogs pa so so'i ming dang rnam pa mthun par 'char ba de la lus nyams sogs thams cad tshang ba go rim nges can du byung na nges pa'i rtags dang / phyogs mthun snang ba gzhan 'char ba de la ma nges pa'i rtags zhes tha snyad sbyor bar mdzad de/ ma nges pa'i rtags de yang 'di ltar sa rlung dbu mar chud pas ri rab khang khyim la sogs pa dang / chu rlung la mtsho dang 'bab chu la sogs pa dang / me rlung la me 'bar ba la sogs pa dang / rlung gi rlung la 'tshub ma dang ser bu la sogs pa'i snang ba dang /nam mkha'i rlung la nam mkha' dang / bar snang dang / phug stong sogs sbubs stong pa dang / ras yug sngon po brkyang pa 'dra ba sogs sna tshogs 'byung / gzhan yang sbrang gshog la nyi zer phog pa 'dra ba sogs dang / 'ja' 'od phra mo dang /skya khyam khyam sogs 'bar ba dang zla ba'i rnam pa ci rigs su bsdu ba dang /gsor mig lta bu dang sngo ljang sogs nyi mar bsdu ba dang / shing sdong gi grib ma 'dra ba dang / thag pa dang srad bu nag po sogs sgra gcan dang / sog mda' —333—

'phangs pa 'dra ba kha dog ma nges pa phra mo rgyug pa 'byung ba ni glog dang / kha rlangs lta bu dang mig la skor ba byed pa lta bu dang / bya lding ba 'dra ba sogs thig le'i rigs su gtogs zhes gsung zhing / nyams gzhan yang ci rigs pa la/ lus nyams 'gul snying mi 'dod pa dang / ngag nyams lce sgyur ba dka' zhing smra mi 'dod/ sems nyams gsal la brtan pa gzhan du mi 'phro ba rnams sa rlung gi byed pa yin/ lus nyams 'jam mnyen shed chung ba/ sems nyams dga' shas che ba la res 'phro rgod thung res ting nge 'dzin bzang na chu khams kyi nus pa yin/ ha cang 'phro rgod che na glod pas phan/ lus nyams khong pa'i nang nas me 'bar ba lta bu dang / du bas tshubs pa 'dra ba dang / shin tu skam dang che ba dang / sems nyams blo rgod la rtsub cing spro thung / rmi nyams su'ang mes tshig pa sogs byung na me khams kyi byed pa yin/ spro thung ba la'ang slod pas phan/lus nyams rlung gis khyer ba snyam byed/ nam mkha' la 'gro ba snyam byed/ dngos su'ang lus gnad ma zhig par ring du 'phar ba 'byung / sems nyams su gsal stong shas che/ nam mkha'o la lding zhing yod pa snyam byed na rlung khams kyi byed pa yin/ lus nyams lus med par snyam byed cing / sems nyams sa rdo ri brag sogs thogs bcas 'di rnams thams cad sangs pa'am cha shas ci rigs ci rigs nas sangs te/ rang nyid nam mkha'i dbyings ya gi na yod pa snyam byed pa byung na mkha' khams kyi byed pa yin no/ /gnyid kyi 'od gsal ni/ dang por gnyid 'thug gi skabs su gsal stong gi nyams skyong thub pa tsam 'ong la/ res 'ga' nam langs pa dang / 'od kyi —334—

khyab pa snyam byed/ rig pa gsal ba/ khams dwangs pa/ gnyid du ma song ba 'dra ba la sad rgyu yod pa/ sad ma thag mun khang stong gzugs kyis khyab pa dang /gzhom med kyi sgra rjas mthun par tshor ba'ang yod/ gnyid la 'gro dus sa la bying ba snyam byed/ 'od khyug khyug pa 'ong / rna bar sgra tsi rong gi 'ong / 'od gsal ngos ma zin gong du gnyid mi bde ba dang / 'dre gnon 'dra ba dang / lus sbrid pa 'ong myur du zin pa'i rtags yin/ de nas gsal stong ngang rim pas bde ba 'char ro/ /ma nges pa'i rtags 'di dag sor sdud nas bsam gtan dngos gzhi'i bar du nam yong nges pa med do/ /khyad par rdo rje 'bebs pas byin gyis brlab pa zhes bya ba dang por sems mi rtog par cung zad gnas shing / rtags snang ci rigs par mthong ba nas gzung ste/ sems mi rteg pa la rang shugs su gnas pa'i ngang nas/ lus nyams drag po 'dar ba dang g.yo ba dang 'phar ba dang rgyug pa dang bro gar byed pa la sogs pa dang / ngag nyams drag po smra ba dang rgod pa dang ngu ba dang glu len pa dang sngags kyi tshig dang ku co 'don pa sogs 'byung ste/ dang po gsal stong tsam gyi ngang nas 'byung la/ phyis ni bde nyams chen po dang bcas te 'byung ba/ de yang mnyam bzhag gi ngang nas byed 'dod rtog pa med par 'byung ste mi rtog pa 'thug pos non pas so/ /yang rjes thob tu sems nyams sna tshogs pa 'byung ba ni/ dga' ba dang skyo ba dang khro zhing 'tshig pa dang rgyug par 'dod pa sogs sna tshogs pa ste 'dod ma dang phyi 'dod ma sum cu rtsa drug po rnams kyi ye shes kyi cha shas babs pa dag yod la/ nyams de thams cad byung rgyal du bskyangs pas gegs dang skyon las rang sar grol nas —335—

yon tan gong 'phel du 'gyur ba yin no/ /de rnams sor sdud dang thun mong pa yin la/ spyi ldog nas nyams myong dang yon tan yar ldan du 'byung ba'i gong ma rnams la'ang 'di dag thams cad 'gyung ngo / /so sor sdud pa'i skabs su 'gyung ba rnams bshad zin to/ /de nas bsam gtan bsgoms pas rtags bcu'i tha ma thig le'i nang du rtags gzhan dgu yang re re dang / gnyis ldan nas dgu ldan bcu ldan gyi bar du rim gyi rim gyis 'char bar 'gyur zhing rtags bcu char tshang ba'i thig le de la ni/ thig le chen po'i snang ba zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang bsam gtan bsgoms pas sor sdud kyi dus kyi rtags snang gi rgyu rnams chos lnga ldan du 'gyur zhing nges pa kho nar rags pa rnams shin tu phra bar 'gyur ro/ /des na phal cher la rtags snang thog ma phra rags gang yin yang cung zad mi gsal zhing bar du rags la gsal ba dang / mthar phra zhing gsal ba 'byung ba yin kyang / 'ga' zhig la sngar gyi rtags snang rags pa de bsam gtan bsgoms pas phra mor song ba'i mtshams su rtags snang nub te/ sgom stor ba srid pas de la rjes dran du bshad pa'i yid kyi phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor cung zad tsam dang rlung bum can bsres te mi g.yo gsum ldan bsgoms pas rtags snang slar yang shar 'ong la/ sngar gyi rgyu la rtags snang cung zad yod na/ bsam gtan gyi spogs chog bzhin bsgoms pas sor chud 'ong ste/ phal cher la mtshams de nas phra zhing gsal la brtan pa'i rtags snang 'byung ngo / /thig le'i snang ba la dbus su sems gtad na phra bar 'gyur zhing / mtha' la gtad na che bar 'gyur ba ni stong gzugs gzhan la'ang —336—

rigs 'gre ste/ rags pa la brtan pa ma thob kyi bar du de ltar byas kyang yod do/ /gzhan yang stong gzugs kyi gsal cha dang spros bral dbyer med de la mnyam par gzhag pa goms pas/ sems gnas na stong gzugs gnas/sems g.yo na stong gzugs g.yo/ sems gnas tsa na mthong bya mthong byed tha dad par snang ba mngon gyur 'gags pa ni shes rab kyi yan lag rgyud la skyes pa'i tshad yin/ de'i tshe sems gang du gtad gtad du stong gzugs ci rigs pa re 'char ro/ /thig le chen po la mnyam par gzhag pas dmar ser la sogs pa kha dog gnyis 'dres kyi rnam pa dwangs shing gsal ba zhig gi dbus su/ dang po dbu phyag la sogs pa sku'i cha shas tsam 'byung zhing / de je gsal la lha'i sku rnam pa yongs rdzogs su rdzogs pa 'char ro/ /yang bsam gtan shin tu brtan pa mthar phyin na/ sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku gzugs de yang yul nges pa thig le'i dbus dus nges pa mnyam rjes thams cad/ rnam pa nges pa mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs pa ste/ nges pa gsum ldan du 'gyur ro zhes dang /de rjes re khu nag po yang mthong ngo zhes bla ma gong ma 'ga' zhig gsung la/bdag gi rnam par rtog pa ni/ bsam gtan du ni mnyam bzhag tu sangs rgyas kyi gzugs mthong ba tsam yin la/ mnyam rjes thams cad du 'char ba ni sor bsam mthar phyin nas srog rtsol mngon du gyur pa'i tshe 'byung ste/ der byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mchod ces bya ba la sogs rgyu mtshan du ge'o/ /yang kha cig 'di snyam du/ 'o na rnam pa kun ldan rang sems yul dang rnam par bral ba dag go /zhes pa'i skabs na 'grel par/ gzhan sems ma yin te/ gzhan —337—

sems shes pa med pa'i phyir/ /zhes re khwa nag po'i rtags mthong nas kyang gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes med par bshad la/ bsam gtan mthar phyin na mngon shes lnga kar thob pa yin pas rtags de rnams thams cad sor sdud dam bsam gtan gyi gung yan chad la rdzogs pa yin no/ /zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar ma yin te/ spyi stong gzugs 'di rang sems yin te/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes med pas kyang shes shing nyams su myong ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes spyi ldog nas stong gzugs ni bem po dang med bzhin snang ba yin par 'dod pa gzhan du bkag zin pas/ shes pa yin par sgrub pa las shes pa'i nang nas gzhan sems ma yin zhing rang sems kyi snang ba yin pa'i sgrub byed du de ltar gsungs pa yin gyi/ sangs rgyas gzugs dang re kha nag po mthong ba'i dus mngon shes med ces pa'i go ba yī rang ma yin no/ /yang spyir rtags snang thams cad rtags bcur 'dus par sbyor drug gi mkhas grub chen po thams cad kyi bzhed pa bzhin don la gnas la/ de las kho bo cag gi bla ma mkhas grub rgya gar ba 'ga' zhig 'di skad gsung ste/ dper na stong gzugs la ma ga dha'i yul ljongs lta bu zhig mthong ba la/ ljongs de yud tsam mi g.yo la/ de nas sangs 'gro na sprin dang 'dra ba ste du rtags rags pa yin/ ri nags grong khyer sogs cha shas rags sa rags sa nas g.yo zhing skye 'jig byed pa ltar snang na du rtags dngos yin/ cha shas phra mo nas g.yo na smig rgyu'i rtags yin/ 'od dang bcas pa g.yo zhing skye 'jig yang yang byed na me khyer gyi rtags yin/ 'od dang bcas te mi g.yo bar 'dug na mar me'i rtags yin/ de rnams gcig gis ga—338—

cig bsgrub pa'i dbang du byas na/ phan tshun mi sgrib par dwangs gsal du 'dug na nam mkha'i rtags su bsdu/ des gzhan la'ang rigs 'gre ba yin no gsung /de ltar na thog mar dge ba'i 'khrid kyi nyams myong rgyud la skyes pas gang zag des ni don dam pa'i bum dbang dngos thob pa yin te/ de bzhi du/ bar dges gsang dbang dang / rjes dran gyis sher dbang dang / ting nge 'dzin gyis don dam pa'i dbang bzhi pa dngos thob ces gsungs pa'ang rnam grangs kyi sgo nas de ltar yin la/ spyi ni sor sdud rkyang pa rgyud la skyes pas kyang dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes thun mong ma yin pa ci rigs par rgyud la skyes pa yin la/ rigs mthun rdzogs par ni ting nge 'dzin mthar phyin pa na'o/ /bsam gtan gyi rim pa dang 'brel ba rnams bshad zin to/ /thog mar dge ba'i nyams myong khyad par can skyes pas rtsa bzang ba 'ga' zhig la srog rtsol sgos su ma bsgoms kyang / rlung dbu mar chud nas gegs med yon tan phun sum tshogs pa skyes pa'ang yod/ bum pa can ched kyis ma bsgoms kyang rang shugs kyis bum pa can grub pa'ang yod/ gtsug tor du rlung sems 'dus pas rdo rje bslang ba'i bde ba khyad par can thob pa'ang yod/rlung dbu mar 'dus pa tsam dang rdo rje bslang ba'i nyams phyogs mthun las srog bsdud kyi 'pho ba'i gegs dang 'dzag gegs su 'gyur pa'ang srid/ rtsa 'bring ba man chad la sor bsam tsam gyis de rnams mi 'byung ste/ sor bsam gyis rjes su srog rtsol bsgoms na/ lte bar drod skye/ smin mtshams su bde ba'i zug dang /spyi bo za 'khrig g.ya' ba sogs 'byung ste/ rlung sbyor ci rigs pa bsgoms pas —339—

gtum mo cung zad 'bar ba'i rtags yin/ me stobs chung / thig le stobs che na/mgo dang mig rus mi bde/ byad sha 'gyur/ langs na mgo 'khor/ me stobs che na 'ga' zhig la 'dzag gegs 'byung nyen yod pas/ rlung sbyor gyis bsal dgos/ rlung dbu mar 'jug tu nye na rtags snang rnams dbang po'i sgo nas 'tshang ba dang / ba spu'i sgo nas 'jug pa sogs 'byung / me stobs chung ba la rlung gyen du song bas spyi bo'i thig le 'khyags pa'i rtags su rtags snang nam mkha' la 'khor ba dang gyen du 'gro ba shas che khams ngan par 'gyur/ me stobs che bsta (spyi bo'i thig le zhu na rlung yang cung zad mar zlog pas rtags rnams kyang phya / spong du thur du 'gro khams bzang bar 'ong bde nyams kyang gong 'phel gaṇ+ḍa gro/rtags snang nam mkha' lding ba de ha cang thal na gtsug tor gyi sgo phug nas 'pho nyen yod pas dbab par bya'o/ khyad par nges pa can du rdor bzlas dang 'jam rlung sbrags pas snying tsha mgo bo na smin mtshams 'dus shing bcus pa dang 'khyil pa snyam byed/ sems gsal stong 'od gsal du thim/ 'od kor dang bcas pa'i rtags snang rang gi lus la nye bar 'khor/ gnyid rnams rang sangs la song /rlung gi rgyu ba dang rnam pa cung zad mthong / mig na gtsug tor za 'khrig sogs gong du bshad pa bzhin byung na/ rlung dbu mar chug ni thub/ da lta bcing ma thub pa'i rtags nges pa can yin/ de 'bad rtsol gyis drag por bsgom na zug gzer rnams sngar bas cher 'gro/ smin mtshams yan chad sbrid cing med pa snyam byed/de nas 'od kor rang gi lus kyi nang du ga bor ba ཿnga ngo / /spyir 'od kor dma' sa nas langs te/ gyen du drag por 'khor ba de shin tu bzang ba yin —34()—

no/ /de yan chad tsam la bum can gyis dbu mar bcug na 'bebs pa sogs ma byas kyang 'pho ba'i gegs su mi 'gyur ba shas che gsung ngo / /byed bcings log pa'am/ de las kyang thal na rtags snang sangs/ thog pa'i 'du shes nub/gzugs med bzhi dang phyogs 'dra rung gi ting nge 'dzin skye/ 'di skabs dang por dal bus 'bebs mang du byas nas/ mthar 'bebs drag pos phab na srog bsdud kyi gegs sel bar 'gyur/ de las cung zad thal nas brgyal ba ltar song na 'bebs drag po 'ba' zhig gis 'bebs/ 'jug tu 'phar g.yo 'dar sprug smyo 'bog lta bu ring du byung ba'i mthar sel 'gro'o/ /'pho ba'i gegs 'og tu 'byung ba rnams kyang rim pa 'di /bo na dang 'dra bas tshod bzung zhing bsal lo/ /rdor bzlas la rlung 'jam zhing phra la ring/ rgyu ba mi tshor shes pa gsal/ rmi lam 'jam nyal song / stong gzugs gsal zhing 'tsher la phra sil 'gro na yon tan shar ba yin/ 'jam rlung dang rdor bzlas la mnyam rgyu'i skabs su phyir 'gro je thung dang gnas pa je ring bya/ 'jam rlung ma byang bar du ha cang drag na nu ma sbos yong ba dang / dal bus mnan par shugs grags na mgo dang ro stod na yong ba'ang srid/ 'jam rlung la lte bar kog kog zer/ spyi bo za/ dpral ba 'bul yong / spyi bor bu ga zang thal dod yong ba'ang srid/ de glod cing 'bebs dgos/ goms na mthong snang thams cad ljang mer 'gro/ sku dang thig le ljang khu phra mo dang / yon tan 'char tshul snga ma dang 'dra ba las ches bzang ba 'char ro/ /lus chu lud pa ltar 'phyar ba'i nyams dang / rmi ltas ri la 'bab 'dzeg dang / 'phur ba dang / rta rgyug pa sogs 'gyung /—341—

'byongs na rmi lam 'jam zhing / zin sbyong spel sprul rnam thar sogs shugs la 'byung ngo / /de nas srog rtsol dngos gzhi la/ stong gzugs rags la gsal ba de 'jug dka' ste 'ching sla/ phra zhing gsal ba de 'jug sla ste 'ching dka'/ mi gsal na/ 'jug pa dang / 'ching ba gnyis ka la dka' zhing bogs chung ba yin no/ /rtsub rlung bum pa can bsgoms pas/ rtsa bzang na gegs med par yon tan skye mod kyang phal cher la sdug bsngal gyi nyams re thog mar 'gyung bas rlung cig car 'du na lus rang dbang med par 'dar/ glo bur du drod skye/ nyams snang rnams khra chem pa dang dmar thing ba'i ngang nas lus 'gyel zhing dran med du brgyal ba sogs 'byung / rlung rim gyis 'jug na stong gzugs rang la 'khor/lus bstums shing bsgril ba 'dra ba dang / rlung subs 'gro ba lta bu 'byung / de nas cung zad goms pas bde sdug spel mar 'gyung ste/ de yang goms na mthar btang snyoms su 'gro/ gong du bshad pa'i rtags snang thams cad 'byung ba'i steng du sa rlung 'chings na/ lus gnad bshig snying mi 'dod rtsub la lci ba dang / snang ba ser por snang / chu 'chings na grang la mnyen pa dang chu'i snang ba 'char ba shas che/ lar chu la grang dro gnyis ka'ang 'byung / me 'chings na drod 'bar zhing me'i snang ba 'byung / rlung 'chings na lus yang zhing 'phar ba dang / rlung po'i snang ba 'byung / nam mkha'i rlung 'chings na/ sngo yam pa dang / bde sing ba dang /lag pas byug pa sogs ched du reg na ma gtogs lus yod par mi mngon zhing / bu ga'i rigs dang / bar snang dang / steng 'og phyogs mchams stong par —342—

— sdi —tral ri ba re snang ba 'byung / nam mkha'i nang tshan du ye shes kyi cha la ljang khu dang khra cha / 1 ca ba 'byung ba'ang yod/ de 'dra re re la'ang mthar rtags snang thams cad thig le la 'dus nas lus kyi dbus su thim 'gro na gnad du song ba yin/ de ltar 'byu/nga ba cha mnyam du zhugs na gegs mi 'byu nga la/ cha ma snoms na rtsub nyams su 'char te/ de thal na gegs su 'gro/ de yang sa rlung zin na rlung gi stobs zad/ smra brjod mi thub g.yo 'gul mi shes pa lta bu dang / sa la bying ba dang / gzhan gyis mnan pa dang / bying rmug la sogs par 'gyur/ me zin na sa'i stobs nyams te/ me char 'bab pa sogs tshig pa'i snang ba dang / rdzus che zhing lus gcig tu mi zug /chu zin na me nyams pas khong 'dar/ grang shum byed/gangs ri dang rba rlabs kyi gseb tu shor ba snyam 'byung / shes pa dran pa mi gsal bkol du mi btub pa 'byung / rlung 'phel na chu nyams te 'gros mgyogs shing lus yang / 'gro snying 'dod/ sems bzung kyung mi zin pa yong /nam mkha' thams cad kyi grogs yin yang / nam mkha' kho na 'phel pas g.yangs za zhing skyo shas che bar 'byung / de dag kyang phal cher byung rgyal du bskyangs shing / lus la nad khams 'phel bar 'dug na gegs sel gyis bcos/ de lam du bsrang zhing bskyangs pas gtum mo 'bar ba'i snang ba cung zad 'byung zhing / /bde nyams gong 'phel du 'gro ste/ 'di dag skabs 'dir rdor bzlas dang / 'jam rlung dang bum can rnams rim can du bsgom pa'i dbang du byas nas bshad pa yin la/ spyir nas rtags rim pa gsum po de rnams rtsa lam byang ba dang / dbu ma'i sgor 'dus pa dang / dhū tar 'a 'ching ba'i rtags kyi —343—

rim pa tsam yin pas bum can lta bu gcig dang ponas mthar yun bsrings/ cedi bsgoms pas kyang rtsa lam byang ba dang / dbu mar 'dus pa dang / der 'ching ba rnams rim pas 'grub pas rtags 'di rnams thams cad yong ngo / /rtsa chad gsos pas dang por mtshon gyis 'bugs pa dang / sems can gyis rmugs pa 'dra ba'i lus nyams dang / lus kyi nang du srog chags rgyug pa 'dra ba'i nyams snang dang / dog 'tshang byed pa'i rmi nyams 'byung / rtsa chad 'bring po rnams gsos pas bgangs pa 'gril ba 'dar sprug 'phar 'khrig zug rngu dang bcas pa yong /rtsa chad phra mo rnams gsos pas/ tsha tseg tseg pa sogs zug chang chung mang po ldang / 'di dag gang du 'gyung ma nges te/ rtsa chad ci rigs pa gsos pa yin no/ /de nas bar skabs su btang snyoms dang bde nyams shas che bar 'byung /yang bar skabs zhig nas rlung gis rtsa gang ni gang la/ dbyings su thim ma thub pas srog thur 'dres pa'i rlung stobs su gyur te/ gong du bshad pa lta bu'i 'pho ba'i gegs shig 'byung nyen yod/ rtags rnams gong du bshad pa dang 'dra zhing /rtsa rlung cung zad byang ba'i skabs yin pas 'pho ba dang 'bebs po gnyis ka sngar las bla'o/ /bum pa can dbu ma'i nang du nyin zhag gcig 'ching bar nus na nad mtha' dag 'byang zhing tshe la cung zad dbang ba yin la/ yang srog thur 'dres pa'i tshad la phyi rtags 'og rlung kha snar thon na thur sel srog la 'dres/ dri bzang kha snar rngub pa 'og sgo nas ma nyams par 'thon na srog thur sel la 'dres pa zer te/ 'di rtsa nang du 'dres pa ni ma yin/ khog nang tsam du phyi la rgyu ba'i srog thur rags pa 'di 'dres pa tsam yin pas rmongs pa ngo mtshar bskyed —344—

pa'i rtags tsam yin/ nang rtags steng bzung na 'og 'thems/ 'og bzung na steng 'thems pa yin te/ rtsa nang ci rigs par 'dres pas na snga ma las bzang ngo / /gsang rtags 'bar snang dang bde drod dngos su skye ste ches mchog rtsa dbu mar srog thur 'dres pa yin no/ /srog rtsol gyi rim pa'i phyed phyi ma'i skabs 'dir srod gzugs phal pa 'grub pa yin te/ lnga phyi ni ci rigs su yod do/ /gzhan yang thig le bzhi'i snang ba las 'khor 'das kyi chos mtha' dag 'char te/ grub mtha' bzhi'i lta ba dang / mu stegs byed kyi rgyud bzhi dang / rig byed bzhi dang / sde pa bzhi dang / gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi la sogs pa'i lha'i snang ba dang / sngags kyi snang ba dang / tshig don rnam par 'byed pa'i blo gros dang / lta spyod sgom gsum gyi nyams mtha' yas pa 'byung la/ dud 'gro mi lha dmyal ba la sogs pa'i gnas lus longs spyod kyi snang ba dang / bde sdug la sogs pa'i tshor ba dang nyon mongs pa'i khyad par mtha' yas pa snang ste/ sngon gyi man ngag pa rnams la gnas sbyong du grags pa dag yin la/ mdor na sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba rnam pa thams cad pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis shes bya la srid tshad snang ba yin zhing / des na 'od gsal bde gshegs snying po'i ngo bo ni dus rtag tu cig car rnam pa thams cad pa yin kyang rnal 'byor pa'i blo'i mthong tshul la rnam pa de dang de 'char ba'i rkyen re dang phrad pa'i tshe snang ba yin pas na sna tshogs pa rnams rim can du snang ngo / /rkyen de yang gang zhe na/ nang gi rtsa rlung thig le'i 'phro 'du'o/ /sems kyi snang cha nyid rtsa dang rlung dang thig le sna tshogs su snang zhing / sna tshogs su snang ba de rnams kyang sems nyid thig le —345—
