bzhir snang ba la brten nas byung ba yin pas rnam pa thams cad pa'i khongs su rtsa rlung thig le'i 'du 'phrod kyang 'dus pa yin pas de dag rnam pa thams cad pa'i 'char sgo las gzhan du mi bsam mo/ /'on kyang kun rdzob rten 'brel snang tshul la bltos nas lus kyi thig le dpral ba na gnas/ gnyid sad dus kyi snang ba rags pa thams cad des bskyed/ ngag gi thig le mgrin pa na gnas/ rmi lam dang bar do la sogs pa'i snang ba thams cad des bskyed/ yid kyi thig le snying ga na gnas/ gnyid 'thug po dang brgyal ba dang 'chi ba la sogs pa'i gnas skabs thams cad des bskyed/ bzhi pa'i thig ‘spe lte ba na gnas/ gnyis sbyor la sogs pa'i chags pa dang / yul bzang ngan bar ma gsum la sred cing rmongs pa rnams des bskyed/ de bzhin du rtsa 'khor gzhan la'ang sbyar du yod de/thig le bzhi po de nyid dri ma dang bcas pa ni gzhi dus kyi 'khor lo'i zhal bzhi yin la/ sgrib pa phyed tsam dag pa na lam dus kyi 'khor lo'i zhal bzhi dang /shin tu sgrib bral gyi gnas skabs su 'bras bu dus kyi 'khor lo'i zhal bzhi'o/ /rgyud las dus kyi 'khor lo'i zhal bzhi las 'khor 'das thams cad sprul par gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'i gtso bo'i 'di yin la/ der gsungs pa'i bzhi tshan rnams kyis kyang nges par bskyed par bya'o/ /srog rtsol gyi rim pa dang 'brel ba rnams bshad zin to/ /'dzin pa'i skabs su rtags thun mong ma yin pa rnams kyi khyad par 'di ltar shes dgos te/ rtags kyi rgyu ni srog thur 'dres pa la brtan pa thob pas gtum mo 'bar rtsa kha thams cad dros/ rtsa thig thams cad glum langs pa ltar —346—

kho' zhing sa gas/ rtsa mdud thams cad mes dral thig le rnams gnas so sor 'bar zhing g.yo/ khams rnams yar mar du 'du zhing steng 'og tu cung zad gang ba rnams yin la/ rtags dngos ni dbu ma'i nang du phra zhing phra ba'i re ji nag po nā da'i rnam pa can dang / rta rnga zlum por bkug pa lta bu'i thig le'i rnam pa can 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'bar ba/ re ji phra mo'i nang na rtas sa bcu kar rdzogs par 'char zhing / sku gzugs la sogs pa dag pa dang ma dag pa'i snang ba sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa zhig 'byung ba de yang dha ti'i nang du gtum mo 'bar ba'i 'bar snang gi dbus su 'byung ba yin/ gtu pa mo 'bar ba'i me'i kha dog kyang sna tshogs 'byung la/ re 'a yang nag po gtso bo yin pas smos kyi/ gzhan du na kha dog sna tshogs pa'o/ /de na las 'phro can ma gtogs/ sor sdud ci la thig le'i dbus su sku gzugs res 'ga' 'char ba dang / gzhan yang rim pa dang po gsum pa re sku nag po 'dra rud 'char srid kyang ma nges pa'i rtags yin par shes par bya'o/ /'dzin pa'i rtogs pa skyes pa'i skabs 'dir srog gzugs khyad par can 'grub pa yin te/ de yang sngar gyi sangs rgyas kyi gzugs brnyan de nyid shin tu brtan par gyur pas stong gzugs dang srog thur gong bu gcig pa'i rlung 'dres pa de blos brtags pa la ma bltos par lha sku mtshon dpe can gyi rnam pa dang por gcig 'char ba nas brtsams te je mang rje 'phel du 'gyur mdog dbyibs mtshan ma ni ma nges te/ kha cig la ni rnam pa gcig nyid rtag tu 'char ba'ang yod/ kha cig la ni 'phral 'phral 'gyur bar snang ba'ang yod pa dang /spyir phyi nang thams cad du 'char ba yin yang dhū ti'i nang du 'char ba ni mar me —347—

lta bu/ gzhan rnams mar me'i 'od lta bu'o/ /'di ni srog dbu ma'i thig le la lan gcig thim pa nas 'byung ste mthar brtan pa thob nas las tshogs sna tshogs pa 'grub bar 'gyur ro/ /dper na srog dang 'dres pa'i stong gzugs kyi lha de nyid snying gar chu'i dkyil 'khor dang u yig tu gyur te/ lha yab g.yon pad+ma dkar po dang / yum g.yon ut+pal dkar po 'dzin pa/ gnyis ka'ang g.yas mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ glang po che sa srung la zhon pa bsgrub bya'i khyim du spros nas zhi rgyas kyi las byed par bsams pas gang blos bsgyur ba der 'gyur te/ stong gzugs de yang de lta bu'i rnam par song ba na snying gi bum can la 'bad pas/ de ma thag tu zhi rgyas kyi lus thogs pa med par 'grub bo/ /de bzhin du rtsa 'khor dang gdan 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dang sa bon dang lha'i sku mdog phyag mtshan dang bzhon pa rnams sde kha bsgyur bas las gzhan thams cad kyang 'grub bo/ /de bzhin du zad par rnams kyang 'grub par bshad do/ /dper na lte ba'i '-i yig las sa'i zad par zam pa lta bu spros te/ lte ba'i bum can la 'bad pas chu bo'am rgya mtsho'i steng nas mi bying bar 'gro ba la sogs pa'o/ /nyer 'tshe gzhom pa phra mo gzhan yang bshad de/ /mgrin par me'i dkyil 'khor la ra yig las byung ba'i seng ger gyur zhing / seng ge spros pas glang po che rnams bskrad par bsams te/ /mgrin pa'i bum can byas na glang po che'i nyer 'tshe bzlog pa la sogs pa dud 'gro gdug pa can rnams dang / lha min dang 'gyung po sprod par byed pa sogs mdor na phyi nang gi rten 'brel ma nor bar bsgrigs pas bsam pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /skabs 'dir —348—

gzhom med kyi nā da'i sgra dbyangs kyang 'byung bar 'gyur te/ dang por dha khi nang du stong pa'i sgra tsam grag pa byung na/ de nyid gong 'phel du song nas thre drag po 'brug sgra lta bu la sgra gzhan phra mo sna tshogs pas bskor ba lta bu 'byung / de nas mi ring ba na dus cig car du srog chags sna tshogs pa'i chig 'dra ba dang //'byung ba sna tshogs pa'i sgra dang / gtam sna tshogs pa dang / chos/ kyi skad sna tshogs pa mang po sgra gcig las grub pa 'byung ngo / /las dang po pas srog 'jin rjes mthun pa sgom pa'i skabs dag tu me shas che na thig le 'bab pa'i snang ba dang / lus drod che ba dang / rngus chu 'bab pa ltar 'byung / lce'u chung las thig le 'bab pa tshor ba sogs 'byung ste/ 'ga' zhig la 'dzag gegs dang rngus babs grags pas lus stobs 'chor na/ 'dren 'grems dang lus zungs mi 'chor ba'i gdams ngag bya/ 'ga' zhig bde gsal gyi nyams yod 'phro la rlung khams ldang / lus grang / mgo na na thig le 'ju ma thub pa yin/ 'ga' zhig mthong snang gi nyams bzang yang lus sngo zhing skams bde nyams yal/ gzhan gong dang 'dra na thig le rgyas ma thub pa yin/ 'di rigs chags lam gyis bde ba spel bas sel lo/ /'dzin pa'i skabs 'dir yang gtum mo'i 'bar snang gis rtsa sgo phye nas srog sdud kyi 'pho ba 'gyung ba'i gegs cung zad 'byung ba'i skabs yod kyang /rlung sems la ci rigs par dbang thob pas gegs sel gyi gdams ngag phal pa la ma ltos te/ sgrub pa po rang nyid kyis shes par 'gyur ro/ /srog rtsol mthar phyin nas gegs phal cher las grol zhing / 'dzin pa'i phyed snga ma mthar —349—

—phyin nas sgom gegs kyi ming yang med do/ /'dzin pa'i rim pa dang 'brel ba rnams bshad zin to/ /rjes dran gyi skabs su 'di ltar nges par byed dgos te/ spyir sa pu ṭi dang / gdan bzhi la sogs pa rgyud sde du ma nas gsungs pa la/ dang por mar me'i mtshan ma dang / gnyis pa glog gam mkha' snang gi mtshan ma dang / gsum pa rdul phran dkar po'am dkar po'i 'od kyi masno ma dang / bzhi pa 'dod pa'i lha'i longs spyod kyi mtshan ma dang / lnga pa lha'i gzugs kyi mtshan ma dang / drug pa gzugs med ye shes kyi mtshan ma dang / bdun pa chos kyi dbyings kyi mtshan ma dang / brgyad pa bdag nyid sangs rgyas su gyur pa'i mtshan ma ste/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa la mtshan ma brgyad po ni de rnams so/ /'di dag la bshad tshul mi 'dra ba ci rigs par yod mod kyang / skabs 'dir 'di ltar bshad par bya ste/ mar me'i mtshan ma ni sor bsam gyi dus kyi rtags rnams thams cad de/ yan lag phyi ma rnams la ltos nas rgya shin tu chung ngu zhig gsal bar byed pas so/ /srog rtsol gyi skabs kyi rtags thams cad ni gnyis pa glog gi mtshan ma ste/ snga ma las rgya che yang mi/ brtan pas so/ /gsum pa 'od zer dkar po'i mtshan ma ni 'dzin pa'i skabs kyi mtshan ma thams cad do/ /der zhu bde 'dzag med grub pas byang chub kyi sems rgyas shing / rtsa nang thams cad du thig le 'gro 'ong mthong bas dang / phyi ru ring de'i mthu las zla 'od la sogs pa'i snang ba 'char bas so/ /bzhi pa la sogs pa bzhi ni rjes dran gyi skabs 'dir 'byung ba yin te/ bzhi pa 'dod pa'i lha'i longs spyod de/ lha 'dod khams pa dang mtshungs —350—

par 'dod yon lnga tha mal pa 'di rnams mi 'byung bar/ stong pa nyid kyi gzugs sgra dri ro reg byar 'char zhing / de las 'jug shes drug dga' bde khyad par can gyis brlan pa dang / lnga pa lha'i gzugs kyi mtshan ma ni/ gzugs khams kyi lha 'od lus su yod pa ltar/ rang nyid stong gzugs kyi lha skur gyur te/ 'od zer dpag tu med par 'phro ba 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi nang du chud pa/ dkyil 'khor mtha' yas pa spro zhing bsdu ba 'byung ste/ stong gzugs kyi lha yab yum grub nas sngar gyi 'dod pa'i longs spyod dang / lhag par khams gsum gyi gzugs brnyan thams cad kyis kyang dga' bde bskyed nga/'o/ /drug pa gzugs med ni/ de nas zhu bde khyad par can skye ste/ gtum mo'i mes rtsa stong phrag bdun bcu rtsa gnyis kyi byang sems thams cad dros thub/ rang gnas su zhu thub/ spyi bor sdud thub/der shin tu zhu zhing dbu ma'i lam du drangs nas bzung gin bzung gin 'khor lo drug 'gengs nus te/ gtum mo 'bar ba'i nus pa rdzogs shing brtan pa thob na de ltar 'gyung gi gzhan la mi 'byung ngo / /de yang mnyam bzhag dang rlung stobs kyis rlung dang thig le 'dres pa de nyid zhag gcig dbu mar 'dzin nus na brgyal ba zhes bya ste/ dpral bar thig we 'dzin nus/ zhag bco lnga dbu mar khegs na bcings pa zhes bya ste/ mgrin par 'dzin nus/ zla ba gcig tu khegs na bsad pa zhes bya ste/ snying gar 'dzin nus/ zla ba drug tu khegs na bsregs pa zhes bya ste/ lte bar 'dzin nus par rdo rje snying 'grel la gsungs la/ lo gcig khegs na gsang bar 'dzin nus/ rtag tu khegs na nor bur 'dzin nus/zhes man lung gu ru sogs bla ma gong ma rnams gsung ngo / /de ltar rdo rje nor —351—

bur byang chub kyi sems brtan pa'i ye shes de ni/ mchog tu bde ba gzugs med pa/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gzugs med kyi ye shes su ming btags pa yin no/ /skabs de dang der thig le bzung nus zhes bya ba ni/ khams kyi dwangs ma dang bde ba'i ye shes gnyis gnas de dang der nam du yang mi nyams shing /rkyen gang gis kyang g.yo mi thub pa ste zhu bde 'dzag med mthar phyin pa'i grub 'bras yin no/ /zhu bde 'dzag med lhun gyis grub pa ni/ rtsol med du bzhag kyang nor bu las byang sems mi 'dzag nga/ra ma zad kyi/ ched gtad phyir phab kyang 'dzag mi thub pa la zer ro/ /'khor lo 'og ma 'og ma rnams su babs pa'i skabs kyang gong ma gong ma gang bde nyams pa med cing / skad cig skad cig la byang chub kyi sems 'phel bas 'phel ba'i cha gang yin pa de 'og ma 'og mar 'gro zhing gsog par byed cing / de la gong ma gong ma'i ro bcud dang ngad dang nus pa'i cha shas yod pas gong ma'i thig le 'og mar song zhes brjod la/ des na 'og mar babs pa'i tshe rtsa 'khor gong ma stong par song ba min zhing / yang zlog pa'i tshe yang mas rim gyis stong par song ba min pas/ gnas skabs 'di tsam gyi nyams rtegs rgyud la skyes pa'i dga' bzhi lugs 'byung lugs zlog dang / las dang po pa'i dbab zlog gi rim par ni khyad par shin tu che ba yin la/ zhags grangs 'di snyed du khegs zhes gong du bshad pa de rnams kyang mnyam bzhag thun gcig la de tsam du gnas nus la/ de las lhag par mi nus te/ rtsa 'khor gong 'og gang rung gcig tu 'gro dgos pa'i don yin no/ /de ltar zhu bde 'dzag med lhun gyis grub pa de thob pa'i rgyu ni gnyis te/ gtum mo 'bar —352—

ba brtan pa dang / gnas de dang de thig le gang ba'o/ /de yang gtum mo 'bar ba g.yos na snying ga'i nad ste rlung gi thig le snying gar gnas pa de g.yo bar byed la/ de gnyis g.yos pas thig le rtsol med du khegs pa mi 'byung la/ gtum mo g.yo ba'i rgyu ni ro rkyang gi rgyu ba yin no/ /de khegs pas gtum mo brtan/ des snying gi nang brtan/ de gnyis brtan pas thig le rtsol med du brtan par 'gyur ba yin no/ /gang bas g.yo med du gnas pa ni bum pa gang ba bzhin no/ /bdun pa chos kyi dbyings kyi nyams ni zhu bde des rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa chos thams cad kyi chos nyid gnas lugs de dngos su nyams su myong ba snyam byad cing / gnas lugs de shin tu gsal bar mtshon par nus pa yin no/ /brgyad pa bdag nyid sangs rgyas su gyur pa'i nyams ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag ste/sku dang ye shes zung 'jug gi cha shas thob pas/ rang nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su gyur pa dang phyogs 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang rjes dran gyi skabs su khams dwangs ma thams cad spyi bor 'dus/ dh+wa tī la dus me 'bar/ byang sems babs pa phyag chen gyis bcings/ dbu ma throg les gang bas lus kyang thig les gang / thig le'i cha shas rdul phran gyi tshad tsam las kyang rtags snang mtha' yas pa 'char ba'i phyir 'khor 'das khams gsum gyi gzugs brnyan dpag tu med pa zhig cig car snang ba rgyun mi chad par 'byung zhing / de re res kyang zhu bde dang zhu bde ma yin pa'i dga' bde'i khyad par re 'grub mod kyang / bde ba skyed byed gtso bo ni dbu mar gnas pa gtum mo'i rang bzhin las grub pa'i rtags bcu lha sku yab yum gyi rnam pa can rnams te/ gtum mo'i me dang rtags —3kye 3—

bcu dang / srog thur gcig tu 'dres pa'i rlung rnams gzhi gcig la 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'o/ /dran ting gi skabs dang 'brel ba rnams cung zad bshad zin to/ /gzhan yang 'dzin pa'i skabs su gtum mo 'bar ba bcu 'grub tshul dang / 'dzin pa nas rjes dran la 'tshams sbyor tshul dang / rjes dran gyi mgo thob pa tsam nas stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo 'dod pa'i lha de grub pa yin kyang zhu bde rdzogs par 'dren thub mi thub kyi khyad par dang / stong gzugs kyis bde ba 'phel thub mi thub dang / mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba bskyed thub mi thub kyi khyad par dang / dga' ba bzhi dang bcu drug gi rab tu dbye ba dang / 'dod pa'i gnas skabs bcu rnam par dag pa'i ye shes kyi rim pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi skabs su khams thams cad dwangs ma bcur gyur gyi bar du bzhu btul byed pa ye shes dag byed dang / phung khams dbang yul las dbang bya ba dang bcas pa lha skur shar bas lus dag pa dang / las rlung bsad pas ngag dag pa dang / byang sems dag pas sems nam mkha' ltar spros pa dang bral yang rtog med kyi rig pas ji lta ba dang / ji snyed pa shes tshul dang / sa bcu gnyis kyi yon tan sogs mang po bshad du yod mod kyi/ gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /'dir ni lam 'di 'bad pas bsgoms na deng sang gi gang zag mang po zhig la'ang 'gyung du rung ba'i lus nyams/ ngag nyams/ sems nyams mthong nyams rmi nyams te rtags lngar grags pa nyer mkho che ba rnams gtan la phab pa yin pas/ phyogs mtshon 'di tsam las dpags nas mtha' yas pa'i bar du'ang shes par bya zhing / slob —354—

dpon nyams myong dang yon to can gyis ngo sprod par yang bya'o/ /lam 'di rtags snang gis lam 'khrid pa yin pas rtags tshad shes pa gal che zhing / stong gzugs la gces spras dang rtsis so cher byed dgos/ 'on kyang stong gzugs mthong ba tsam gyis mi chog ste/ ngo sprod tshul dang / lam du bsrol tshul dang /bogs 'don tshul ma nor bar byed dgos so/ /gang dag 'od gsal stong gzugs la 'khrul snang gi nyams tsam mo zhes smod pa de dag ni/ rgyud sde mtha' yas pa'i don ma go bar lta ba mtho ru re bas g.yang sar lhungs pa yin no/ /de bas na bla ma dam pa'i man ngag btsal nas yid bzhin nor bu lag tu 'ongs pa chud ma zos par bya'o/ zhes pa zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i rtags tshad kyi yi ge mdo tsam bkod pa 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā tha'i sug las so// //zhus dag dar rgyas 'phel// 'dir 'bad dge 'dis lus 'di bor ma thag /g.yu lo bkod par 'phags ma'i dgyes zha‘la drung / /thugs sras gdul zhing mchog tu legs gyur te/ /skye srid de la lam mthar phyin gyur cig /ces pa yang ma tis smras pa'o// //—355—

na mo gu ru we/ skabs 'dir zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sgom pa la nyer mkho'i yan lag tu gegs sel gyi man ngag cung zad tsam zhig bshad par bya'o/ /de la gegs thams cad bsdu na gsum ste/ lus sems gnyis kar la gnod pa bdud kyi gegs dang / gtso bor sems la gnod pa ting nge 'dzin gyi gegs dang / gtso bor lus la gnod pa 'byung ba lus 'khrugs rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa'i gegs so/ /de rnams thun mong du sel ba ni/ bla ma'i mos gus dang / gang shar sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i lta ba dang / sems can mtha' dag la bcos min gyi snying rje chen po dang / sdig pa bshags pa dang / tshogs gsog pa la nan tan du byed pa rnams yin pa las/ gegs sel bogs 'don thams cad kyi gtso bo ni bla ma'i mos gus kho na ste/ bsag sbyang gi gtso bo yang mos gus kyi sgo nas bla ma'i phyir du dka' spyad byas pa yin zhing / gegs thams cad mos gus gcig pus rang grol du 'gro ba bya brgya 'ur rdo gcig gis 'ded pa'i tshul du yod pas/ mkhas rlom gang dag bla ma'i mos gus bsgom pa'i lam blun po dang nya ma'i chos yin par brtsi zhing / rang la yon to phra mo yod pa'i yus kyis bla rma/ bsten tshul chos nas bshad pa bzhin mi byed cing / man ngag la thob gsha' byed pa'i tshul du dbang che'i spyod pas len par byed pa rnams la ni nyams myong ye mi skye ba'am/ cung zad skyes kyang bar chad kyis 'khyer bar the tshom —356—

med do/ /des na mos gus la sogs pa'i gnad lnga po 'di rnams bor nas/dmigs pa rlung sbyor lus sbyong sad sud tsam dang / dbyug chos dang 'jib ru dang khab btsag dang me gtar la sogs pa nad bcos than thun res gegs sel zhing bogs thon par re ba ni 'khrul pas 'khrul pa mgo bskor ba yin rno/ /sngar gyi gnad lnga po de tshang ba'i steng nas/ 'gyung ba lus 'khrugs yin na bcos phra mo de rnams byas kyang legs par 'gyur ba'i skabs cung zad yod mod/ nyams dang gegs kyi dbye ba ngo ma shes pa dang / gegs rang yin kyang skabs 'gar phan las gnod che ba'ang 'byung srid pas nyams myong can gyis legs par brtag pa gal che'o/ /gegs gsum po de rnams so sor bsrung zhing sel ba ni/ bdud gegs la rgyud sde nas gsungs pa'i bsrung bzlog stong pa nyid dang snying rjes zin pa'i khog nas nyams su blangs pas sel/ spyir na tsha dang mi 'dod pa dang rmi lam ngan pa dang ltas rtsub pa sogs bdud kyi bar chad yin pa'i nges pa med/ rkyen des chos la bar chad che bar song na bdud kyi bar chad yin/ rkyen des chos dang dge ba la bskul/ tha na rim gro tshun chad kyis kyang dge las 'phel/ snying rje nges 'gyung mos gus sogs snga phyir je 'phel du 'gro ba byung na dkon mchog gi thugs rjes chos la bskul ma yin/ rmi ltas bzang /longs spyo 'phel/ mi kha byams/ gtam snyan/ 'phral skyid kyang dkon mchog gi byin rlabs yin pa'i nges pa med/ de la brten nas chos mi 'phel bar song na bdud rigs kyi bar chad yin/ rang gzhan gyi dge ba gong 'phel du song na dkon mchog gi byin brlabs sam dkar phyogs kyi lha'i mthu yin no/ /sems —357—

kyi gegs sam ting nge 'dzin gyi gegs ni/ bying rgod gnyis dang / rnam rtog rgyun chags dang / nyon mongs drag po rgyun gcod dka' ba rnams yin pas/ sems byings na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa dang / 'phags pa rnams kyi yon tan dang / bla ma gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar dang / chos kyi phan yon rnams bsams nas spro ba rgya chen po bskyed de/ rig pa shugs bton nas bsgrim zhing bsgom pas sel/ gzhan yang thun chung ngur bcad/ sa mtho ba dang /mthangs dkar ba dang / bsil sar bsgom pa dang / chu lcag dang / zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la lta ba la sogs kyang sel/ kha zas dang spyod lam gyis kyang bsal lo/ /'dod yon dran pa sogs rgod pa la 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang /tshe 'di mi rtag pa dang / mtho dman 'byor rgud dang / 'khor ba'i chos gang la'ang snying po med tshul bsams nas skyo shas drag po bskyed/ shes pa khong glod pa'am rigs gcig la dran pa'i bya ra ba bzhag nas cung zad bsgrim pas sel ba'ang yod/ gzhan yang bying ba sel byed kyi ldog phyogs rnams bsten zhing / kha zas dang spyod lam gyis kyang bsal lo/ /rnam rtog rgyun chags la ni 'phro ba ngos 'dzin pa dang / rnam rtog grangs la 'debs pa dang / thun 'phro bcad kyin bcad kyin dran pas bzung bas sel/ rnam g.yeng gi nyes dmigs dang / sems gnas pa'i phan yon bsam/ grim lhod spel mar byas te bsgoms na sel ba yin no/ /de bzhin du nyon mongs so so la so so'i gnyemyo/ po ci rigs pa bsten nas dbyings su mnyam par 'jog pa ste/ zhe sdang la snying rje/ 'dod chags la mi gtsang ba/ sred zhen ser sna sogs la nges 'byung sogs so so'i gnyen por —3kye8—

mdo rgyud sogs las gsungs pa rnams ci rigs par bsgoms pas/ nyon mongs yul dang bcas pa sgyu ma lta bur shes bzhin pas dbyings la mnyam par bzhag na sel bar 'gyur/ 'byung ba lus 'khru / gas rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa sel ba la/ dang por nad gdon brtag pa ni/ lte ba'i rtsa 'dab re bzhi dang /gsang gnas kyi phyi skor bcu drug ste brgyad bcu las grang nad bskyed cing de rnams kyi skyon las lus kyi smad lci/ bshang gci'i lam mi bde/ rtsa chu sdom pa'am dgag dka' ba 'byung / sems 'phro zhing gnyid med pa'am chung / kha zas bsil ba gnod/ gzhan yang rlung rkyang pa'i nad phal cher yang rtsa de rnams la brten pa yin no/ /mgrin pa'i rtsa so gnyis dang snying ga'i brgyad de bzhi bcu las mkhris pa dang tsha ba'i nad gtso bor bskyed de rbus che/ skyug stangs 'byung /zas kyi ro mi gsal/ gnyid che mgo bo lci/ kha zas drod dang bcud gnod/gcug tor gyi rtsa 'dab bzhi dang dpral ba'i bcu drug ste nyi shu las tsha grang gnyis kar dang bad kan bskyed de/ bkrag mdangs shor/ pho ba mi bde/ chu skyur skyug zas zhu rjes 'pho ba tsha/ lus lci/ rnying pa dang bcud can gnod pa'o/ /gzhan yang mchin pa la nad yod na/ mig mi gsal zhing na ba dang /mkhal ma la yod na rna ba 'on zhing rnag sogs 'byung / glo ba la yod na snas dri mi tshor bsnabs mang / snying la yod na lce mi bde zhing 'khrum pa 'byung / mtsher pa la yod na reg bya mi gsal zhing khol bur na ba sogs dang / rus pa la yod na so sen bkrag med pa dang / sha la yod na dreg pa chags shing ba spu logachu rgyus la yod na rengs 'khum 'gyung / khrag la yod na chu dmar ba'am ser ba —359—

dang / lha ba dang sbubs la yod na skra spu gyen du langs pa sogs 'gyung ngo / /'gyung ba lus 'khrugs kyi rjes 'brangs ni steng 'og gi gdon gnyis te/steng gdon la lus sbrid/ dran pa rmongs/ rmi lam du mun nag sogs 'gyung /'di'i grogs ni rgyal 'gong sogs pho gdon rnams kyis byed pa mang / 'og gdon ni lus sems lci/ dug gsum 'phel/ lus khol bu khol bur na tsha dang 'brum pa sogs 'byung / rmi lam du sdig sbrul sogs dud 'gro sna tshogs rmi/grogs ni mo gdon dang bdud kyis byed pa mang / grogs gang yin pa de'i dngos dang rmi lam gyi ltas kyang 'byung ngo / /de rnams bcos thabs la 'gyung ba lus 'khrugs spyi sel ba ni gdams ngag 'di nyid kyi man ngag las 'gyung ba'i lus sbyong rnams yin la/ de dag nyin re ma chags par byas na sngar yod rnams thon 'gro zhing phyin chad mi 'byung ba yin no/ /so so'i bcos thabs la srog rtsol gyi skabs dang 'brel bar/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i man ngag rdo rje'i tshig drug gi 'phros la/ bkag pas 'og sgo btsan thabs su 'gags na steng gi sbyor ba la brten nas dgrol ba ni/ lus gnad gzhan rnams ci bder bcas/ 'og gi 'byed 'dzum gyi sbyor bas thur sel 'then glod mang du bya/ rlung ro bsal la steng rlung drag tu rngubs te gsang bar shugs chen pos mnan/ de nas yar 'then te stod du sleb pa tsam na lag pa khu tshur bskyang zhing nu khar brdeg kha nas hā ring ha thung 'don zhing lus 'phar rdeb bya/ dri chu 'gags pa yin na de rjes rlung sngar bzhin bzung la sna bug g.yas nas mang du 'bud/ dri chen dgag pa yin na g.yon nas mang du 'bud do/ /'di dang phyogs mtshungs pa gzhan yang bum can —36()—

bsgom pas thur sel stod du hanas pa dang / srog rlung smad du lhung ba gnyis 'byung ba'ang srid/ thur sel glo bur du gyen rgyu'i gnas su sleb na smad kyi drod bsdus/ stod la drod rgyas/ mgo nas rlangs pa 'phyur/ khog nang du shing brdzangs pa bzhin na 'ga' zhig la mgo bor zug zer chen po skye ba'ang yod/dbugs nang du sdud dka'/ khog nang nas yar rlung phub bskor ba bzhin 'gro ba'i snang ba dang / skar khung gi snang ba 'byung ba'ang yod/ de la bcos thabs ni/ phyar ba lta bu'i steng du gan kyal du bzhag nas zur bzhi nas bteg cing / rgyab sa la cung zad rdeb pa yang yang bya/ de nas mgo mdun du bkug la sgal tshig dang po nas gzhug chung gi bar du khu tshur gyis rim pas brdung / shugs che chung nad khams dang sbyar/ mar rnying pa'i byug pa dang rkang mthil drod dugs bya/ dmigs pa la gnas pa 'dug na bu ga mang po'i sbyor ba dang / nor bur thig le nag po la sems gtod du gzhug go /des sel/ gyen rgyu srog rlung dang bcas pa de thur sel gyi gnas su glo bur du lhung na/ rtsa chu bsdams pa'am 'og sgo sdud mi shes/ rgyu zhabs dang bshang gci'i lam gzer/ stod kyi drod bsdus/ smad lhag par tsha/ de bcos pa ni gcig gis rkang pa nas bzung zhing / mgo zhabs slog pa'i tshul gyis mgo sa la ma reg tsam rgyab tu khur/ gcig gis gzhug rus nas ltag pa'i tshigs pa zad so'i bar du khu tshur gyis rim pas brdung / de nas ras sam rnam bu dro mos dkris shing phyi nas bsdams/ yang kha bub du spyi rting log tshul du bzhag nas gong bzhin tshigs pa rnams rim pas brdungs/ bu ga mang bo'i sbyor ba bsgom thub na legs te des sel/ bum can bsgom pas kor ler —361—

na tsha byung na dal bus mnye ba dang bu ga gsum pa'i sbyor bas phan/ kor ler 'khrum pa dmar tsam byung na dri chu grang mos bkrus pas sel/ gzhan yang mgo bo na ba dang / snying 'tshangs pa dang / ro stod tsha kram kram pa byung na te te brdung ba dang / thur segs la rgyug pa dang/ dpyangs phrul byas pas kyang phan/ snying ga dang rtsib chung nas yar tsha kreng byung na sked pa yan la las mi 'chol/ 'og rlung drag tu 'then/ brla dang byin pa bsgrim/ rkang sor rnams bskums te rkang pa brkyang bskum mang du byas pas sel/ byang chub kyi sems mi nyams par byed pa'i dngos gzhi ni/ lam gyi dngos gzhi rnams bsgom zhing 'dren 'grems byas pas 'dzag gegs phal cher chod pa yin la/ 'dzag pa'i sgo rnams nas bsrung ba ni/bshang gci dang sdongs nas 'chor pa la/ thig le rul ba rnams nad dang 'dres pa chu dang sdongs nas 'byung zhing / 'ga' zhig la bong bu'i chu 'dra ba 'ong / de ni snyigs ma nad du gyur zin pa yin la/ dwangs ma 'chor ba'i rtags su rtsa chu dor bas lus 'dar shig pa dang mgo 'khor ba'am 'gyel tshad pa 'gyung / de la rlung kha sbyor lte ba nas rgyu zhabs kyi bar du 'then gnon bzhi lnga zhig bya/ rgya mtsho ri rab la gcir ba sogs lus kyi 'gyur ba bzhi dang ldan pas rlung kha sbyor then ne'i ngang nas rtsa chu rang 'gros su dor bas phan/ rngus dang sdongs te 'dzag na drod che zhing rngus cab ste 'byung / de rjes lus zi ldab kyi 'gyung zhing stobs chung /de la tsan dan du ma tsam dri chur btab ste des lus bkru/ de nas mar gyin5spyogapa byas la sran phye lta bus dril phyis bya/ dmigs pa ba skru'i bu ga thams cad thig le 'od dkar po can gyis gang bar bsam/ so khrag dang sdongs nas0chor —362—

ba ni/ khrag nag por 'dug na nad yin pas dor/ khrag mtshal kha 'byung zhing mgo zi yor ba dang / nyams snang bkrag 'chor ba'i rnam pa byung na zungs khrag dang thig le 'dres pa yin pas mchu btsums pa'i ngang nas lcibs kyis 'jig tshul dang/ bum pa can dang ltag pa skyed pa lhan cig bya/ mchi ma dang lhan cig 'gyung ba yang rtags snga ma dang 'dra zhing / de la bum can bzung lus sgyed mig bcum byed pa dang / res 'ga' spyi bo'i bum can bzung zhing mig nam mkhar bltas pas phan/ sna khrag dang sdongs nas 'dzag pa yang rtags gong dang 'dra/'di sgo yangs pas gegs che zhing cung zad sel ba dka'/ khrag gcod kyi man ngag gzhan yang bya/ khyad par bum can gyi ngang nas mtheb mdzub kyis sna stems/sna'i rlung nang du drang zhing mgo sprug /de nas langs te lag pa g.yab g.yug bzhin bskor dgos te/ g.yas g.yon gang nas 'dzag pa'i phyogs de nyid g.yab bo/ /snabs dang 'dres na snabs sngo sangs tshwa mi bro ba 'byung / rtags gzhan gong dang 'dra/ de la bum can gyi ngang nas sna bkag ste sna'i rlung rngub pa de kas sel/ rna pags dang / lhan cig 'byung ba yang rtags gzhan 'dra ba las rna ba'i gting za bar 'ong / de la'ang rlung sbyor bshad ma thag pa de khas phan zhing rna pags de zos na'ang phan par bshad do/ /de dag ni gegs sel spyi khog bshad pa'i sde wo te dang pho/ /gzhan yang sa rlung stobs 'phel te lus rdzi/ nyams shed chung / chags pa srab par 'gyur te/ de la g.yas kyi rlung 'gro 'ong gi bzlas pa dang / g.yas nas 'bud rngub kyi bum can byas pas sel/ de bzhin du chu rlung 'phel te grang —363—

shum dang khong 'dar byed/ ngag smra brjod dka' bar gyur na dri chu'i rtsa'i lam nas rdor bzlas sogs bya/ me rlung 'phel te lus rngus/ drod skye mig mi gsal bar song na sna g.yon nas bya/ rlung gi rlung 'phel te lus yang shes pa 'phyo/sdod mi tshugs/ sna 'gag pa'am dri mi tshor na bshang ba'i rtsa'i lam la dmigs nas rdor bzlas sogs bya/ mkha' khams 'phel te g.yang sa skye/ rig pa skyo/stong nyams 'ba' zhig 'char/ rna ba 'on pa la sogs par gyur na 'og sgo gnyis 'byed 'dzum yang yang bya/ /khu ba'i lam la dmigs nas rdor bzlas sogs bya/ ye shes kyi khams 'phel nas chags pa drag po skye/ 'dzag gegs 'byung/ smyo ba ltar gyur na rlung mnyam rgyur btang / dbu ma la dmigs nas rdor bzlas bum can sogs bya'o/ /yang mnyam gnas la sogs pa'i rlung skyon kyang 'chos dgos te/ mnyam gnas rgyas pas mang du zos kyang bkres shing stobs chung / ngal zhing dub na g.yas kyi me rlung la dmigs nas bum can dang rdor bzlas byas pas sel/ mnyam gnas stobs nyams na zas mi 'ju/ dmu chu dang skran sogs su 'gyur bas g.yon gyi sa rlung la dmigs/ srog rlung 'phel na drod nyams rlung sems rgod/ spyo 'bog tu 'gyur/ dri chu'i lam gyi rlung la dmigs/ de stobs nyams na lus stobs 'chor/ dran pa nyams/ brgyal ba la sogs par 'gyur te bshang ba'i rtsa'i rlung la dmigs/ gyen rgyu 'phel na dbugs lhag par rgod/ bza' btung la sred/ mang du smra/ g.yon gyi chu rlung la dmigs/ de stobs nyams na dbugs 'gro 'ong dka'/ bza' btung gi ro mi tshor/ g.yal dang skyigs bu 'byung / g.yon pa'i rlung gi rlung la dmigs pa'am —364

dri chu'i lam la dmigs/ thur ser 'phel na bshang gci khu ba rlung ste 'og gi rgyun lam bzhi 'dzag pa dang lus 'dar ba sogs su 'gyur/ de la g.yon gyi sa rlung ngam bshang ba'i rlung la dmigs/ de stobs nyams na rtsa chu sdoms/ ras mi thon/ pho ba 'ur sgra 'byung / g.yon gyi me rlung ngam sna g.yas kyi rlung la dmigs/khyab byed 'phel na tshigs rnams bskrad/ 'gro 'dug dka' pags pa dang ba skru'i khung bu rnams tsha zhing gzer/ g.yon gyi rlung gi mtha' 'am dung can ma la dmigs/ de stobs nyams na lus skrang / pags pa 'gog /ba skru byi/ za zhakhru/ga la sogs par 'gyur/ de la dbu ma la dmigs shing mnyam rgyu'i steng nas rdor bzlas dang bum can byas pas sel/ rlung rengs bcos pa ni/ srog rlung snying khar gzer na stod 'tshangs dang snying gzer 'ong / rengs na snying rlung du 'gro bas lus chur bcug ste gang na sa de chu'i rba la gtad/ de rjes bsku mnye bya/nor bur sems bzung bas sel/ gyen rgyu zin na pho ba sbo/ mkhal skyed na/gzer zhing skyug /rengs na pho gzer dang / dmu chur 'gro/ de la chang gi kha khru gdab/ na sar dugs bya/ skyigs bu 'don/ shes pa mgrin par gtod/ thur sel zin na dpyi mig na/ ro smad bshal/ dri chen ha cang bska ba dang sla bar 'gyur/ rengs na smad 'khyal du 'gro bas bshang gci'i lam gyi bar du drag tu mnye zhing dugs bya/ 'og sgo'i rlung steng du drag tu drangs/ shes pa tshangs phug tu gtad do/ /gyen rgyu zin na mgrin pa skrang / rtse'u chung dang rtse mgo na/ rengs na lkog 'bras su 'gro bas/ rlung thur du mnan zhing mgrin pa skor/ rlung sna nas 'bud pa dang ha drag tu 'don/ khyab byed zin na mgo bo sogs lus khol bur —365—

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā ta'i gsung 'bum/na/ rengs na sgur por 'gro bas 'chongs rgyug dang bsku mnye bya/ mig tu rgyu ba'i rlung rengs na rab rib dang skam tshag la sogs par 'gyur/ chu grang dang gur gum la sogs ba'i bsil sman gdab/ mthil bzhi dang bol gong la khrus dang byug pa bya/ rna ba la min pa'i ngos bkab nas/ na ba ngos nas rlung drag du drangs/kha sna nas 'bud/ sna la yang sna bug bkag nas de bzhin du bya/ lce la yang kha btsum/ lce sgril ba dang gcu ba mang du byas nas/ lce brkyang zhing kha nas rlung mang du 'don/ pags pa sogs lus spyi dang bye brag la rlung drag tu rngubs/ skang pa'i sor mo bsdus la bro 'drab/ lag pa'i sor mo bskum la drag tu sprugs pas sel/ lus kyi cha shas so so dang rlung bcu'i gnas gang la yang rud ste/ so so'i 'khrul 'khor byas pas mchog tu phan par 'gyur zhing / gang na sar gtad nas bum pa can 'bugs pa bzhin bzung pa dang / gang na sa de nyid stong par bsgom pa dang / gang na sar dbu ga dod cing ha zhes rlung drag tu bus pas bu ga nas rgyangs rgyangs thon par bsgom pas kyang phal cher sel ba yin no/ /yang srog rtsol bsgom pas thur rlung gyen du log nas stod 'tshangs sogs byung na/ lus gnad khu tshur brla ba theg dang / rkang sor bskums/ smad kyi nywa bzhi sgrim/ thur rlung drag tu bskum pas kyang sel/ yang nang gi khams 'khrugs pa las bad kan rgyas te spyi bo dang dpral ba lci zhing mi theg pa snyam byed/ lus lji shed chung na dpral ba'i bum can gyi 'dug stangs lta bu'i ngang nas rlung rgyu zhabs su drag tu mnan pas sel/ 'dis ni 'khru nad dang chu sri ba la'ang phan/ mkhris pa skyes te kha skoms shing kha bar 'gyur/ skom dad che na snying ga dang mgrin pa'i bum can —366—

bsgoms/ 'dis rgyab kyi zug rngu yang 'joms/ 'dus pa'i nad la brten pa'i lus phrum gzer 'byung na/ lus gnad sor sdud dang 'dra ba las thog mar steng rlung mnan/ de nas thur sel 'then pa'i kha sbyor gyis sel/ rim gyi tsha ba'i khyad par 'ga' zhig la mun khang du mnyam pa'i stabs kyis 'dug /sked pa sogs lus drang por bsrangs/ mtheb mdzub kyis sna'i rtsa ba bsdams/ kha sbyor gong bzhin bzung bas sa la 'gyel bar ma gyur gyi bar du bsgom pas sel/ dmu chu dang skran dang gzhang 'brum dang glo nad dang skyigs bu dang dug dang mgo nad dang mig nad rnams kyang bum pa can gyi sbyor ba zla gcig bsgoms pas sel bar bshad cing / ma zhu ba la gan kyal du 'dug lte ba'i bum can bzung lag pa g.yon pas lte ba'i pags pa bsdus te mgo dang rkang pa gyen du 'degs pas ldang ba lta bu'i tshul yang yang byed pas sel lo/ gzhan yang rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa'i nad kun la so so'i nad bskyed pa'i rtsa 'khor rnams su bum can bsgom zhing nad gzhi dang bstun pa'i kha zas dang spyod lam ma 'khrugs par byas pas sel te/ de yang 'dus pa'i nad ni gsang gnas kyi bar skor 'dab ma bcu dang nang skor 'dab ma drug la brten pa yin pas/ gsang ba'i bum can bsgom pas sel zhing / gsang ba'i bum can spyi 'gro des ma sel na dmigs pa rtsa 'khor de gnyis la gtad/ gsang ba'i bum can gyi ngang nas mtha' nas bskor zhing dbus su sdigs pa mang du byas la/ mthar kha sna gnyis nas rlung ro drag tu 'don pas sel de bzhin du gzhan rnams la'ang rigs 'gre ste/ rtsa bzang ba'i rigs dang / nad stobs chung ba rnams so so'i bum can dkyus ma de —367—

khas sel zhing / rtsa ngan pa dang nad stobs chen gyi rigs la des ma sel na rno khyad re gdags pas sel ba yin te/ bad kan skya por grags pa ni srog rlung gi skyon yin pas steng rlung drag tu rngubs nas lte 'og tu yang yang mnan/ dpral pa'i bum can bsgom pas sel bar 'gyur/ rlung dang grang ba ni thur sel gyi skyon yin pas thur sel drag tu bskums te bde ba skyes skyes su bzung ba lan mang du bya/ bshang sgo rting pas bkag ste gnas pa dang / lus kyi smad du drod bskyed pa'i spyod lam byas pas sel/ tsha ba thams cad gyen rgyu dang mnyam gnas gyi skyon yin pas stobs chung na steng 'og gi rlung cung zad re bzung zhing phyi la drag tu 'bud cing / 'bud dus rlung zhabs bar rlung cung zad re ma bzung na grang bar thal nyen yod/ stobs che na shid sgra dang bcas te kha nas rlung grang mor rngubs te bzung / gtong ba'i skabs kyang so bsgrigs te sing sgra dang bcas te yun bsrings ba bus bas sel/ 'dus pa ni khyab byed kyi skyon yin pas/nad gsum ka'i rlung sbyor re mos su byas pas sel bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du rlung gi nad ni nye ba'i phyi skor drug cu rtsa bzhi dang / gsang gnas kyi phyi skor bcu drug gi nus pa yin pas skyil krung lag gnyis pus mo la bkab pa'am/ tsog bu lag gnyis pus 'phyud kyi tshul bya/ rlung ro bsal/ steng rlung rang babs la 'og rlung dbus nas steng du drag tu 'then/ gsang ba nas nye ba'i bar du rgya mtsho bskyod pa'i tshul gyis g.yas g.yon res mos su bskor/ shugs zad pa thur sel dal bus glod la bzhag kha dang sna nas rlung drag tu 'bud cing lte ba dang gsang ba'i bum can ci rigs pa bsgom mo/ /'dis ni stod 'tshangs dang —368—

gzer ba sogs rlung nad thams cad sel/ lus gnad de nyid dang 'dra ba las/rlung ro bus/ sna nas drag tu rngubs/ lte bar thub tshad du mnan/ thur sel rang babs su bzhag pa lan kha yar byas nas/ /dpral ba dang gtsug tor gyi bum can bzung zhing smin mtshams yan chad kyi mgo bo'i pags pa bskyod cing srubs/mgo sgyed dgu yang yang bya/ mthar rdo rje bsdams pa pho bar brdeg /'dis bad kan gyi nad rnams sel bar 'gyur zhing / khyad par bad rlung mgo 'khor sogs la bsngags so/ /de yang gtsug tor gyi rtsa 'dab bzhi dang / dpral ba'i bcu drug bad kan skya bo 'phel zad byed pa'i rtsa yin pa'i gnad kyis so/ /lus gnad de dang mtshungs pa las/ bdud rtsi lce sbyor gyi man ngag bzhin du rlung grang mo sas la bzung / mgrin pa skor ṣ+ka ro stod yi/ de rjes 'og rlung rang babs su glod nas steng rlung drag tu btad/ de ltar yang tshu byas pas tsha mkhris sel bar 'gyur la/ grang mkhris la ni rlung sna nas rngubs pas sel/ de yang mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab so gnyis dang snying ga'i brgyad rnams mkhris pa 'phel zad byed pa po yin pa'i gnad kyis so/ /gzhan yang ma ning gi bum can cung zad brtan par byas nas/ stod smad gzhan la tho ma song bar bum can nyid lte 'og tu drag tu bskor bas skran dang dmu chu bad kan mkhris pa sogs phal cher sel bar 'gyur/ yang skran ma zhu ba la rgyab rten la cung zad gan kyal du 'dug lag pa g.yon pa'i rdo rje bsdams pa'i khu tshur kha sbyor gyis 'pho ba bzung zhing skor ba bum can dang bcas pas sel bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar na 'byung ba lnga'i rlung gi gegs sel dang / srog la sogs pa rlung lnga'i gegs sel dang / rlung rengs —369

bcu bcos pa dang / 'khor lo drug la brten pa'i gegs sel te/ de dag ni srog rtsol nyid kyi sgo nas gegs bsal ba'i sde tshan te gnyis pa'o/ /gzhan yang sman gyi sbyor bas bsal ba la/ spyir lan tshwa dang skyur ba'i sman gyis rlung dang / mngar ba dang bska bas mkhris pa dang / kha ba dang tsha bas bad kan yang zhes pa spyir btang yin la/ ro nus zhu rjes kyi rnam pa'i dbye ba mtha' yas pa yod pas mtha' gcig tu ma nges la/ khyad par grogs dang cho ga'i sbyor ba sna tshogs las nus pa tha dad pa du mar 'gyur ro/ /skabs 'dir kun spangs kyi sman sbyor rgyud las gsungs pa ni/ ra'i 'o ma tsha ba gsum dang bcas pas bad kan dang / ma he'i 'o ma ka ra dang bcas pas mkhris pa dang /rnga mo'i 'o ma rgya tshwa dang bcas pas rlung 'joms shing / ba'i 'o ma nyes pa gsum char 'jom byed de/ tsha ba gsum dang bcas pas bad kan ka ra dang bcas pas mkhris pa/ rgya mtsho'i tshwa dang bcas pas rlung sel/ sngar gyi sman de rnams dang bcas pa'i mar dang bcas te sman mar du sbyar ba spel gyin btang bas ldan 'dus sel la/ 'o ma gsar pa rtag par ma 'byor na de dag gis bsdus pa'i tshig ma la yang sbyar bar bshad do/ /dza ti'i 'dab ma'am 'bras bus rang las brgyad 'gyur gyis mang ba'i chu la bkol te bzhi cha tsam lus pa de'am/ mi bskyod pa cung zad dro ba yun ring du khar bzung bas kha nad dang / zug med pa'i so srin sel/ kaṇ+ḍa ka ri'i 'bras bu'i du ba so la bdugs pas kyang zug dang bcas pa'i so srin la phan/ til mar dang ra gcin mnyam du bkol nas bzhi cha tsam lus pa la tsha ba gsum til mar gyi bzhi cha btab// rna bar blugs pas —370—

rna ba'i nad 'joms shing de bzhin du dri chu dron mo blug pas kyang ngo / /ba mar brgyad 'gyur ba'i 'o ma dang lhan cig bskol mar khu tsam lus pa na/ nā ga ge sar dang gur gum bsres pa mar gyi bzhi cha'i tshad tsam sbyar nas snar blugs pas sna nad sel/ ban+ta karko ṭi dang shog shing dang / tig ta'i phye ma bong bu'i chu la sbyar ba byugs pas 'bras dang / sha ro dang / skrangs 'bur la phan/ ban+ta karko ṭi ni mkhan pa 'bru med pa yin zer ba dang / ba sha ka nag po yin par 'dod pa gnyis yod pa phyi ma 'thad do/ /snga ma yang tshab ma rung bar 'dod cing myong bas grub pa yin na mi 'gal lo/ /nyi ma'i shing gi 'dab mas bslan pas kyang de ltar 'gyur bar gsungs la/ 'di bod kyi nyi shing ba yin zer ba mi 'thad cing /tshab ma lcam pa'i 'dab ma brdungs pas rung bar bzhed do/ /lan tshwa'i rigs snyed tshad kyi thum bu mar rnying zhu bar bcug nas dugs byas pas kyang 'bras sogs 'phel ba 'joms shing / tho rangs dri chu grang mo snas rngubs nas rlung 'bud pa'am/ chu grang sna nas rngubs pas mgo nad zhi bar byed cing / dri chu grang mo mig tu blugs pas mig rim la phan/ tho rangs kha bkrus pa'i so la srin lag gis brdar te mig la byug pa dang / zla 'od kyis phog pa'i chu grang tho rangs blangs nas mig la phyar te blugs pas kyang mig khrag tu song ba sogs la phan no/ /tshwa ba gsum dri chu la sbyar ba'i khu ba snar blugs pas 'byung pos zin pa dang / dug sprul dang / khyi smyon sogs g.yo ba'i dug rnams sel bar 'gyur/srog rtsol dang bcas te snying khar pad ma'i gdan la sna tshogs yum dkar mo mchog spyin dang / pad dkar 'dzin pa rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs nga —371

bsgoms nas/ oX phre bi shwa mā ta badz+ra kaṇ+ḍa kaX nā sha ya nā sha ya/ ma ma shān+ti ku ru swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzlas te/ gnas drug tu sngags chus byug pas 'bru/ma nag sogs bsrung zhing / gzhan la bsrung na/ ma ma zhes pa'i gnas su grub bya'i ming bcug nas bzla/ nad gdon gzhan bsrung na/ badz+ra kaṇ+ḍa kaX gyi gnas su nad gdon de dang de'i ming bcug pas sel/ 'brum nad byung ba na/ skya nad kyi dus su/ sran chung dang / ru drwa skya'i 'khru btags pas chu bskol ba la sbyar te/sngags brgya rtsa sogs btab nas 'thung zhing / nyin zhag gsum pa sogs tsha ba cung zad zhi zhing / 'brum du phyir thon pa na 'brum bu'i nad kyis shi ba'i mi thod dri chu grang mo la brdar te/ khong du btang bas sel bar 'gyur/ 'dar bu la sogs pa tshad pa'i nad kyis zin pa la/ skyu ru ra/ 'o su/ da li dkar po rnams cha mnyam pa nyi zla'i 'od kyis reg pa'i chu brgyad 'gyur la bskol/ bzhi cha lus pa'i khu ba de'i bzhi cha'i ka ra dang bsres te/ tho rangs zhag gsum la sogs par zos pas/ tshad pa las grol zhing / rim gyis btab pa la sman de rnams kyi steng du 'jim pa dang de gsum 'gyur a ru ra bsres pas sel bar 'gyur la/'jim pa'i tshad ni nad gyi tshod dang sbyor ro/ /'byor ldan gyi sman dngul chu'i sbyor ba mang du gsungs kyang / bod yul 'dir deng sang rgyud don ltar lag len la khel ba dka' bar snang la/ sman gyi khyad par rnams kyang 'byor ba dka' 'o/ /de ltar na bdud rtsi lnga'i bcud len dang / gser gyi gong bu'i bcud len sogs rnam gzhag rags pa ni rgyud 'grel nyid na gsal lo/ /de dag gi skabs na bshad pa'i bcud len mdor bsdus gnyis ni 'di yin te/ gzhon nu ma'i rdul 372—

zla ba mar ngo la bab pa dang / blo dha rā dza'i khu ba rlung mnyam rgyu'i dus su sna nas rngubs te bum pa can bzung na rgas pa sel zhing lus kyi srin bu med par 'gyur ro/ /de la blo sgo rā dza ni/ bod yul du dod thub ra mo sha yin zhes skabs 'di dang gzhan du bod rnams phal cher gsungs pa/ mngon shes dang ldan pas dod thub kyi sman yin par gzigs na ni ngo mtshar che la/ gzhan du na sman gyi rnam pa dang /ro nus zhu rjes ye mi 'dra bas mi 'thad par mngon/ rtsosgo rā dza ni sa spo ta'i skad yin la/ 'phral skad du bha thi rā zer zhing / mon yul phan chad kyi rgya bal kun tu skye la/ de la dkar nag gnyis las bcud len phal cher la nag po sbyor gyin snang bas 'dir yang nag po yin no/ /rgya bal kun tu skye bas bcal na rnyed sla'o/ /yang sha lnga po rul sum med cing chu ser bton nas skam pa'i phye ma sbrang rtsi'am sbrang chang dang sbyar nas lo gcig zos pas kyang rgas pa dang / nad mtha' dag sel la/ de bzhin du me tog dang byang chub kyi sems bsres pas kyang ngo / /zhes bshad do/ /'di dag ni kun spang gi rdzas sbyor la brten nas gegs bsal ba ste sde tshan gsum pa'o/ /yang spyi khyab tu log gnon gyi man ngag kyang bstan par bya ste/ cha ba shas che na spyi bo'i ha las bdud rtsi ga bur gyi chu lta bu babs pas/ lus gang ba dang / grang shas che na lte ba'i ho las me 'bar bas gang ba dang / lus lji na gsang gnas su rlung gi dkyil 'khor ya gyis mtshan pas lus yer yer du 'degs pa dang / rlung 'gags pa'i rigs la bshang lam nas mthon 'gro bar bsam pa dang / rlung 'khyims pa la spyi gtsug nas mthon par bsam pa dang /—373—

khol bur gzer ba la gang na sar sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi mnan par bsgom pas sel lo/ /log gnon drug po de ni 'gro ba'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi man ngag yin no/ /yang log gnon lnga ste/ stod 'tshangs dang pho ba sbos pa sogs lus gang nas na na/ 'khor lo ltar bskor ba bya ste/ bum can bzung / lte bar 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ g.yas g.yon du res mos kyi 'khor bar bsams la lto ba bskor mthar je che je che la nam mkha'i mthar klas par bsam/ lus dmigs kyi na na/ gru gu ltar 'gril ba bsgom ste/ gang na sar bu ga hur gyis byung / rlung bzung nas gtong ba'i dus su/ bu ga nas phar rlung ro nag po rta rnga lta bu nar gyis thon/ phyi rol tu gru gu ltar 'gril nas nang du mi bzlog par bsam rim gyis de je sbom du btang / lus phal cher khyab par nan bu ga mang po'i sbyor ba bya ste/ lus lcags tshags lta bur bsam/ rlung ro drag tu gdon/ bu ga thams cad nas rlung 'tshub kyi rnam pa phyur phyur 'gro bar bsam/ lus stod smad phyed mar na ba sogs byung na/ 'khor lo med pa zhes bya ba bsgom ste/ gang na sa de sbubs stong je yangs je yangs la song ste/ nam mkha' dang 'dres par bsam/ rlung gis shes pa 'phro zhing yer ba dang / mchongs rgyug byed pa sogs byung na rab tu dma' ba'i sbyor ba zhes bya ba la bslab ste/ nyal sa yang sa dong lta bur bya/dmigs pa rang lus sa 'og tu thim pa'am/ chu dron mo'i nang du byings shing lus zhu ba'am/ mar nag gi mtsho nang du lus bcug par bsgom pas sel log gnon lnga po 'di ni bsam mi khyab kyi gdams ngag sogs na yang snang ngo / /spyir gegs sel gyi gdams ngag ni gcig tu nges pa med de/ lam gyi cha lag —374—

tsam yin pa'i phyir dang / gegs mi 'byung ba yang mang zhing / yod pa'i rigs la'ang gegs kyi rigs gcig gnyis tsam ma gtogs mtha' dag mi 'byung ba'i phyir dang / dus skabs nyi tshe ba de ka ma gtog rtag tu nyams su len mi dgos pa'i phyir/ phan tshun bsre slad du 'gyur ba'i nyes pa 'ga' yang mi bskyed pas na/gdams ngag gzhan las 'byung ba rnams kyang 'dir blangs pas chog la/ de yang man ngag khungs ma lag len dang 'brel ba zhig blangs dgos kyi/ lag len gyi rgyun med na gnad longs pa dka' zhing / man ngag brdzus ma las 'gyung ba rnams kyi lag len yod kyang gegs mi sel ba'am/ phyogs gcig gi gegs sel kyang gegs gzhan skye ba sogs 'byung bas/ lag len khungs ldan btsal bar bya la/ spyir rtsa'i gegs sel 'khrul 'khor/ rlung gi gegs sel rlung sbyor/thig le'i gegs sel de gnyis 'dzom pa'i bzhu btul/ sems kyi gegs la dmigs pa'i gnad sna tshogs su 'pho ba rnams kyis sel ba yin no/ /skabs de dag thams cad du/ ye shes phebs pa'i nyams dang / sgom log gi gegs dang /sgom skyon ma yin pa'i 'gyung ba lus 'khrugs kyi nad rnams ma nor ba gal che/ye shes phebs pa'i nyams la/ ha 'don dang dbyug bcos dang sman dang / me gtar la sogs pa gang /smung mi bya ste/ nyams ngo sprad de nyams byung rgyal du bskyangs pas gegs med cing / yon tan gong 'phel du 'gyur/ bcos gzhan de rnams byas na/ sgom log tu 'gyur zhing gegs chen po da gdod skye ba mang zhing / nyams bzang po yal zhing yon to skye 'phro 'chad ba yin no/ /sgom skyon tsam yin na/ dmigs pa rlung sbyor 'khrul 'khor sogs kyi sel dgos shing /—375—

sman gtong ba yang rung la/ me gtar dbyug bcos sogs ni phal cher la mi legs so/ /sgom skyon ma yin par/ nad gzhi tsam gyis khams ma snyoms pa yin na/ nang gi rnal 'byor dang sman dpyad me gtar la sogs pa gang gis bcos kyang rung bar shes par bya'o/ /de dag ni log gnon gegs sel gyi sde tshan te bzhi pa'o/ /yang rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i gegs sel gyi man ngag sman dpyad dang shas cher 'brel ba lugs gzhan yang brjod par bya ste/ 'di la gnyis te/rten lus las byung ba'i gegs dang / brten pa sems las byung ba'i gegs so/ /dang po la rtsa rlung thig le gsum las/ rtsa ni rang bzhin gyi bzang ba dang /ngan pa gnyis yod kyang rlung sems kyi gnas tshul yin pas lus dal ba dang /skabs su khrus dang / bsku mnye dang / lus kyi gnad bcun pa dang / lus ma 'gram pa kho nas chog go /'on kyang sgom pa'i rkyen rnams/ khur so'am/brdabs pa la sogs pas mi bde ba dang / rtsa phran chad pa lta bu thams cad la lus ngal bar bya ste/ mi bskyod pa'am/ yang na 'om bu dang / bal lu dang / shug pa dang / tshe dang / mkhan pa bstos pa'i chus bkrus la/ skabs su bsku byug bya ste/ des bde bar 'gyur ro/ /rtsa chad pa dang rma byung na dmigs pa ni khams byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar 'thab pa la sems gtad la skabs su mi bskyod pas bkru'o/ /sngo breg pa thang du bya ba'am/ sbrang dang sbyar la bza'/ 'di ni chad pa dang / mgo lus kyi rtsa skyon dang mtshon gyi rma thams cad la phan pa yin no/ /rtsa 'chus pa lta bu la ni/ thog ma ji ltar bsdad pa'i lus gnad byas la/—376—

de nas khad kyis rlung 'jam por bzung la/ lus g.yas dang g.yon du gcu zhing lag mthil gyis byug rtsa'i nad kyi gegs thams cad la 'di rnams kyis phan no/ /gnyis pa rlung gi gegs la gsum du 'du ste/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga dang yan lag gi rlung lnga dang / khyad par gyi rlung rengs lnga'o/ /mkhris pa dang / bad kan gnyis thig le'i snyigs ma yin yang / rlung gis ma dkrugs na nad mi byed pas/mi mnyam mkhris pa dang sdongs nas tshad pa'i nad thams cad bskyed pas de ni rgyu yin te/ rkyen dus dang gdon dang / zas dang spyod lam bzhis byed la/ gnas pa'i sa mchin mkhris la brten nas nad du byed pa ni/ khrag sha tshil rus rkang khu ba'i gnas su song nas/ don snod la nad du 'gro ba yin/ nad rigs mang yang skabs 'dir khrag 'phel ba dang / mkhris pa 'phel ba gnyis la/ rtags ni kha kha zhing / lce gzhung ser/ lus drod che gnyid che/ drod bcud gnod/ nyi mas dros na na/ chu dmar ser la spris ma 'thug rnyog ma che/ rtsa drag tu 'phar zhing grims/ khyad par du nyin gung mtshan gung la mi bde ba yin/ de bsal ba ni/ kha zas mi za/ lus rtsog bu'am/ skyil krung gang bde bya/ rlung kha nas sing sgras rngubs la pho bar dgang / sna nas hū gis drag tu dbyung / re mos kyi thun du bcad la bya/ dmigs pa ni pho bar me mnyam gnas pa'i sar/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsil ba dang 'od dang bcas pa yar 'gro mar 'gro la sems gtad/ de kyang mi phan pa'i nad stobs che na/ mi bskyod pa grang mo la/ a ru ra/ gla rtsi/tsan dan/ ga bur bzhi gang rnyed btab la btung / rlung myur du skye ru 'ong bas —377—

brtags shing byed pa gal che'o/ khyad par du gnyan dang tshad gzer drag po byung na/ gong gi dmigs pa bya/ rlung mi bzung / dri chu/ gla rtsi/ thar nu/ bong nga /ming can/ ru rta/ li shi gang 'dzom btags la cha mnyam par byas la btang /gong gi sman de rnams ma rnyed kyang / chu grang dang mi bskyod pa kho nas phan par bshad do/ /nad kyi rtse chag nas btung du mi btub/ grang bar 'gro 'ong bas so//gnyis pa bad kan la skya ser skrug po gsum yod kyang / skya bo pho stod na gnas/ ser po mkhris pa dang bsdongs pa yin/ smug po ni lus kyi khrag pho bar babs pa yin/ spyir brten sa ni klad pa yin/ rtags ni lus lci/ dang kha mi bde/ be snabs dang / chu skyur dang / ser po dang / khrag rus skyug chu dkar la rnyog /smug po la smug la rnyog /dri chen sol ba 'dra ba'am/ khrag dang ser por 'ong / zas bcud chen gnod/ rtsa dal zhing bying ba yin/ khyad par du dpyid dang / srod dang/ snga gro dang / de bcos pa ni/ rlung steng 'og kha sbyar la bzung /kha zas ran par bza'/ skabs su sna dang kha nas dbyung / sked pa dang / rkang pa dang / lag pa rnams mi bde na sked skor dang sprug pa bya/ sman byed na/ skya bo be snabs su skyug pa la/ se 'khru/ sug smel/ shing tshwa/ pi yi ling btang / 'gril ba lta bu byung na cong zhi dang / tshwa bsregs pa bsnan la btang / ser po la gong gi se 'khru bzhi pa la/ a ru ra dang brag zhun bsnan la btang / pho ba lag mthil gyis mnye/ de rnams kyis ma phan na/ pho stod du ber ka brdeg go /smug po la ni/cong zhi/ brag zhun/ 'u su/ sga skya/ a ru ra/ gur gum/ pri yang ku rnams sbyar la za/ des kyang 'gril zhing ma phan na/ mi bskyod pa la a ru ra/ dong kha tshwa la —378—

bsregs pa btab cing 'thungs pas sbyongs yong / sbyongs rjes/ se 'bru bzhi pa dang gong ma rnams za/ ber ka dang 'khrul 'khor drag po rnams mi bya'o/ /byas na yang khrag pho bar babs nas nad 'ong / khyad par du cong zhi khrol bur zos nas lus sbyongs sngags so/ /gsum pa rlung gi nad la/ spyir rtsa ba dang yan lag gi rlung thams cad kyi gegs sel ba dang / bye brag so sor bsal ba'o/ /dang po lus thams cad zi ba dang / 'khyoms pa dang 'phyo zhing gnyid med pa dang / zer gzug dang / chu sngo zhing sbu ba che/ rtsa dal myur gang yin yang stong zhing / dgong kha dang tho rangs na ba ni rtags yin no/ /gegs sel ni lus la bsku byug bya/ rkang pa skyil krung lag pa mnyam bzhag bya/ mig thur la gtad/ dmigs pa lte 'og tu sa'i dkyil 'khor ram/ gser gyi rdo rje shin tu lci ba zhig bsgoms la 'og sgo drag tu bsdom zug gi dmigs la rdo 'am/ gyo dum tsha mos bdug /zas drod bcud bsten no/ /rlung gi nad phal che ba des sel bar 'gyur ro/ /bye brag du sel ba la rtsa ba'i rlung lnga srog 'dzin la ni/ 'khrugs pa dang / rengs pa dang / stong ste gnas tshe pa gsum ste/ dang po ni 'khrugs pa'i rkyen ni sgom pa dang / slob gnyer drag po dang / mya ngan dang / sems las drag pos byed la/ ngo bo ni srog rtsa'i rlung 'khrugs pa yin/ rtags ni mchin srog dang sgal gzhung / sems mi bde/kha nas shugs ring 'don/ snying 'phar zhing / phyi rol gyi skad dang / rdog sgra snying gi nang du grags pa snyam byed/ de la bcos pa ni/ lus thams cad sbang ma'am/mkhan pa'i chu dang mi bskyod pas bkrus la bsku byug bya/ dmigs pa ni/ lus —379—

stong sang nge ba la/ nang du zla ba'i 'od shar ba ltar dkar sang nge bar bsam/lus skyil krung bcas la pus mo gnyis la lag pas 'jus te lus bsrang /mgrin pa dgye bor rgyab tu 'then la kha nas ha zhes drag la ring bar brjod la rlung dbyung zi thom byung ba dang ba 'ag /des gyen du 'tshangs byung na/ 'bebs pa'i 'khrul 'khor 'ga' bya/ rjes la bsku byug bya/ de ltar thun du bcad la bya/dus gcig la mang grags na mi bzang / rim gyis je mang du bya'o/ /srog 'dzin rengs pa ni/ srog rtsa'i nang du shing bcug pa 'dra/ rtags g.yin sngar dang phyogs mthun/ de bsal ba ni/ lus tsog pur byas nas/ rlung sna nas hu gis dal bus dbyung / yang skyil krung byas te sa la brdab/ de gnyis re mos bya/dmigs pa lte bar thig le dkar dmar 'thab pa la sems gtad/ des sel lo/ /srog rlung ltengs te gnas 'khyams na/ rtags snga ma rnams kyi thog tu shes pa dang / rlung nang du bsdud cing brgyal ba lta bu 'gyung / de la lus sbyongs dang /rlung rtsol drag po mi bya bar klod la/ rig pa rang sor bzhag steng du rlung sems 'gro ba snyam byed na/ 'og tu shes pa gtad/ bying ba snyam byed na/ mgrin pa'am dpral bar gtad/ nang du 'thum pa snyam byed na kha sna gnyis ka nas dbyung ngo /sman byed na/ a ka ru nag po/ go snyod/ snying zho sha drod sman hril 'jong gnyis ka ru rta spos dkar dzā ti de rnams gang 'tshogs btang / rlung stobs shin tu che na/ sha chen nam/ shing khun/ sgog skya btang / rlung skye ba'i spyod lam mi bya'o/ /gnyis pa gyen rgyu la gsum ste/ thur sel dang sdongs te stod du 'tshangs pa dang / 'khrugs pa dang / stong pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sgom nyes pa dang / nyal nyes —380—

pa dang / lta stangs steng du grags pas byung ba yin/ rtags ni dang po pho ba nas yar phus btab pa bzhin 'ong zhing / mgrin pa man chad rkyal pa phus btab pa'am/ khang chung dud pas 'tshub pa bzhin 'ong zhing gzer/ skad mi thon/ 'og sgo sdud mi shes/ de bcos pa ni/ lus tsog pu'am/ yang na skyil krung bya/ rang gi lag pa gnyis kyi mkha' la lus bteg la brdab/ rang gis mi nus na/ stan gyi stebs su bsdad la/ mi gnyis kyi sor bzhi tsam btegs la brdab/ lan gsum bzhi tsam nas sa la bzhag la tshigs gzhung khu tshur gyis brdung / rlung gi gnad ni/ 'og sgo drag tu bsdam/ steng ye mi bzung / dmigs pa ni lus 'degs dus su/ rlung thams cad 'og sgo nas thon nas dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la thim par bsgom mo/ /'khrugs pa ni/ rtags gzhan sngar dang phyogs mthun pa las/ mi nor ba'i rtags ni/ stod du 'tshangs pa dang / phur bus btab pa bzhin gzer yang 'og sgo ni sdud shes pa'o/ /'di bcos pa ni/ gang gzer sar gru gu'am/ pho rdo khu tshur tsam bcings la/ grogs gcig gis ro stod pang gis btab la sprug de nas dal bus sa la bzhag ste/ khu tshur gyis brdung pa dang bsku byug bya'o/ /des ma phan na sngar ltar yang bya'o/ /'di gnyis ni/ nad rlung rtsa la rengs pa'i stod rengs kyang yin no/ /yang 'khrugs pa'i rigs gcig la ske dang lkog ma skrangs shing 'gyur mi shes pa dang / kha 'tham pa 'ong ste/ de la ni rlung kha sbyor byas nas mgrin par drag tu bkang la lag pas mnye/ gtong tsa na ha zhes sna nas btang / ha yang skabs su brjod/ g.yer ma go snyod tshwa dang gsum mar nag gam mar gang rung —381—

la sbyar nas bskol la 'jam tsam gyis byugs la 'phur/ skabs su mi bskyod pas kyang bkru'o/ /stong pa ni rlung gi nus pa zad pa yin te/ /stod rnams mi bde rlung bus tsa na shed med pa zhig 'ong / mgo zi ba la sogs pa'i rlung rtags rnams 'ong / de bcos pa ni/ bsku byug dang drod dugs bya/ /rlung nang du bzung /dbyung ba bya mi nyan/ mdor na gyen rgyu'i nus pa skye dgos pa yin/ gong gi gnyis ni gyen rgyu 'phel ba'i skyon yin pas gzhil dgos pa yin no/ /gsum pa thur sel la skyon gsum ste/ gyen rgyu dang 'grogs te smad du 'tshangs pa dang / 'khrugs pa dang stongs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thur du rlung mi thon te/ 'og rgyangs nas rdo ltar 'gro zhing gzer rtsa bsdud/ zhag gcig lus na srog gi bar chad du 'gro ste/ de bsal ba ni lus tsog pur byas la/ lag pa gnyis dpung pa la bsnol mar 'jus te/ rlung sna nas hū zhes dal la ring bar bus te phyir bkag la/ lto ba sgal pa la sbyar la yar nus tshad 'then la/ yang rlung rngubs pa dang dus gcig tu lus klod/ dmigs pa ni rlung thams tsad smin mtshams su 'dus par bsams te/ lta stangs smin phrag tu gtad/ de ltar mang du byas pa'i rjes la/ 'phur ba dang bsku byug bya/ nges sel lo/ /'khrugs pa ni/gong dang 'dra la khang pa la/ khyad par ni res na res bde/ dri chu ser la sdom/res bshal tsha 'byug byed de bsal ba ni/ lte 'og tu 'bo rdo khu tshur tsam du bcings la/ kha bub tu nyal te rkang pa'i rting pas 'phongs su rdeg cing brkyang bskum res mos kyis bya'o/ /yang na grogs gcig gis rkang pa gyen du bstan nas khur ba'am pang gis 'degs pa gang bde byas la sprug /rjes su sgal —382—

tshigs la sogs pa rnams ran pa khu tshur gyi brdung bsku byug bya'o/ /stongs pa ni/thur sel gyi nus pa nyams pa yin pas/ rtsa rgyud rnams na khog smad lci 'og rlung mi thub pa yin/ de ni kha zas drod bcud bsten/ 'og sgo 'then 'phul bya/ bcu drug mdor khu tshur kyis brdung ste des sel bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar stod smad gnyis ka la rjes phan dka' na/ gang dmigs yod sar ber ka rdeg go /dzā ti/rgyam tsha/ drod sman hril 'jong/ sga skya shing khun/ sgog skya gang 'dzom rus khu'am/chang gis phul la btang bar bya'o/ /'di ni pho ba'i mkhris pa 'ju byed stongs pa'i nad yin no/ /bzhi pa me mnyam la ni gegs gsum ste/ gang ba dang / stong pa dang /gzer ba'o/ /dang po ni pho ba'i rlung gis stong sbos byas te/ mi bde zhing /'grangs pa dang / ltog dus mi bde ba yin/ de la rlung kha nas pho bar mid pa bzhin byas te bcug lag lag mthil gyis mnye/ de nas sbreg pa bton pas chog go /sman byed na/ se 'khru sug smel/ li shi/ pi yi ling / tsi tra ka rgyam tshwa gang 'dzom chu bskol gyis phul la btang ngo / /'di ni pho ba'i bad kan myags byed dang gnyis sdongs pa yin pas rlung kha nas ha zhes bton nas/ rjes su ber ka khru gang tsam gyis rtse mo pho khar gtad de bskor ba dang/ yang na lag pa'i khu tshur pho khar gtad la/ mgo bo thur du bstan nas bya/ skyug pa byung na bde bar 'gyur ro/ /stongs pa la rigs gnyis yod de/ grang bas stongs pa dang / tshad pas stongs pa'o/ /de la grang bas stongs pa ni/ pho bar 'ur sgra sgrog cing / sgra bcas su sbyong / be snabs dang zas mdog 'khru ba yin/ de la ni gong gi sman —383—

nam/ yang na tsha ba gsum po gang rnyed btang zhing / sked skor mang du byas pas sel lo/ /tsha bas stongs pa ni/ khrag gam ser po'am/ tshur 'khru yang drod chen po tsha sha ra ra sbyong ba yin/ de la ni kha nas rlung sgra bcas su pho bar bcug la/pho bar phu sub bya/ 'og sgo 'then 'phul bya/ des kyang ma phan na/ chu grang ngam/mi bskyod pa grang mo btung la lus sbyongs bya/ rgyam tshwa/ kha ru tshwa/ snya lo/ btsod/a ru ra/ brag zhun gang rnyed thang du byas la btung ngo / /'di ni 'pho ba'i mkhris pa 'ju byed dang sdongs pa'i nad yin no/ /tsha grang gnyis ka'i rjes su 'bras thug gam tha rams sam/ ram bu'i thug pas sbyongs bcad do/ /yang na da trig gi thang btang ngo / /snga ma rnams kyis 'khru ba chad na de tsho btang mi dgos so/ /gzer ba ni/ pho ba'i dkyil du gzer ba yin te/ de la rlung gis pho ba bkang la/ lag pa gnyis spyi bor bteg cing pho bar brdeg /yang na mnye zhing khu tshur gyis brdung / 'di la yang nang du tsha lam lam byed na tshad pa yin/ grang lhang lhang byed na grang ba yin pas/ rlung 'dzin lugs dang sman ni snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /gsum ka la lto ba gyang ngam shing ngam/ rdo lta bu la bkal la rkang lag re mos kyi g.yab cing ha zhes rlung kha nas bton pas kyang phan/ gzer ba 'di srin la yang yong bas srin nad la ni/ a ru ra/ zel tshwa/ rgyam tshwa/ pi pi ling chu bskol gyis phul la btang bas phan/ des kyang mi phan pa'i thu ba la/ thang khrom gyi 'bras bu bsnan/ cis kyang ma phan nam/ sman ma rnyed na/ srin 'gril sar ber ka brdeg cing / tshwa chu blud pas phan no/ /da ni zhar la ma zhu ba 'chos na/ ma zhu ba gsar pa la ni/ rlung kha nas pho 384—

bar bcug cing lus tsog pu bsdad la/ 'og sgo 'then 'phul bya zhing / 'khrul 'khor gyis dkrugs pas sbyongs par 'gyur ro/ /yang kha nas sgro'am/ mdzum mo bcug ste rlung kha nas gyen du drangs la skyug go /sman gyis bcos na/ mar dang zho dar dang 'o ma rnams ma zhu ba la/chur khu bskol la bshung / sha ma zhu na sog pa'i khrung khrung bskol la btung / chang ma zhu na sog tshigs bskol la btung / tsam pa ma zhu na bul tog bskol la btung / chu dang sman ma zhu na rgyam tshwa bskol la btung / ma zhu ba snying pa gril ba dang / skran la pho bar rlung bcug ste lag pa'i sor mos yun ring du mnyes la/ rjes su a ru ra dang rgyam tshwa'i thang re mos kyis btang / des bde bar 'gyur ro/ /lnga pa khyab byed la gegs gsum ste/ rengs pa dang 'khru/gas pa dang stongs pa'o/ /dang po ni drag shul dang lung gis skyen gyis rkang lag rnams blo bur du rengs shing 'khum par 'gyur te/ de la mar snying pa'am zhun gyis legs par byugs la/ rlung gis lus thams cad dal bus bkang la/ phur zhing kha sna gnyis nas hu dang he yis dbyung / drod sman ci rigs btang / des 'tsho'o/ /gnyis pa 'khrugs pa ni/ lus kyi yan lag gi rtsa rgyus rnams na zhing /khab kyis gtsags pa 'dra ba 'byung ste/ de bsku byug bya zhing / zas bcud can bsten/ mi bskyod pas bkru rlung kha sbyor ran par bzung ngo / zhabrul 'khor mi chen lugs bya/ yang 'khrugs pa rigs shig pags pa thams cad rtse zhing chu bur thug thug pa 'byung / de la mi bskyod pa'am/ mkhan pa'i chus bkru/ chu grang —385—

mo'am mi skyod pa la spangs pa'i ras kyis dkris la/ rlung kha sbyor nus tshad du sdom des bde bar 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa stongs pa ni yan lag gi shed shor nas sgul skyod dka' ba da/nga / tshig rnams lhod cing mi theg pa yin/ de la rlung bzung nas phur sub legs par bya shing / khong du dbang po lag pa la sogs pa'i rtsa ba lnga/ sbrang rtsi'am mar dkar dang sbyar la za/ rlung bzung nas rtse mo dang mchongs rgyug bya/des skyon las grol lo/ /da ni gnyis pa yan lag gi rlung rnam pa lnga las/ mig du rgyu ba rengs na/tsha grang gnyis las/ grang ba la rlung dang bad kan gnyis te/ dang po ni rlung bsgoms pas mig 'bur ba dang mi gsal bar gyur na/ ras la mi bskyod pa grang mo btang la mig dkris te ltag khung du 'dud la phyi gan du nyal la/ rkang lag drag tu brkyangs la bcud cing brkyang bskum bya/ rkang pa'i rting pa dang ltag khung du bsku byug bya zhing / dmigs pa ni ltag khung du thig le dkar po'am/ser po la dmigs pa gtad/ mig tu rlung rengs nas ha re long ba lta bur gyur na/ srin lag gis lag pa'i mthil du drud la mig tu blan/ lag pa'i mthil gyis dal bus phur zhing zas drod bcud bsten no/ /zas za dus mig la rlangs pas bdug /meg gi 'khrul 'khor bya/ bad kan gyi mig skya rib tu gyur na/ snga dro kha ma bshal ba'i so la sen mo drud la mig la blan/ rtag tu du sbrang dang sbyar la bza'/ yang na a ba/ gur gum/ mdung rtse/ go snyod/ dom mkhris/ lcags sbrul a ru ra'i skyo ma lcags sder la byug pa rnams sbrang dang sbyar la lho stong la —386—

—— ——thum ze bza'/ bad kan la gnod pa'i zas mi za'o/ /tshad pa'i rkyen las byung ba'i rmi/ga nad ni/ khrag dang mkhris pa gnyis las/ khrag gi nad kyis mig tshag pa dang / sha 'dzer byung ba dang / mkhris pas mig drod che zhing ser ba yong de dag thams cad la mi bskyod pa grang mo byas la mig la bsku'o/ /'bras bu gsum dang gur gum btang na bzang / sman byed na/ gur gum/ skye ba'i bar zhun/ a ru ra/ reg rdo bsregs pa/ de rnams cha mnyam ste zhib tu btags la chu dang sbyar mig la byug /des kyang ma phan na/ ltag khung gi mig rtsa la dbyug pa rgyab la khrag dbyung / mig gnad pa la yang mi bskyod pa grang mo btab cing khrag skyes na gong ltar bya'o/ /ling thog dang sha 'dzer byung na/ ling thog gi dkyil na phar rlung thon par bsam la dmigs pa gtad/ o theb long / neb long / tsha te long / sur+ya tsan+d+ra 'di long zhig ces bzlas la lhag khung nas gdab/ phug ron gyi dang sgro la sngags la/ ling thog blangs/ gong gi sman yang byug /shin tu bcad dka' na/ mig rus rtsa can/ rgya tshwa/ dung bsregs pa'i phye ma btab/ rjes su gur gum byug go /rna ba ru rgyu ba rengs na/ nad rigs mang yang tshad pas 'grams pa dang lung gnyis las dang po ni/ rna ba nas khrag dang chu ser dang rnag 'bab pa dang drod che ba'o/ /de rnams la thog mar seng ge rnam grol gyi phyag rgya cung zad sprugs la/ de'i 'og tu rlung dbyung ba byas te/ rna ba ru rlung dang rig pa gtad pas des rnag la sogs pa thon no/ /rnag khrag skams nas 'on na rna ba'i gting du sngo ba dang dmar ba 'byung / de la rgya tshwa dang / khug chos kyi 'bras bu/ru rta gsum mi bskyod pa dang sbyar la rna bar blug cing dal bus phye la/ rjes su —387—

————ma 'gram par bya'o/ /rlung gis 'on pa la/ gtum mo'i me la dmigs pa gtad cing rna ba'i mdun du snum byugs la mnye'o/ /rna ba ru rlung dang rol mo'i sgra byung zhing 'on na/ mgo rus rnying pa bskol ba'i nang du/ shing khun dbang po lag pa/ru rta/ kha ru tshwa/ se 'khru/ sug smel/ pi pi ling / mkhal ma zho sha rnams phye ma zhib tu byas la btab ste bskol ba'i rlangs pa la rna ba bdug cing rlangs pa yal ba dang / khu ba phor chung re btung des rlung 'on la phan no/ /snar rgyu ba rengs na dbugs dbyung rngub dka' zhing du ba 'tshub pa ltar 'gyur/ he'i sgras rlung mang du 'gyung rngub bya/ chu ser ram thor bu lta bus 'gags na/ ru rta dang / bca' sga mi bskyod pa dang sbyar la snar rngubs te mnyes la/ drag tu bus rjes su mi bskyod pas kyang bkru/ sna khrag pho/ra na/ lus skyil krung byas la/ lag pa rgyab gzhung du khu tshur mi drag tsam gyis brdung zhing / sprug pa dang rdung ba res mos bya'o/ shin tu chod dka' ba la/ skra bsregs pa dang / de nyid bskam pa'i phye ma snar rngub cing /smin mtshams dang tshigs pa drug bdun gyi g.yas g.yon du ber ka brdeg rdo grang mo blan no/ /rlung gi rkyen gyis sna khrag 'ong ba yang yod pas/ rkang mthil du sgog pa byug go /lce la rgyu ba rengs na smra ba dka' ba dang / /lce dang mchu rnams su thor pa 'ong ba dang / so na ba 'ong / dang po la rlung mgrin par bzung la lag mthil gyis 'phur zhing / lce'i rtsa bar ya ra las me 'bar te/ ngag gi skyon thams cad bsregs par bsgom/ thor pa dang khrag gis mi bde ba la/ a ru ra/tshur nag zhu mkhan gang 'dzom mi bskyod pa la sbyar te khar bzung / yun ring du song ba dang phyir pho la 'jibs nas chus bshal lo/ khyad par du gag pa lta bu —388—

la/ rgya tshwa/ li shi/ me tog gsum pa'am/ de ma rnyed na lce tsha ba'am/ srub ma dang sbyar la gdab bo/ /rlung gi so na ba la ni mi bskyod pa dron mo'am/ mar khu dron mo khar bzung pa'am/ yang na 'phyid pa snum tshos dron mos mnan no/ /rlung srin la mkhan pa dang / khyi'i spu mar du bcos la mnan no/ /mi ma yin pa'i rkyen gyis ngag mnan par gyur na/ rang yi dam lce rdo rje rtse lnga pa'am/ ral gri bsgoms la sngags kyi 'od zer me lta bus gnod byed bsregs par bsam ste/ oṃ ā hū/ bdag gi ngag la rak+ta rak+ṣa ku ru swāhā/ zhes bzlas so/ /rdzas ni/ shu dag /ga bur/ gla rtsi/ mkhan pa a krong / phur mo mngar gsum dang sbyar nas ril lu byas te/ khar mur chus bshal lo/ pags pa la rgyu ba rengs na/ za 'khrug la sogs pa pags pa'i nad du 'gyur te/ de bcos pa ni/ mi bskyod pa drod mos khrus bya zhing / des ma phan na tshwa dang g.yer ma/ chur rtsa'i rtsa ba dud pa ma shor bar bsregs pa'i thal ba rnams zhib tu brdungs la/ mar nag gam/ mar gyi nang du btab la bskus shing nyi mas bsreg u ba ru gyur nas bdud rtsi'i phye ma mar khur btab la/ bdud rtsi chen po'i mar khu'am/ yang na dur byid dang chur rtsa thar nu gang 'dzom bsregs pa'i thal ba mar dang sbyar la bsku'o/ /pags pa'i bar du chu ser gyis gang nas skrangs na/ thog mar rlung hū gis dbyung ba mang du byas la/ rlung phyi bus te seng ge rnam grol gyi phyag rgya bcas la drag tu sprug go /sman ni so ma rā ja pa'am mdzo mo'i dar ba gsar pa'am/ mi bskyod pas phul te za'o/ /'dis ni sha lpags kyi mdze nad kyang sel lo/ rma rnying dang / 'bras dang / phol mig dang / ser ka —389—

'tshor med pa rnams la ni/ rlung bzung nas dmigs pa der gtad nas drag tu bcud de byang sems dkar dmar rma'i nang du 'thab pa la sems gtad/ dri chen/ spyang brun/ khyi lud dkar po pa g.yag dang / lug thug gi rwa gzhob/ mi dang phag pa'i tshil rnams 'bru mar dang sbyar la bsku'o/ /des nges par 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /'bras dang me dbal mdzer pa nag po'i rigs sha dang rus pa la zin zhing nyung ma 'khyags pa lta bur gyur pa rnams la/ thar nu/ re cag spyang 'tsher gsum gyi rtsa ba dri chen dri chu tshwa dud pa rnams sbyar la rma la bsku zhing / sbang ma'i lums su bcug la/ rjes thams cad chod nas shin tu tsha bar gyur pa dang /tshod bzung nas gong gi sman gyis bskus na 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /'brum nag la sogs pa 'brum pa'i nad la/ bya rkang gzugs pa'i 'khrul 'khor bcas la/ rlung kha sbyar du bzung la/ mnan zin nas 'gyel 'gyel du bcud cing rjes su mi bskyod pa la sran chung btab la/ thod pa'i nang du btags pa btung ngo / /de dag ni yan lag gi rlung gi gegs sel 'phros dang bcas pa'o/ /sga skya/ drod sman 'jong mo/ bur dkar dang gsum bskol la/ ja sun tsam re/ nyin gcig thengs gnyis 'thungs na/ 'bu rnon la phan no/ /thig le'i gegs sel bstan pa ni/ rgyu rkyen ngos zin par bya ste/ dang po nyon mongs pa'i bag chags kyis 'dzag pa ni/ gnyen po theg pa thun mong gi thabs/ mi sdug pa bsgoms pa rig pa kun brtags sam/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa'i shes rab kyis so sor brtags nas/ sgyu ma lta bu'i —39()—

stong pa nyid bsgom pa ste/ gsum po 'di gang zag gis blo rigs dang sbyar nas bsgom pa gal che/ /gnyis pa thig le gdon gyis 'dzag pa ni/ rmi lam na/ rta dang / khyi dang /bud med la sogs pa rmi zhing / mi 'dod bzhin du 'dzag par 'gyur ro/ /de'i gnyen po ni spyi yi dam bsgom bzlas bya ba'am/ bye brag tu gtum mo bsgoms pa lta bu yin na/ gtum mo me shin tu 'bar ba bsgom ste/ rlung 'jin pa dang dus gcig tu rmi lam du gang byung ba de thul gyi bsregs par bsgoms nas/ rlung phar 'bud tsa na thal ba rgyangs ring du gtor bar bsam/ gtum mo mi bsgom na/ bdag nyid yi dam gang yin pa gnas gyur pa las/ pad ma nyi zla'i steng du byang chub sems dpa' ha nu man+da/ sku mdog dmar smug /zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas na ri rab/ g.yon na ljon shing bsnams pa/ spyan bgrad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags rdo rje'i rnam pa me 'bar ba/ rgyan med cing lus la ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba/ de'i gsang ba rdo rje rtse lnga pa me rab tu 'bar bas gnod byed bsregs par bsgoms la/ o sidha ban ta ra mu kha/ o bhe te bhe te/ ma bhe te ma bhe te/ ma bhi sha ma sa ma sa hū phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas shing / de rjes la/ o na shu kra dha ra ni bha dha mi si ha hi swāhā/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad re bzlas so/ /rdzas kyi bsrung ba byed na/ pad+ma rak+ta gtsang ma dang / sa ma pa ra zer ba'ang 'dug byin brlabs can gyi dri chu dang / yungs kar bsregs pa'i thal ba dang /gu gul dang de rnams zhib tu btags te ril bu yungs kar tsam byas la gong gi shu kra'i sngags brgya'am/ stong ngam khri'am/ 'bum tshun chod bzlas te/ ril bu —391—

mi bskyod pa la sbyor dbang po'i sgo rnams su byug pa'am/ yang na ril bu re mid nas yi ge hi me 'bar ba gcig tu gyur par bsgoms na'ang zhag mang du bsrung ngo / /yang gzhon nu mas bkal ba'i skud pa dkar po'am nag po la gong gi sngags bzlas nas sked pa la bcings na yang srung bar 'gyur ro/ /nad gzhi grang ba dang 'gram skyon gnyis las 'gyung ba yod de/ grang ba la ni se 'bru/sug smel/ pi pi ling / rgya tshwa/ rgyam tshwa/ kha ru tshwa/ mkhal ma zho sha/ sdig srin/bye ma/ sngo bre kha ba/ de rnams gang 'dzoms pa sbrang rtsi'am bu dkar la sbyar ba'i ril bu'am/ yang na rus khus phul la btang / gcan gzan la sogs pa'i pags pa dron mos mkhal khung dang / sked pa la bcings pa'am/ yang na gdan dro bar bya/ kha zas bcud can btang / des kyang ma phan na/ gru mos sleb pa'i mkhal khung thad ka'i tshigs pa bcu bzhi pa'i g.yas g.yon du mtshon re gzhal ba'i sar dbyug chos bya ba'am/ yang na me tsa bya/ des nges par sel bar 'gyur ro/ /brdabs pa la sogs pa'i 'gram pa la a ru ra/ brag zhun/ bre kha ba de rnams sbrang rtsi la sbyar la grang shas che na pi yi ling bsres la za'o/ /des nges par phan no/ /spyod lam gyis 'dzag pa ni/ /ngal dub la sogs pa'i rkyen gang yin pa de/ cha mnyam pas sel bar 'gyur ro/ /de rnams ni phal pa rnams dang bcas pa spyi la 'byung ba'i gegs sel lo/ khyad par du rtsa rlung bsgoms pas khams byang chub kyi sems rgyas pas 'dzag pa rnams la/ dang po lus 'khrugs pa'i dus su bsrung ba byas pa don chung zhing / phyis gegs sel gyi mi phan par 'gyur ba yin pas/ rang sor klod la bzhag go /phyis lus thams cad du bde —392—

stobs rgyas shing thur du 'dzag na lus la bgram par bya ba gal che bas/ dang por rlung sbyangs te/ kha sna nas ha dang hu gis dbyung ba dang / dus gcig tu lus tsog pur byas te/ lto ba sgal pa la sbyar zhing 'og gi lam gsum gyen du 'then/dmigs pa hu sngon po zhig rtsa dbu ma nas smin mtshams su hril gyi byung bar bsam/ yang nang du rngubs nas lto ba gang zhing 'og tu phul nas hū de dbu ma'i mas snar thal te byung bar bsam/ de ltar rlung byang nas/ dmigs pa gtad pa tsam gyis 'dren thub pas 'khrul 'khor gang gis kyang phan no/ /mi shes na 'di ltar byas te/ lus tsog pa'am/ skyil krung gang bde la/ lag pa'i srin lag gi rtsa mthe bong gis mnan la/ khu tshur bcangs te mdun du bsnol ba ltar byas nas/ de nas sngar ltar rlung bzung zhing / dang po steng rlung non par mnan la/ de nas 'og rlung yang drag tu 'then pa dang dus gcig tu lho ba sgal pa la sbyar/ lce yar skan la sbyar/ mchu dang mig gyen la bzlog /mdun dang g.yas g.yon du lus phar gcu tshur gcu bya zhing / res mos kyis drangs te/ dmigs pa ni/ hū gis thig le thams cad drangs/ smin phrag tu thim pa la shes pa gtad de dag 'dren yin no/ /dal bus 'dren na skyil krung bcas pa'i pus mo la lag mthil gtad nas gzhan rlung sbyor 'dren lugs snga ma bzhin du dal bus bya/ des ni steng du drangs par nus pas de nas dgram pa ni/ lus drag tu sprug pa dang 'phur ba kho nas chog pa shas che la/ gal te des ma chog na gan rkyal du nyal la/ rkang pa dang lag pa re mos su sprug pa dang 'phur bas khyab par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar byas pas steng lce chung gi dbus su 'dzag na/ seng ge rnam grol gyi phyag rgya byas —393—

te/ rlung phyi bzung nas gnad du 'gro bar bya'o/ /'ga' zhig la byang grags pa'i stobs kyis/ gong gis 'khrul 'khor gyis mi phan pa yod de/ de la dbu ma'i mas snar dgag dgos pas bgrang ba'i mthas bsrung ba zhes bya ba/ 'og gi rtsa sgo rkang nga/ g.yon pa'i rting pas mnan la/ thig le rlung gis thur du phul zhing /bar gyi rlung thad kar brgyangs nas yun ring du ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag cing de nyid brtan par bya/ 'di rnams ni byang chub sems kyi gegs sel yin no/ /brten pa sems las byung ba'i gegs sel ni/ /gong du bshad pa nyid la tshang zhing / gzhan yang thun che chung kha zas dbri skyed/ dmigs pa sgrim lhod rnams spel ba dang / sems kyi gnad sna tshogs su 'pho ba dang / yul sna tshogs kyi bdud rtsi bsten pa dang / bla ma la mos gus dang / chos la yid ches kyi dad pa dang / 'gro ba la snying rje dang / chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur shes pas/sems kyi gegs las rngong sar grol bar 'gyur ro/ /gegs sel thor bu sna tshogs bsdus pa'i sde tshan te lnga pa'o// //de ltar na gegs sel gyi yi ge 'di yang / brgyud pa'i bla ma gong ma so so'i man ngag gi yi ge bzhin tu phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa yin la/ 'ga' zhig la nyams myong gis kyang cung zad brgyan pa ste/ nags rgyal gyi dben gnas jo nang du tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// la stod dbang rgyal dang / sron lugs kyi gegs sel mang du yod pa ni de rnams kyi gsung du blta bar bya'o// //—394—

o snyu sti/ bla ma dang yi dam la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba'i bla ma dang ni de'i chos la/ /dad pas btud nas skabs 'dir brjod bgyi ba/ /blo gros dman zhing brtson pa dang bral yang / /bla ma'i bka' drin thob gang gsal bar brjod/ /phyi ma'i dus 'dir shing rta cher grags shing / /yon to dris rgyas grags pa'i rta dmar can/ /phyogs bcur 'god la lhod pa dang bral ba pad dkar zhes bya'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ /sor sdud skabs 'dir rlung sems zin pa'i rtags/ /bshad pa'i sa chu me dang rlung gi rlung / /zin pa'i gnad gang zin nyid ci la dang / /dbu mar tshud dang de la khyad par ci/ /'dir brjod pa/ spyir na phyi rol yul la rgyug byed rlung / /zlog tu nye dang cung zad zlog pa dang / /dbu mar zhugs dang gnas dang thim pa de/ /gnas skabs lnga kar la yang thim rim gyi/ /rtags kun che chung rim pas 'char ro zhes/ /sman zhabs la sogs rgya bod mkhas grub kyis/ /rgyud sde dgongs pa bzhin bshad 'dir bzung bya/ /thim sogs kun la'ang rim pa du ma mthong / /re zhig thim dang gtan nas thim pa dang / /re zhig thim la'ang rnam grangs mtha' yas yod/ /mnyam bzhag thun gcig bar la'ang skabs lnga dang / /ldang ba yod phyir shin tu gnas skabs mang / /sor bsam gnyis kyi skabs su rlung rnams ni/ /cung zad ldog nga/ yin zhes kho bo 'dod / /de la zin zhes tha snyad sbyar la rag /gnad ni dhū ti'i —395—

yas snar rlung sems 'jug /dbu mar cung zad chud pa 'di yang lags/ /ro rkyang rgyu ba 'gags na chud pa zer/ /tha snyad glo bur sbyar ba mang po la/ /brtsad par mi 'os don la dpyod na mdzes/ /tshig gtsor mdzad na skabs 'dir nam mkha'i rlung / /dngos shugs gang la'ang ma bstan chad pa'i skyon/ /tshud ces bya ba grong khyer pa yi brda/ /sa yi dngos gzhir smra ba'i skyon du gsungs/ /zhes brjod do/ /dris pa/ rtsa rnams dag tshe dbu ma las gzhan pa'i/ /rnam ga theg rgyud las ma mthong kun mkhyen che/ /'khor ba gnas gyur myang 'das mi bzhed pas/ /ro rkyang 'khor ba'i rtsa sogs gang du song / /brjod pa/ nyid kyi lugs la dag pa ci la zer/ kho bo cag ni rtsa gzhan nus pa dag /dbu ma bzhin du ye shes skyed byed la/ /dag ces zer zhing slob dpon so so yi/ /grub mtha' 'gal ba mtha' dag su yis skyong / /rgyal dang rgyal sras chen po'i dgongs pa 'chad/ /'on kyang jo nang kun mkhyen 'khor 'das kyi/ /gnas gyur gtan nas mi bzhed rgyu mchan ci/ /rnal 'byor spyod gzhung grub mtha'i snying por mjad/ /'khor ba rnam shes brgyad po gnas gyur las/ /myang 'das ye shes bzhi sogs thams cad bzhed/ /'khor ba 'khrul snang med par rtogs pa'i tshe/ khams gsum snang ba thams cad 'gags pa la/ /ro rkyang gnyis la dgos su dpyod 'di blun/ /grong khyer tshig nas thal bar song shes nas/ /sgo gleg gang la song zhes dbyod dang 'dra/ /'dri na 'khor ba gang du song zhes 'dri/ /mtha' yi rtsa rnams shin tu phra ba dang / /dbus kyi rtsa ni shin tu sbom zhes sogs/ /gsungs phyir dbu mar dag pa shin tu bzhed/ /dris pa/ sor sdud nyid kyis grol ba'i gang zag de/ /rtsa mdud sto396—

gang gis bshig dang dkar dmar gyi/ /'pho ba dag dang bcu gnyis bden don sa/ /rgyu rkyen ci las byung 'di gsal bar smros/ /brjod pa/ lam g.yin rtogs pa rgyud la ma skyes pa'i/ /sor sdud kho nas grol ba yod ma yin/ /sor sdud kho nas grol ba'i gang zag gis/ /tha snyad tshad ldan las med 'dis ci bya/ /rab kyis dang pos rtogs zhes bya ba la/ /rab ces bya bas rim gnyis 'bad pa yis/ /skye ba snga mar bsgoms pa'i gang zag bstan/ de ni tshe 'dir bla mas bsten pa ltar/ /sor sdud bsgoms pa'i rkyen gyis rlung 'gags nas/ khams kyi thim rim mthar phyin rjes dran dang / /ting 'dzin sogs kyi rtogs pa skyes la zer/ /skye ba snga mar 'dzin pa'i rjes dran gyi/ /rtogs pa yod na de la 'byung ba lags/ /sor sdud tsam gyi lta ba bzang po dag /shar la grol ba'i ming tsam 'dogs pa mthong / /ming tsam la ni bdag cag ga la rtsod/ /bsam gtan phan gyi man ngag bla ma yis/ /ma bstan pas na dang po'i rtogs zhes bshad/ /rtsa mdud 'jig par yan lag phyi ma bzhir/ /dkar dmar thim tshul ting 'dzin skabs su 'gyung / /dris pa/ srog rtsol dus su phyi nas rngub pa'i rlung / /dbu mar zhugs pa'i gnas te 'khor lo gang / /de nyid dbu ma'i lam du mi 'jug na/ /sas te nang du bkang pa'i dgos pa ci/ /brjod pa/ srog rtsol dus kyi zhugs gnas thim gsum po/ /gtso bor lte ba'i 'khor lor byed pa yin/ /dris tshig 'di las dpags na srog rtsol skabs/ /dbu mar zhugs pa 'ba' zhig khyed bzhed dam/ /dris pa/ rlung rnams phyi rol 'phos pa'i skyon gsungs nas/ /yang 'dir mnyam rgyu'i 'pho ba bsgrub byar bstan/ /gzhan ni de nyid sgra 397—

gcan 'chi ltas bshad/ /'di 'dra 'gal med ston pa'i rigs pa ci/ /brjod pa/ re zhig gzhan las zhes 'di ci zhig brtag /dus 'khor yin na gzhan zhes tshig mi 'thad/ /rgyud sde gzhan zhig yin na skabs kyi gtam/ /nyams pa min nam blo ldan rnams kyis dpyod/ /'di la mgo sgre ba'i lan ni/ sa sder shin sbyangs bde ba skye ba'i sngon/ /klad pa lci zhing non pa 'byung zhes ba/ /gzhan du mgo nad yod pa'i rtags su bshad/ /'di 'dra 'gal med ston pa'i rigs pa ci/ /ye shes mgon po mahā kā la ni/ /spyan gsum phyag bzhir sgrub thabs khungs mar 'byung / /gzhan du dbang phyug mig gsum lag bzhir bshad/ /de 'dra'i 'gal med rigs pa'ang khyod dris shig /dngos kyi lan ni/ 'chi ba'i rtsa chen bsdud 'bral mar 'bab pa'i/ /mnyam rgyu'i rlung gis dus min 'chi ba ster/ /dbu mar 'bab gang phyi ru rgyu ba na/ /mnyam rgyu kho na lags te 'chi med ster/ /de bzhin 'chi ba'i ltas la'ang dbu ma'i sgo/ /yangs por zhig pa'i mnyam rgyu 'gyung mod kyi/ /rnal 'byor stobs kyis dbu mar bcings pa dang / /'dra ba'i the tshom gzhi yang ga la yod/ /dris pa/ srog rtsol gyis ni rlung rnams 'gags byas nas/ /'dzin pas rigs drug rtser mor 'chings de la/ /slar yang ting nge 'dzin der nyi khri dang / /chig stong drug brgya 'gag dgos ci ste gsungs/ /brjod pa/ srog 'dzin skabs su rtsol bas 'ching nus mod/ /de ru gtan nas rgyu ba 'gag ma yin/ /ting 'dzin skabs su rlung rnams rtsa ba nas/ /phyin chad rgyu ba med par byas pa yin/ /byams pa bsgoms pas lan dga' zhe sdang bzlog /stong nyid mthong tshe gtan nas bzlog pa bzhin/ khyed kyi —398—
