ltar na rlung thim rnal 'byor pa/ /rtag tu dbugs kyi 'gyu ba 'chad par 'gyur/ /rlung gi thim tshul srog 'dzin las lhag pa/ /rjes dran skabs nas ci phyir yod ma yin/ /'on kyang thim tshul 'byung ba'i thog ma dang / /gtan nas thim pa'i dus gnyis brjod pa yin/ /dris pa/ ting nge 'dzin der rtsa mdud grol ba dang / /'dzag bde dag gsungs sngon ma rnams la min/ /lam 'dir khyad chos lhag po ci zhig yod/ /med na skabs 'dir gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan gang / /brjod pa/ ting 'dzin skabs 'dir phyag chen gyis drangs pa'i/ /zhu bdes rang bzhin bde ba mtshon pa yod/ /de yis thig le mi 'dzag mi g.yo bar/ /rang gnas g.yo med bcings pa'i bde ba sgrub/ /'gyur med bde bas rtsa mdud rdzogs par 'jig /'dzag bde'i dbang du de ni 'gyur ma yin/ /dag ces bya ba cung zad mgo gnon dang / /sa bon bcom dang gnas ngan len pa spangs/ /gsum la ci rigs dgongs phyir bag yod mdzod/ /las rgyas 'dzag bde sbyin zhes gsungs pa dang / /dag bya'i 'dzag bde cig gam tha dad 'dod/khyod la dri bya kho bo tha dad smra/ dris pa/ lus gcig nyid kyis ye shes sku 'grub pa/ /gsal bar gsungs na rtsa sogs snyigs ma'i khams/ ji ltar dwangs 'gyur snyigs ma'i phung po 'di/ /spangs na lus gcig de yang ji ltar 'gyur//brjod pa/ gong du ro rkyang gang du song zhes dang / /skabs 'dir snyigs ma ji ltar dwangs zhes pa'i/ /dogs dpyod 'di ni lhag par bzang min te//dogs la gcig gi dogs pa gcig lan btab/ /dkar dmar rlung bcas bcings pas snyigs ma'i khams/ /ngan pa zos nas ye shes skur 'gyur ba//—399—

lcags rnams dngul chus gser du bsgyur 'dra zhes/ /gsal bar gsungs pa 'di la dris pas ci/ /spangs zhes bya ba ngo bo spangs pa'am/ shi bas spangs pa nyid la 'dri ba yin/ /snyigs ma yal nas ye shes skur gyur la/ khre ba'i dogs pa dpyod ldan su la 'gyung / /ye shes sku dang ma dag lus nyid kyi/ /gzhi mthun med cing ngo bo zhes ma spangs/ /lcags kyi dngos po spangs zhes dper yang gsungs/ /'di la ji skad bkod pa'i skyon yang med/ /thog ma'i rten gyi lus ni cig kho na/ /de phyir lus cig kho nar brjod mod kyi/ /rnam smin ye shes sku de gnyis brgyud kyang / /lus gcig nyid la 'ched rgyas zhes gsungs bzhin/ /rgyal ba'i sras por zhal gyis bzhes zin pas/ /rtsod pa lhur len bstan bcos 'os ma yin/ /mkhas pa lan smras 'os yin dri 'os min/ /'khrul dang blun po mkhas par 'chos pa la/ /gdams ngag 'os kyi sdang ba'i yul ma yin/ /dri med rang lugs rgya cher 'jog pa dang / /lugs ngan rigs pa'i mtshon cha brgya phrag gis/ /gzhig par rigs kyi khyad du bsad pas ci/ /klu sgrub dbyig gnyen chos kyi grags pa sogs/ /'phags yul mkhas dang phyogs 'di'i shing rta che/ /kun gyi dri ba phyogs bcur 'gyed mi mdzad/ /mkhas rnams gzhan gyi dris na gsong por smra/ /shes bzhin 'dri ba tshar bcad kyi/ /gnas su bshad pa ma yin nam/ /rgyal ba bcom ldan mu stegs la/ /the tsho mi gcod par ga la mdzad/ /zhus na nye ring med par ni/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi'i char yang 'bebs/ kha ba can 'dir phyi ma'i dus/ /grags 'dod chags sdang dbang gyur rnams/ /rang nyid spobs pa gtugs bzhin du/ /gzhan la dri ba brgya phrag —40()—

sbyor drug gi dri lan bzhugs/rtsom/ /'di lta bu yi skyes bus ni/ /gzhan la dri ba mi mdzes te/ /gal te gzhan gyis dris gyur na/ /tshig gi dga' ston spel bar 'os// //zhis pa'ang tā ra nā tha yis/ /dri ba'i bstan bcos mthong ma thag /rang gi blo la shar ba rnams/ /thun gcig nyid la yi ger bkod/ /rang lo nyer lnga pa la'o/ /zhus dag dge legs 'phel/ g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing / /'phags ma bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /nga tsho phyi ma'i dus/ /de ru skye smon 'debs/ /'di yang ma tis so//

nged dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gi las sgrub mi snar lo bstud mar 'tsho ba'i yon sbyor gnang mkhan mchog sprul pad+ma dbang rgyal rin po che la snying thag pa nas thugs rje zhu ba dang /krung rga'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma par skrun thad la rgyab skyor dang mnyam las gnang bar snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu ba yin/dpar yon zhal 'debs gnang mkhan/rang re'i spun zla rnams kyi mtshan tho/ ka mad kyi go rim ltar lags/gdung sras phrin las nor bu rin po che/ bla ma mthar phyin rin po che/ bla ma yon tan/sman pa rig 'dzin lags/ las rab gling pa rin po che/ bsod nams bde skyid/
